  (or a trans chain), and the needed facts are:
    - Quant (lift 1 a) <: a and b <: Quant (lift 1 b)  (sub_inst/sub_lift,
      using subst_lift1),
    - the Asf datum from section 4,
    - the Fork cases are vacuous because a Funty source cannot reach a Fork
      or Stem head (same no_* lemmas).
This lemma is also exactly the "domain contravariance + codomain covariance"
needed for the closure steps.

6. Preservation lemmas (standard de Bruijn metatheory)
------------------------------------------------------
subst_subtype :
  forall P Q w, subtype P Q -> subtype (subst P w) (subst Q w).
lift_subtype :
  forall P Q k n, subtype P Q -> subtype (lift_rec P k n) (lift_rec Q k n).
Prove by induction on the subtype derivation.  All rules are schematic, so
the only work is commuting subst/lift with the constructors:
  - sub_lift/sub_inst need
      subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X            (subst_lift_rec)
      subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X  (subst_lift_rec_S)
  - sub_inst needs the "subst commutes with subst under one binder" instance
    (two substitutions at different depths); prove the standard lemma
      subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 1) (subst ...) ...
    or avoid it by applying the induction hypothesis at the right instance.
Everything else is congruence (sub_stem/sub_fork/sub_asf/sub_funty/sub_quant
and the quantifier commutation rules are preserved verbatim by subst/lift,
because subst/lift recursively map constructors to the same constructors and
commute with Quant by incrementing the cutoff).

7. Additional easy shape lemmas used to kill impossible cases
-------------------------------------------------------------
below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf.
no_leaf_stem : subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False.
no_leaf_fork : subtype Leaf (Fork P Q) -> False.
no_stem_fork : subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False.
no_stem_leaf : subtype (Stem A) Leaf -> False  (from below_leaf).
stem_inv : subtype (Stem A) (Stem B) -> subtype A B.
All are proved by induction on the derivation plus inversion on the possible
last rules (which are syntactic: the constructors of the conclusion fix the
head of the source).  sub_trans is handled by applying the IH to the second
premise (whose source is the same head) and then to the first premise.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes Triage.derive.
Open Scope string_scope. Open Scope nat_scope. Open Scope tree_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Fixpoint NF (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => NF Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z | _ => False
  end
with NFQ (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => NFQ Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z | _ => False
  end.

Fixpoint SF (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Stem _ => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => SF Z
  | Quant Z => SFQ Z | _ => False
  end
with SFQ (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Stem _ => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => SFQ Z
  | Quant Z => SFQ Z | _ => False
  end.

Lemma pred_subst_rec : forall X,
  (NF X -> forall u k, NF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NFQ (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (SF X -> forall u k, SF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (SFQ X -> forall u k, SFQ (subst_rec X u k)).
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; simpl in *; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma pred_lift_rec : forall X,
  (NF X -> forall k n, NF (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (SF X -> forall k n, SF (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (SFQ X -> forall k n, SFQ (lift_rec X k n)).
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; simpl in *; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma NF_subst : forall X u, NF X -> NF (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (pred_subst_rec X) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma NFQ_subst : forall X u, NFQ X -> NFQ (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X)) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma SF_subst : forall X u, SF X -> SF (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X))) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma SFQ_subst : forall X u, SFQ X -> SFQ (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X))) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma NF_lift : forall X, NF X -> NF (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (pred_lift_rec X) H 0 1). Qed.
Lemma NFQ_lift : forall X, NFQ X -> NFQ (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (pred_lift_rec X)) H 0 1). Qed.
Lemma SF_lift : forall X, SF X -> SF (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_lift_rec X))) H 0 1). Qed.
Lemma SFQ_lift : forall X, SFQ X -> SFQ (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_lift_rec X))) H 0 1). Qed.

  - apply (proj1 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X)) H u 1). (* Quant *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Funty *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Leaf *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Stem *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Fork *)

  - constructor.                                       (* Funty *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Leaf *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Stem *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Fork *)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Theorem programs_have_types: forall p gamma, program p -> derive gamma p (program_type p).

Theorem programs_have_principal_types:
  forall p, program p ->
            forall gamma ty, derive gamma p ty -> subtype (program_type p) ty.
====
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* A small hint database for the subtyping and typing rules. *)
Create HintDb triage.

Hint Constructors subtype : triage.
Hint Constructors derive : triage.
Hint Constructors program : triage.

(* Applications of a leaf and of a stem. *)
Lemma subtype_leaf_app: forall A u ty,
  subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype A u ->
  subtype (Stem A) ty.
Proof.
  intros. eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_app: forall A B u ty,
  subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype B u ->
  subtype (Fork A B) ty.
Proof.
  intros. eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Hint Resolve subtype_leaf_app subtype_stem_app : triage.

(* A typing of a stem at a function type is principal at the
   corresponding stem type. *)
Lemma stem_fun_principal: forall M gamma u ty,
  program M ->
  (forall gamma ty, derive gamma M ty -> subtype (program_type M) ty) ->
  derive gamma (Node @ M) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype (Stem (program_type M)) (Funty u ty).
Proof.
  intros M gamma u ty Hp IH Hd.
  inversion Hd; subst.
  inversion H3; subst.
  pose proof (IH _ _ H5) as HA.
  eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Hint Resolve stem_fun_principal : triage.

Theorem programs_have_types: forall p gamma, program p -> derive gamma p (program_type p).
Proof.
  intros p gamma Hp. induction Hp.
  - simpl. eauto 10 with triage.
  - simpl. eauto 12 with triage.
  - simpl. eauto 20 with triage.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_principal_types:
  forall p, program p ->
            forall gamma ty, derive gamma p ty -> subtype (program_type p) ty.
Proof.
  intros p Hp. induction Hp; intros gamma ty Hd.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst. eauto with triage.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst. inversion H3; subst.
    pose proof (IHHp _ _ H5) as HA.
    eauto 15 with triage.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst.
    pose proof (IHHp1 _ _ H5) as HM.
    pose proof (IHHp2 _ _ H4) as HN.
    eauto 20 with triage.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

(* D1 certificate: a predicate on the *reachable* type, not on derivations. *)
Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with

  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Parameter Good_subst : forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k).

   derivation.  This is the whole content of D1. *)
Lemma Good_stable : forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.

  intros S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d0 ].
    apply sub_stem, d.  (* wrong direction placeholder *)
Abort.

(* Direct D1 from Good_stable at S=Leaf. *)
Definition D1_of_stable
  (stab : forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T)
  : forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  := fun u ty d => stab Leaf (Funty u ty) I d.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Type-valued mirror of subtype, used for derivation analysis. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive subT : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=
| subT_zero : forall ty, subT ty ty
| subT_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subT ty1 ty2 -> subT ty2 ty3 -> subT ty1 ty3
| subT_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subT uty1 uty2 -> subT (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| subT_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2,
    subT uty1 uty2 -> subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| subT_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subT uty1 uty2 -> subT (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| subT_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2,
    subT uty2 uty1 -> subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| subT_quant : forall vty1 vty2, subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)
| subT_quant_stem: forall uty, subT (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| subT_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subT (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| subT_quant_asf: forall uty, subT (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| subT_dist: forall uty vty, subT (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| subT_inst : forall ty u, subT (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| subT_lift: forall ty, subT ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))
| subT_leaf_fun:forall uty, subT Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| subT_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subT (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
| subT_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subT (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| subT_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subT (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| subT_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subT (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| subT_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subT (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| subT_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subT (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)
| subT_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subT omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| subT_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subT (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| subT_to_asf: forall ty, subT ty (Asf ty)
| subT_from_asf: forall uty vty, subT (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| subT_bffs: forall uty vty,
    subT (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| subT_bfff : forall uty vty wty,
    subT (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty)).

Lemma subT_subtype : forall X Y, subT X Y -> subtype X Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y h. induction h.
  - apply sub_zero.
  - eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - apply sub_stem; assumption.
  - apply sub_fork; assumption.
  - apply sub_asf; assumption.
  - apply sub_funty; assumption.
  - apply sub_quant; assumption.
  - apply sub_quant_stem.
  - apply sub_quant_fork.
  - apply sub_quant_asf.
  - apply sub_dist.
  - apply sub_inst.
  - apply sub_lift.
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - apply sub_stem_fun.
  - apply sub_fork_leaf.
  - apply sub_fork_stem.
  - apply sub_fork_fork_leaf.
  - apply sub_fork_fork_stem.
  - apply sub_fork_fork_fork.
  - apply sub_recursion.
  - apply sub_tree; assumption.
  - apply sub_to_asf.
  - apply sub_from_asf.
  - apply sub_bffs.
  - apply sub_bfff.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_subT : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> subT X Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y h. induction h.
  - apply subT_zero.
  - eapply subT_trans; eauto.
  - apply subT_stem; assumption.
  - apply subT_fork; assumption.
  - apply subT_asf; assumption.
  - apply subT_funty; assumption.
  - apply subT_quant; assumption.
  - apply subT_quant_stem.
  - apply subT_quant_fork.
  - apply subT_quant_asf.
  - apply subT_dist.
  - apply subT_inst.
  - apply subT_lift.
  - apply subT_leaf_fun.
  - apply subT_stem_fun.
  - apply subT_fork_leaf.
  - apply subT_fork_stem.
  - apply subT_fork_fork_leaf.
  - apply subT_fork_fork_stem.
  - apply subT_fork_fork_fork.
  - apply subT_recursion.
  - apply subT_tree; assumption.
  - apply subT_to_asf.
  - apply subT_from_asf.
  - apply subT_bffs.
  - apply subT_bfff.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* NF / NFQ                                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint NF (X:dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf Z => NF Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z
  | Var _ => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  end
with NFQ (X:dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf Z => NFQ Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z
  | Var _ => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  end.

Lemma NF_subst_lift_all : forall X,
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NFQ (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NF X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)).
Proof.
  induction X; cbn; repeat split; intros H;
    try exact I; try destruct H; intros;
    try solve [eapply (proj1 IHX); eauto];
    try solve [eapply (proj1 (proj2 IHX)); eauto];
    try solve [eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 IHX))); eauto];
    try solve [eapply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 IHX))); eauto].
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_subst_rec_NF : forall X u k, NFQ X -> NF (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (NF_subst_lift_all X) H u k).
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_subst_rec_NFQ : forall X u k, NFQ X -> NFQ (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X)) H u k).
Qed.

Lemma NF_lift_rec_NFQ : forall X k n, NF X -> NFQ (lift_rec X k n).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X))) H k n).
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_lift_rec_NFQ : forall X k n, NFQ X -> NFQ (lift_rec X k n).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X))) H k n).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* NF / NFQ preservation                                        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma NF_sub_both : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> (NF X -> NF Y) /\ (NFQ X -> NFQ Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction H; cbn in *;
    try (split; intros Hx; intuition).
  all: try (match goal with |- ?G => idtac "REMAIN:" G end).
Abort.

| subT_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subT ty1 ty2 -> subT ty2 ty3 -> subT ty1 ty3

| subT_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subT uty1 uty2 -> subT (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| subT_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2,
    subT uty2 uty1 -> subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)

| subT_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subT (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| subT_quant_asf: forall uty, subT (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| subT_dist: forall uty vty, subT (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| subT_lift: forall ty, subT ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))
| subT_leaf_fun:forall uty, subT Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| subT_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subT (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
| subT_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subT (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| subT_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,

(* NF / NFQ                                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint NF (X:dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf Z => NF Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z
  | Var _ => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  end
with NFQ (X:dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf Z => NFQ Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z
  | Var _ => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  end.

Lemma NF_subst_lift_all : forall X,
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NFQ (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NF X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)).
Proof.
  induction X; cbn; repeat split; intros H;
    try exact I; try destruct H; intros;
    try solve [eapply (proj1 IHX); eauto];
    try solve [eapply (proj1 (proj2 IHX)); eauto];
    try solve [eapply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 IHX))); eauto];
    try solve [eapply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 IHX))); eauto].
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_subst_rec_NF : forall X u k, NFQ X -> NF (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (NF_subst_lift_all X) H u k).
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_subst_rec_NFQ : forall X u k, NFQ X -> NFQ (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X)) H u k).
Qed.

Lemma NF_lift_rec_NFQ : forall X k n, NF X -> NFQ (lift_rec X k n).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X))) H k n).
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_lift_rec_NFQ : forall X k n, NFQ X -> NFQ (lift_rec X k n).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X))) H k n).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* NF / NFQ preservation                                        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma NF_sub_both : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> (NF X -> NF Y) /\ (NFQ X -> NFQ Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction H; cbn in *;
    try (split; intros Hx; intuition).

Abort.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.

(* A syntactic certificate on reachable types. *)
Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

(*
   D1 reduces to the two admissibility (lift/subst closure) properties below.
   These are standard metatheorems about subtype; they are the only missing
   ingredient of this proof.  The theorem D1_from_closures is axiom-free.
*)

Lemma Good_stable :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact H ].
    apply sub_stem. exact d1.
  - (* sub_quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply stem_quant_lift. exact H.
  - (* sub_inst *) unfold subst. apply Hsubst. exact H.
  - (* sub_lift *) unfold lift. apply Hlift. exact H.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D1_from_closures :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst u ty d.
  exact (Good_stable Hlift Hsubst Leaf (Funty u ty) I d).
Qed.
EOF

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.

(* Certificate for D2: the head A is shifted by lift 1 under Quant binders. *)
Fixpoint Good2 (A S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => False
  | Funty a b => subtype (Fork A a) b
  | Quant Z => Good2 (lift 1 A) Z
  | Asf Z => Good2 A Z
  | Stem B => subtype A B
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good2_stable :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, subtype S T -> forall A, Good2 A S -> Good2 A T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T d. induction d; intros A HG; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, HG.
  - (* sub_stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HG | exact d ].
  - (* sub_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact HG.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact HG ].
    apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | exact d1 ].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply (IHd (lift 1 A)). exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift.
    + apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply fork_quant_lift. exact HG.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    pose proof (Hsubst (lift 1 A) ty u 0 HG) as X.
    change (Good2 (subst (lift 1 A) u) (subst ty u)) in X.
    rewrite subst_lift1 in X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    pose proof (Hlift A ty 0 1 HG) as X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    apply sub_fork.
    + exact HG.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact HG.
Qed.

Lemma D2_from_closures :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst A u ty d.
  exact (Good2_stable Hlift Hsubst (Stem A) (Funty u ty) d A (sub_zero A)).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.

(* D1 certificate: a predicate on the *reachable* type, not on derivations. *)
Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

(* Placeholders for the two closure lemmas; to be proved from
   lift/subst preservation of subtype. *)
Parameter Good_lift : forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n).
Parameter Good_subst : forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k).

(* Stability of Good along the subtype relation, by induction on the
   derivation.  This is the whole content of D1. *)
Lemma Good_stable : forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
Proof.
  intros S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d0 ].
    apply sub_stem, d.  (* wrong direction placeholder *)
Abort.

(* Direct D1 from Good_stable at S=Leaf. *)
Definition D1_of_stable
  (stab : forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T)
  : forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  := fun u ty d => stab Leaf (Funty u ty) I d.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* ---------- core arithmetic identities (from exp7.v) ---------- *)
Lemma insert_relocate_k : forall u i k, insert_Var u (relocate i k 1) k = Var i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [h|h].
  - destruct (compare k (1+i)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn; try lia; reflexivity.
  - destruct (compare k i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn; try lia; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_relocate_Sk : forall i k, insert_Var (Var 0) (relocate i (S k) 1) k = Var i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  destruct (test (S k) i) as [h|h].
  - destruct (compare k (1+i)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn; try lia; reflexivity.
  - destruct (compare k i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn; try lia.
    subst. cbn. f_equal. lia.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_rec : forall X k u, subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X.
Proof.
  induction X; intros k u; simpl.
  - apply insert_relocate_k.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_rec_S : forall X k, subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X.
Proof.
  induction X; intros k; simpl.
  - apply insert_relocate_Sk.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift1 : forall X u, subst (lift 1 X) u = X.
Proof. intros. unfold subst, lift. apply subst_lift_rec. Qed.
Lemma subst_lift_rec11 : forall X, subst (lift_rec X 1 1) (Var 0) = X.
Proof. intros. unfold subst. apply subst_lift_rec_S. Qed.

(* ---------- additional commutation identities ---------- *)
Lemma relocate_add : forall i k n, relocate i k n = (if test k i then n+i else i).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec : forall X k n m,
  lift_rec (lift_rec X k n) k m = lift_rec X k (n+m).
Proof.
  induction X; intros k n1 m1; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. destruct (test k n) as [h|h]; simpl.
    + (* k <= n0 : first lift gives n0+n, second test k (n0+n) true *)
      destruct (test k (n1+n)) as [h2|h2]; simpl; f_equal; lia.
    + destruct (test k n) as [h2|h2]; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; lia); try lia.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift : forall X n m, lift n (lift m X) = lift (n+m) X.
Proof. intros. unfold lift. rewrite (lift_rec_lift_rec X 0 m n). replace (m+n) with (n+m) by lia. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_comm_S : forall X w k,
  subst_rec (lift 1 X) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec X w k).
Proof.
  induction X; intros w k; simpl.
  - (* Var *)
    unfold lift, relocate; simpl.
    unfold insert_Var, relocate.
    destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h]; try lia.
    (* lift 1 (Var n) = Var(1+n); subst at S k *)
    destruct (compare (1+n) (S k)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
    + (* 1+n < S k  i.e. n<k *)
      assert (n < k) by lia.
      destruct (compare k n) as [[h2|h2]|h2]; try lia; simpl.
      * (* LHS Var pred(1+n); RHS lift1 (Var pred n) *)
        replace (pred (1+n)) with n by lia.
        replace (pred n) with n by lia. (* n<k and n>=0, but if n<k then n may be 0 -> pred0=0, okay; pred n = n only if n=0? For n=0, pred0=0 yes *)
        reflexivity.
      * subst; lia.
      * simpl. f_equal. lia.
    + (* 1+n = S k i.e. n=k *)
      subst. cbn. destruct (compare n n) as [[h2|h2]|h2]; try lia.
      * cbn. unfold lift. apply lift_rec_lift_rec. (* lift k w then lift 1 = lift(k+1) w *)
      * cbn. reflexivity.
    + (* n>k *)
      assert (k < n) by lia.
      destruct (compare k n) as [[h2|h2]|h2]; try lia; simpl.
      * (* k<n: insert_Var w n k = Var(pred n); lift1 -> Var(1+pred n) = Var n *)
        replace (pred n) with n by lia.
        replace (1+n) with (S n) by lia. cbn. reflexivity.
      * subst; lia.
      * (* n<k contradiction *)
        lia.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma subst_subst_comm : forall X u w k,
  subst (subst_rec X w (S k)) (subst_rec u w k) = subst_rec (subst X u) w k.
Proof.
  induction X; intros u w k; simpl.

      * (* pred n >0: result Var(pred(pred n)); RHS subst X u = Var pred n (since 0<n? compare 0 n hgt) then subst_rec ... w k *)

        replace (pred n) with (n-1) by lia.
        (* Need arithmetic case on compare k (n-1) and relation to S k<n *)
        destruct (compare k (pred n)) as [[hk1|hk2]|hk3]; try lia; simpl.
        -- replace (pred (pred n)) with (n-2) by lia.
           destruct (compare 0 (Nat.pred (Nat.pred n))) as [[h1|h1]|h1]; try lia.
           ++ simpl. f_equal. lia.
           ++ simpl. f_equal. lia.
           ++ exfalso; lia.
        -- subst. (* k = n-1 *) 
           (* LHS: compare 0 (pred n)=eq -> lift 0 u' = u'; RHS compare k (pred n)=eq -> lift k w *)
           simpl. (* lift 0 u'=u' *)

        subst. simpl. unfold lift. simpl. reflexivity.
      * simpl. f_equal. lia.
    + (* S k = n *) subst. cbn.
      unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare 0 k) as [[h0|h0]|h0]; try lia; simpl.
      * (* k>0: lift 0 u' = u'; RHS subst (Var(Sk)) u: compare 0 (S k) ght -> Var(Sk)? then subst_rec (Var(Sk)) w k: compare k (Sk) lt -> Var(S k -1)=Var k. Hmm *)

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| sub_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| sub_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| sub_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subtype (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)

| sub_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subtype omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| sub_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subtype (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| sub_to_asf: forall ty, subtype ty (Asf ty)
| sub_from_asf: forall uty vty, subtype (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| sub_bffs: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| sub_bfff : forall uty vty wty, subtype (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
                                         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty))
.

Require Import terms.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes Triage.derive.
Open Scope string_scope. Open Scope nat_scope. Open Scope tree_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Fixpoint NF (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => NF Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z | _ => False
  end
with NFQ (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => NFQ Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z | _ => False
  end.

Fixpoint SF (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Stem _ => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => SF Z
  | Quant Z => SFQ Z | _ => False
  end
with SFQ (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Stem _ => True | Funty _ _ => True | Asf Z => SFQ Z
  | Quant Z => SFQ Z | _ => False
  end.

Lemma pred_subst_rec : forall X,
  (NF X -> forall u k, NF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NFQ (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (SF X -> forall u k, SF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (SFQ X -> forall u k, SFQ (subst_rec X u k)).
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; simpl in *; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma pred_lift_rec : forall X,
  (NF X -> forall k n, NF (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (SF X -> forall k n, SF (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (SFQ X -> forall k n, SFQ (lift_rec X k n)).
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; simpl in *; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma NF_subst : forall X u, NF X -> NF (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (pred_subst_rec X) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma NFQ_subst : forall X u, NFQ X -> NFQ (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X)) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma SF_subst : forall X u, SF X -> SF (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X))) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma SFQ_subst : forall X u, SFQ X -> SFQ (subst X u).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X))) H u 0). Qed.
Lemma NF_lift : forall X, NF X -> NF (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (pred_lift_rec X) H 0 1). Qed.
Lemma NFQ_lift : forall X, NFQ X -> NFQ (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (pred_lift_rec X)) H 0 1). Qed.
Lemma SF_lift : forall X, SF X -> SF (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_lift_rec X))) H 0 1). Qed.
Lemma SFQ_lift : forall X, SFQ X -> SFQ (lift 1 X).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_lift_rec X))) H 0 1). Qed.

Lemma NFQ_subst_NF : forall X, NFQ X -> forall u, NF (subst X u).
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; intros H u; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.                                 (* Var *)
  - apply (proj1 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X)) H u 1). (* Quant *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Funty *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Leaf *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Stem *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Fork *)
  - apply IHX. exact H.                            (* Asf *)
Qed.

Lemma SFQ_subst_SF : forall X, SFQ X -> forall u, SF (subst X u).
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; intros H u; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.                                 (* Var *)
  - apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_subst_rec X))) H u 1). (* Quant *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Funty *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Leaf *)
  - constructor.                                       (* Stem *)
  - contradiction.                                 (* Fork *)
  - apply IHX. exact H.                            (* Asf *)
Qed.

Hint Resolve NF_subst NFQ_subst SF_subst SFQ_subst NF_lift NFQ_lift SF_lift SFQ_lift : preddb.

Lemma NF_NFQ : forall X, NF X -> NFQ X.
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; simpl; intros; auto; try contradiction;
  try (apply IHX; assumption).
Qed.
Lemma SF_SFQ : forall X, SF X -> SFQ X.
Proof.
  intro X. induction X; simpl; intros; auto; try contradiction;
  try (apply IHX; assumption).
Qed.

Lemma pred_sub : forall X Y, subtype X Y ->
  (NF X -> NF Y) /\ (NFQ X -> NFQ Y) /\
  (SF X -> SF Y) /\ (SFQ X -> SFQ Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction H; simpl in *; intuition; eauto with preddb.
  all: try (match goal with
            | H : NFQ ?X |- NF (subst ?X ?u) => apply (NFQ_subst_NF X H u)
            | H : SFQ ?X |- SF (subst ?X ?u) => apply (SFQ_subst_SF X H u)
            | H : NF ?X |- NFQ (lift 1 ?X) => apply NFQ_lift, NF_NFQ, H
            | H : SF ?X |- SFQ (lift 1 ?X) => apply SFQ_lift, SF_SFQ, H
            end).
Qed.

Lemma NF_sub : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> NF X -> NF Y.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (pred_sub _ _ H) H0). Qed.
Lemma NFQ_sub : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> NFQ X -> NFQ Y.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (pred_sub _ _ H)) H0). Qed.
Lemma SF_sub : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> SF X -> SF Y.
Proof. intros. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_sub _ _ H))) H0). Qed.
Lemma SFQ_sub : forall X Y, subtype X Y -> SFQ X -> SFQ Y.
Proof. intros. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (pred_sub _ _ H))) H0). Qed.

        Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a).

Note the exact indices: under the Quant binder lift uses cutoff 1, so the
relevant identity is subst_lift_rec_S at k=0 (equivalently
subst_lift_rec11).  These two commutation lemmas are what makes the
sub_dist case of D1/D2 go through.

1. WHY NAIVE INDUCTION FAILS; THE RIGHT CERTIFICATE
---------------------------------------------------
For D1 the derivation d : subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) has only two possible
last rules:
  (i)  sub_leaf_fun : immediate (Stem u <: Stem u);
  (ii) sub_trans d0 d2 with d0 : subtype Leaf X, d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty).
The middle X is arbitrary, so nothing is known about X from its shape.  The
same happens for D2 (middle reachable from Stem A).

The fix is a certificate indexed by the *derivation*, not merely by the
type.  Use a well-founded induction on derivation size (define
size : subtype S T -> nat by structural recursion; use lt_wf / Nat.lt_wf_rect)
and prove simultaneously:

  D1(d : subtype Leaf (Funty u ty))              -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  D2(A, d : subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty))       -> subtype (Fork A u) ty
  Comp1(d0 : subtype Leaf X) (d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty))
                                                 -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  Comp2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) X) (d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty))
                                                 -> subtype (Fork A u) ty
  and the quantifier-body invariants QInv1/QInv2 below.

Termination: every recursive call is on a strictly smaller derivation in the
global size measure.  In Comp's sub_trans case reassociate
  Comp d0 (sub_trans e1 e2)  :=  Comp (sub_trans d0 e1) e2
where the second derivation e2 is smaller.  The enlarged first derivation is
still smaller than the original top-level derivation (its two parts are
disjoint subtrees of it), so the outer well-founded hypothesis applies when
Comp's sub_zero/sub_funty cases call D1/D2 on it.  This is the only
implementation subtlety; it is a standard well-founded recursion.

2. CASE TABLE FOR Comp1  (d0 : Leaf <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
---------------------------------------------------------------
Invert the last rule of d2.  The only rules whose conclusion is a Funty are
sub_zero, sub_funty, sub_trans, sub_leaf_fun, sub_stem_fun, sub_dist,
sub_inst, sub_from_asf, sub_fork_leaf, sub_fork_stem, sub_fork_fork_*,
sub_recursion, sub_tree.  For each we need subtype (Stem u) ty:

* sub_zero (X = Funty u ty): call D1(d0); d0 is smaller than the original
  derivation.  [This is where the circular-looking base case is discharged.]
* sub_funty (X = Funty a b, u <: a, b <: ty):
    D1(d0) gives Stem a <: b; sub_stem(u<:a) + sub_trans + b<:ty.
* sub_trans (X <: Y <: Funty u ty): recurse Comp1(sub_trans d0 e1, e2).
* sub_leaf_fun (X = Leaf, target Funty a (Stem a)):
    Stem a <: Stem a by sub_zero (d0 is unused).
* sub_stem_fun (X = Stem B, target Funty v (Fork B v)):
    d0 : Leaf <: Stem B.  Impossible: nothing Stem-headed is above Leaf.
    Need lemma `no_leaf_stem : subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False`
    (prove by induction on the derivation of Leaf <: Stem B; use that every
    rule with conclusion subtype Leaf T has T = Leaf, Funty..., Quant Leaf,
    Asf Leaf, or is a trans whose right side is reached by one of these;
    a Stem target can only be produced by sub_stem/sub_quant_stem, which
    need a Stem/Quant(Stem) source, contradicting the IH).
    Same for sub_fork_* (no Leaf <: Fork...), sub_recursion/sub_tree
    (sources omega2_ty / the tree big Fork are Fork-headed).
* sub_dist (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (Quant a) (Quant b)):
    need subtype (Stem (Quant a)) (Quant b).
    The invariant QInv1(d0) below gives subtype (Stem a) b.
    Then quant_stem_comm : Stem (Quant a) <: Quant (Stem a),
    and sub_quant of the invariant gives Quant (Stem a) <: Quant b.
    sub_trans closes.  THIS IS THE CASE THAT NEEDS quant_stem_comm.
* sub_inst (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (subst a w) (subst b w)):
    need subtype (Stem (subst a w)) (subst b w).
    QInv1(d0) gives subtype (Stem a) b.  Substitution preserves subtyping
    (lemma subst_subtype below), so
      subtype (subst (Stem a) w) (subst b w)
    and subst distributes: subst (Stem a) w = Stem (subst a w).
    Closes with no lift identity needed.
* sub_from_asf (X = Asf (Funty a b), target Funty a b):
    need subtype (Stem a) b.  The Asf-invariant of d0 (section 4) gives it.
* sub_fork_leaf (X = Fork Leaf b, target Funty v b):
    d0 : Leaf <: Fork Leaf b is impossible (no Leaf <: Fork...).  Vacuous.

QInv1 (needed above):
  QInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Quant Z)) :=
      forall a b, subtype Z (Funty a b) -> subtype (Stem a) b.
  Prove by the same two-derivation induction (d0 is the left derivation; the
  second argument is a continuation out of Z).  Base cases:
    - d0 ends in sub_trans through Funty p q then sub_lift:
        Leaf <: Funty p (Stem p) <: Quant (Funty (lift p) (lift (Stem p))).
      The body is Funty (lift p) (Stem (lift p)); the continuation inversion
      (funty_src below) gives a <: lift p and Stem (lift p) <: b, hence
      Stem a <: Stem (lift p) <: b.
    - sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift continuations of Z: exactly the computations
      of section 2, with lifting/substitution preservation.
QInv1 uses no head parameter (the D1 companion is simply Stem a).

3. CASE TABLE FOR Comp2  (d0 : Stem A <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
------------------------------------------------------------------
* sub_zero: call D2(A, d0), d0 smaller.
* sub_funty (X = Funty a b, u <: a, b <: ty):
    D2(A,d0) : Fork A a <: b; sub_fork(u<:a) : Fork A u <: Fork A a;
    sub_trans.
* sub_trans: recurse Comp2(A, sub_trans d0 e1, e2).
* sub_leaf_fun (X = Leaf): d0 : Stem A <: Leaf impossible
    (below Leaf only Leaf; lemma `below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf`,
    proved by induction on the derivation: only sub_zero/sub_trans can end
    with right side Leaf).
* sub_stem_fun (X = Stem B, target Funty v (Fork B v)):
    d0 : Stem A <: Stem B.  Lemma `stem_inv : subtype (Stem A) (Stem B) ->
    subtype A B` (induction on the derivation; rules with conclusion
    Stem-headed are sub_zero, sub_stem, sub_quant_stem, sub_trans; the
    quant_stem case has a Quant(Stem) source, impossible for source Stem A
    unless A is quantified, handled by inversion).  Then sub_fork.
* sub_dist (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (Quant a) (Quant b)):
    need subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant b).
    QInv2(A,d0) below gives subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.
    fork_quant_comm gives Fork A (Quant a) <: Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a),
    and sub_quant of the invariant gives Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a) <: Quant b.
    sub_trans closes.  THIS IS THE CASE THAT NEEDS fork_quant_comm and the
    lift-1 head in the invariant.
* sub_inst (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (subst a w) (subst b w)):
    need subtype (Fork A (subst a w)) (subst b w).
    QInv2(A,d0) gives subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.  Substitution
    preservation gives subtype (subst (Fork (lift 1 A) a) w) (subst b w);
    subst distributes and subst (lift 1 A) w = A by subst_lift1, so this is
    exactly subtype (Fork A (subst a w)) (subst b w).
    THIS IS WHERE subst_lift1 is used.
* sub_from_asf: use the Asf-invariant (section 4).
* sub_fork_leaf/stem/fork_*: X Fork-headed; d0 : Stem A <: Fork ... is
    impossible (nothing Fork-headed is above Stem A except via trans whose
    final step needs a Fork/quantified-Fork source; prove
    `no_stem_fork : subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False` analogously to
    no_leaf_stem).  sub_recursion and sub_tree are the same (Fork sources).
    Vacuous.

QInv2 (needed above):
  QInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Quant Z)) :=
      forall a b, subtype Z (Funty a b) ->
                  subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.
  The head is lift 1 A, NOT A.  Base/closure:
    - Stem A <: Funty p (Fork A p) [sub_stem_fun], then sub_lift:
      body Z = Funty (lift p) (Fork (lift A) (lift p)); QInv2 conclusion is
      Fork (lift A) (lift p) <: Fork (lift A) (lift p) (sub_zero).  The
      continuation inversion gives a <: lift p and Fork (lift A) (lift p)
      <: b, then sub_fork(a<:lift p) + sub_trans.
    - sub_lift continuation: body becomes lift 1 Z; lifting preservation of
      subtype turns the earlier datum into the one with one more lift.
    - sub_dist continuation: use fork_quant_comm.
    - sub_inst continuation: use subst_lift1 exactly as in Comp2 above.
  The head lift 1 A is precisely the index that de Bruijn lifting puts on A
  when the derivation goes under a Quant binder; the two identities
  subst_lift1 / subst_lift_rec_S absorb the shift at the next elimination.

4. Asf (both D1 and D2)
-----------------------
The Asf rules are simple and do not create new function-type heads:
  sub_to_asf  : ty <: Asf ty
  sub_asf     : Asf a <: Asf b from a <: b
  sub_from_asf: Asf (Funty a b) <: Funty a b
For the certificate, pair each invariant with an Asf companion that is the
same datum transported through Asf:
  AsfInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Asf Z))  :=  QInv1-transported-to-Z
  AsfInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Asf Z)) := QInv2-transported-to-Z
with the rule sub_to_asf preserving the datum (the same companion subtype is
kept), sub_asf using the premise's invariant, and sub_from_asf applying the
invariant at the body Funty a b.  The only new obligation is:
  subtype (Asf (Funty a b)) (Funty a b) is an axiom (sub_from_asf), so the
  invariant at Z=Funty a b is consumed directly.
No new commutation identity is needed for Asf.

5. Funty-source inversion (used by the quantifier closures)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Lemma funty_src :
  forall a b u v, subtype (Funty a b) (Funty u v) ->
                  subtype u a /\ subtype b v.
Proof: two-derivation induction exactly like Comp, by the last rule of the
*second* derivation:
  sub_zero: refl both.
  sub_funty: premises give u <: c and d <: v; the first derivation gives
             c <: a and b <: d (recursive call on the smaller derivation
             into Funty c d); compose with sub_trans.
  sub_trans: reassociate as in section 1.
  Other rules cannot have a Funty source except through trans; when the
  second derivation's last rule has source Quant/Asf/Fork/etc., the first
  derivation's source Funty is related to it only through sub_lift/sub_to_asf

6. Preservation lemmas (standard de Bruijn metatheory)
------------------------------------------------------
subst_subtype :
  forall P Q w, subtype P Q -> subtype (subst P w) (subst Q w).
lift_subtype :
  forall P Q k n, subtype P Q -> subtype (lift_rec P k n) (lift_rec Q k n).
Prove by induction on the subtype derivation.  All rules are schematic, so
the only work is commuting subst/lift with the constructors:
  - sub_lift/sub_inst need
      subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X            (subst_lift_rec)
      subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X  (subst_lift_rec_S)
  - sub_inst needs the "subst commutes with subst under one binder" instance
    (two substitutions at different depths); prove the standard lemma
      subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 1) (subst ...) ...
    or avoid it by applying the induction hypothesis at the right instance.
Everything else is congruence (sub_stem/sub_fork/sub_asf/sub_funty/sub_quant
and the quantifier commutation rules are preserved verbatim by subst/lift,
because subst/lift recursively map constructors to the same constructors and
commute with Quant by incrementing the cutoff).

7. Additional easy shape lemmas used to kill impossible cases
-------------------------------------------------------------
below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf.
no_leaf_stem : subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False.
no_leaf_fork : subtype Leaf (Fork P Q) -> False.
no_stem_fork : subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False.
no_stem_leaf : subtype (Stem A) Leaf -> False  (from below_leaf).
stem_inv : subtype (Stem A) (Stem B) -> subtype A B.
All are proved by induction on the derivation plus inversion on the possible
last rules (which are syntactic: the constructors of the conclusion fix the
head of the source).  sub_trans is handled by applying the IH to the second
premise (whose source is the same head) and then to the first premise.

----------------

  strictly smaller derivations, and every case above is closed by an explicit
  rule or by a previously proved lemma.  The genuinely delicate points are
  only the de Bruijn shifts, and both have been pinned down:
      sub_inst (D1) : subst_lift1
      sub_inst (D2) : subst_lift1 (with the lift-1 head in QInv2)
      sub_dist (D1) : quant_stem_comm
      sub_dist (D2) : fork_quant_comm (with the lift-1 head in QInv2)
      sub_lift (both): lift_subtype + funty_src
- No counterexample to D1/D2 was found; the commutation computations above

- Implementation plan: in Task.v, define
    size_subtype : forall S T, subtype S T -> nat  (structural)

9. Machine-checked sub_dist closures (added to /tmp/sub/exp7.v)
--------------------------------------------------------------
These two corollaries are the exact steps used in the Comp1/Comp2 sub_dist
branches; they compile:

Lemma stem_quant_lift : forall a b,
  subtype (Stem a) b -> subtype (Stem (Quant a)) (Quant b).
Proof. intros a b H. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply quant_stem_comm.
  - apply sub_quant, H. Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_lift : forall A a b,
  subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b -> subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant b).
Proof. intros A a b H. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply fork_quant_comm.
  - apply sub_quant, H. Qed.

So the only remaining sub_dist obligation is: the invariant QInv1/QInv2 must
supply exactly the hypotheses of these corollaries (Stem a <: b, resp.
Fork (lift 1 A) a <: b).  That is precisely what the quantifier-body
invariants in sections 2-3 state, and it is why the D2 invariant must carry
lift 1 A.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Inductive derive: list (string * dtype) -> Tree -> dtype -> Prop :=
| derive_ref : forall gamma x uty ty, get x gamma = Some uty -> subtype uty ty -> derive gamma (Ref x) ty
| derive_node : forall gamma uty, subtype Leaf uty -> derive gamma Node uty
| derive_app: forall gamma M N ty u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) -> derive gamma N u -> derive gamma (M@N) ty
.
====
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* A small hint database for the subtyping and typing rules. *)
Create HintDb triage.

Hint Constructors subtype : triage.
Hint Constructors derive : triage.
Hint Constructors program : triage.

(* Applications of a leaf and of a stem. *)
Lemma subtype_leaf_app: forall A u ty,
  subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype A u ->
  subtype (Stem A) ty.
Proof.
  intros. eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_app: forall A B u ty,
  subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype B u ->
  subtype (Fork A B) ty.
Proof.
  intros. eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Hint Resolve subtype_leaf_app subtype_stem_app : triage.

(* A typing of a stem at a function type is principal at the
   corresponding stem type. *)
Lemma stem_fun_principal: forall M gamma u ty,
  program M ->
  (forall gamma ty, derive gamma M ty -> subtype (program_type M) ty) ->
  derive gamma (Node @ M) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype (Stem (program_type M)) (Funty u ty).
Proof.
  intros M gamma u ty Hp IH Hd.
  inversion Hd; subst.
  inversion H3; subst.
  pose proof (IH _ _ H5) as HA.
  eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Hint Resolve stem_fun_principal : triage.

Theorem programs_have_types: forall p gamma, program p -> derive gamma p (program_type p).
Proof.
  intros p gamma Hp. induction Hp.
  - simpl. eauto 10 with triage.
  - simpl. eauto 12 with triage.
  - simpl. eauto 20 with triage.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_principal_types:
  forall p, program p ->
            forall gamma ty, derive gamma p ty -> subtype (program_type p) ty.
Proof.
  intros p Hp. induction Hp; intros gamma ty Hd.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst. eauto with triage.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst. inversion H3; subst.
    pose proof (IHHp _ _ H5) as HA.
    eauto 15 with triage.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst.
    pose proof (IHHp1 _ _ H5) as HM.
    pose proof (IHHp2 _ _ H4) as HN.
    eauto 20 with triage.
Qed.
====

========================================================================

11. Why the closure hypotheses are NOT a complete proof of D1
==============================================================
The hypotheses of d1_reduction.v/d2_reduction.v are:
  Good_lift  : Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)
  Good_subst : Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)
and their Funty instances are exactly preservation of subtype under
lift/subst for a datum H : subtype (Stem a) b (D1) / Fork A a <: b (D2).

Good_lift is plausible and is equivalent to lift_subtype (for arbitrary P,Q):
lifting is a pure renaming, maps Var 0 to Var 0 or Var n (n>0), never creates
a new free Var 0, so covariant ty stays covariant.  The sub_tree case should
be closed with ty' = shift_free ty k n, where shift_free maps free Var i to
Var i for i <= k and to Var i+n for i >= k+1 (not a plain lift!), plus
lift/subst commutation lemmas.  sub_recursion is trivial because omega2_ty,
omega21_ty, omega22_ty are Var-free (program_type never contains Var).

Good_subst is the dangerous one.  It would require subst_subtype for arbitrary
P,Q and arbitrary cutoff k.  The sub_tree case is not obviously preserved:
the outer substitution can hit free variables of ty, and the same free
variable of ty is represented differently in the three components of the
sub_tree source, so the substituted source need not be an instance of
sub_tree again.  Concretely, ty = Funty (Var 1) Leaf, uty = Var 0,
k = 0, w = Funty (Var 0) Leaf turns the substituted source into
  Fork (Fork (Funty (Funty Var0 Leaf) Leaf) A2') A3'
which is not E(ty'') for any ty'' (the first component has a free Var0,
while subst ty'' Leaf never has a free Var0).  It is, however, an instance of
sub_fork_fork_leaf when uty = Leaf; for uty = Var 0 the domain of the
substituted target is Funty Var0 Leaf, so none of the fork_* rules applies
directly.  A derivation could still exist through the Quant/lift equivalence
X ~ Quant (lift X) (which can hide a free Var0 under a Quant), so this is not
a proof that Good_subst is false -- but it shows that a syntactic preservation
proof of Good_subst is at least as hard as the tree-rule analysis, and that
the type-indexed certificate alone is not yet a proof of D1/D2.

Conclusion: d1_reduction.v/d2_reduction.v are a complete, machine-checked
*reduction* and a very compact case analysis, but do NOT claim they finish
D1/D2 until Good_lift/Good_subst are proved.  In particular Good_subst should
not be used in Task.v.

12. Refined primary route: pair-induction on (d : Leaf <: X, e : X <: Funty)
=============================================================================
A direct proof of D1 that avoids arbitrary substitution closure:

  P(d, e) := for d : subtype Leaf X and e : subtype X (Funty u ty),
             subtype (Stem u) ty.

Prove P by well-founded induction on the lexicographic pair
(size e, size d).  Then:
  - e = sub_leaf_fun: ty = Stem u, goal Stem u <: Stem u.
  - e = sub_trans e1 e2 (X <: Y <: Funty): apply the IH to
    (sub_trans d e1 : Leaf <: Y, e2).  e2 is a proper subderivation, so the
    first component strictly decreases: no need to analyze d.
  - e = sub_zero: X = Funty u ty and the goal is D1 for d itself.  Analyze
    the last rule of d : Leaf <: Funty u ty:
       sub_zero impossible (Leaf <> Funty);
       sub_leaf_fun: ty = Stem u, goal Stem u <: Stem u;
       sub_trans d1 d2: apply the IH to (d1 : Leaf <: Y, sub_zero :
           Funty u ty <: Funty u ty) for d2 : Y <: Funty u ty; e is the same
           sub_zero but d2 is a proper subderivation of d, so the second
           component strictly decreases.
       sub_lift target Quant, sub_to_asf target Asf: impossible.
    This is the key well-founded descent that replaces a circular D1 call.
  - e = sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 (X = Funty u1 v1):
       apply the IH to (d, sub_zero (Funty u1 v1)) to get Stem u1 <: v1
       (legal: e' = sub_zero has size 1 < size e when e is sub_funty);
       then sub_stem d1 : Stem u2 <: Stem u1 and trans twice with d2.
  - e = sub_from_asf: X = Asf (Funty a b), target Funty a b.  d : Leaf <:
       Asf (Funty a b).  Need Stem a <: b.  Use d and sub_from_asf?  The
       pair (d, sub_from_asf) has e with no premise; instead use the IH on
       (d, sub_zero (Funty a b))?  That requires d : Leaf <: Funty a b,
       which we do not have.  Need an inversion on d : Leaf <: Asf (...):
       derive Leaf <: Funty a b (using sub_lift/sub_inst/quant_asf rules),
       then apply the sub_zero case.
  - e = sub_dist: X = Quant (Funty u v), target Funty (Quant u)(Quant v).
       Need Stem (Quant u) <: Quant v.  Analyze d : Leaf <: Quant (Funty u v)
       (invert sub_lift / sub_quant / sub_inst chains), extract a derivation
       Leaf <: Funty u' v' with u = Quant u'?  then apply sub_zero case and
       stem_quant_lift.  This is the exact place where the Quant-body
       invariant (QInv1) is needed.
  - e = sub_inst: X = Quant ty, target Funty-headed subst ty u.  Analyze d :
       Leaf <: Quant ty; the reachable Quant bodies from Leaf are lifts of
       reachable bodies (from sub_lift) or Quant(Funty...) forms (sub_dist);
       hence subst ty u reduces by subst_lift1, giving the required datum.
  - e = fork rules/tree/recursion: X is Fork-headed; show no derivation
       Leaf <: Fork-headed type exists (shape lemma no_leaf_fork, provable
       directly by induction on the derivation: only sub_trans, sub_lift,
       sub_to_asf, sub_leaf_fun can start a Leaf-sourced derivation, and
       their targets are Leaf/Funty/Quant/Asf; all other rules have
       Stem/Fork/Asf/Quant sources).  Then these e cases are vacuous.

The only non-shape work is in the last four bullets (from_asf, dist, inst,
and the quant-body inversion of d).  This is exactly the Comp/QInv content
of sections 2-3; the pair-induction above is the cleanest top-level
formulation and removes the need for a mutual Comp1/Comp2 recursion.
The shape lemma no_leaf_fork is the key to killing tree/recursion/fork cases.

- /tmp/sub/d1_reduction.v, /tmp/sub/d2_reduction.v: verified conditional

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.

(* Spine predicates: where the constructor spine (through Quant/Asf) ends. *)
Fixpoint SpineL (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant Z => SpineL Z
  | Asf Z => SpineL Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Fixpoint SpineS (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Stem _ => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Quant Z => SpineS Z
  | Asf Z => SpineS Z
  | Leaf => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma SpineL_subst : forall ty u k, SpineL ty -> SpineL (subst_rec ty u k).
Proof.
  induction ty; intros u k H; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHty. exact H.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHty. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma SpineL_lift : forall ty k n, SpineL ty -> SpineL (lift_rec ty k n).
Proof.
  induction ty; intros k n H; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHty. exact H.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHty. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma SpineS_subst : forall ty u k, SpineS ty -> SpineS (subst_rec ty u k).
Proof.
  induction ty; intros u k H; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHty. exact H.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHty. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma SpineS_lift : forall ty k n, SpineS ty -> SpineS (lift_rec ty k n).
Proof.
  induction ty; intros k n H; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHty. exact H.
  - (* Funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHty. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma SpineL_stable : forall S T, subtype S T -> SpineL S -> SpineL T.
Proof.
  intros S T d. induction d; intros H; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact H.
  - (* trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, H.
  - (* stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* quant_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* quant_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact H.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) unfold subst. apply SpineL_subst. exact H.
  - (* lift *) unfold lift. apply SpineL_lift. exact H.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* stem_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* recursion *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* tree *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* to_asf *) exact H.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma SpineS_stable : forall S T, subtype S T -> SpineS S -> SpineS T.
Proof.
  intros S T d. induction d; intros H; simpl in *.
  - (* zero *) exact H.
  - (* trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, H.
  - (* stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* funty *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* quant_stem *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* quant_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* quant_asf *) exact H.
  - (* dist *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* inst *) unfold subst. apply SpineS_subst. exact H.
  - (* lift *) unfold lift. apply SpineS_lift. exact H.
  - (* leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* stem_fun *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* recursion *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* tree *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* to_asf *) exact H.
  - (* from_asf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma no_leaf_stem : forall B, subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False.
Proof.
  intros B d. pose proof (SpineL_stable Leaf (Stem B) d Logic.I) as H.
  simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma no_leaf_fork : forall P Q, subtype Leaf (Fork P Q) -> False.
Proof.
  intros P Q d. pose proof (SpineL_stable Leaf (Fork P Q) d Logic.I) as H.
  simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma no_leaf_var : forall n, subtype Leaf (Var n) -> False.
Proof.
  intros n d. pose proof (SpineL_stable Leaf (Var n) d Logic.I) as H.
  simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma no_stem_fork : forall A P Q, subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False.
Proof.
  intros A P Q d. pose proof (SpineS_stable (Stem A) (Fork P Q) d Logic.I) as H.
  simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma no_stem_leaf : forall A, subtype (Stem A) Leaf -> False.
Proof.
  intros A d. pose proof (SpineS_stable (Stem A) Leaf d Logic.I) as H.
  simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma no_stem_var : forall A n, subtype (Stem A) (Var n) -> False.
Proof.
  intros A n d. pose proof (SpineS_stable (Stem A) (Var n) d Logic.I) as H.
  simpl in H. exact H.
Qed.

(* The reachable targets from Leaf keep the same Quant/Asf spine ending in
   Leaf or Funty; the reachable targets from Stem end in Stem or Funty. *)
Lemma leaf_reach_spine : forall T, subtype Leaf T -> SpineL T.
Proof. intros T d. apply (SpineL_stable Leaf T d Logic.I). Qed.
Lemma stem_reach_spine : forall A T, subtype (Stem A) T -> SpineS T.
Proof. intros A T d. apply (SpineS_stable (Stem A) T d Logic.I). Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Type-valued mirror of subtype, used for derivation analysis. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive subT : dtype -> dtype -> Type :=
| subT_zero : forall ty, subT ty ty
| subT_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subT ty1 ty2 -> subT ty2 ty3 -> subT ty1 ty3
| subT_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subT uty1 uty2 -> subT (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| subT_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2,
    subT uty1 uty2 -> subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| subT_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subT uty1 uty2 -> subT (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| subT_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2,
    subT uty2 uty1 -> subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| subT_quant : forall vty1 vty2, subT vty1 vty2 -> subT (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)
| subT_quant_stem: forall uty, subT (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| subT_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subT (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| subT_quant_asf: forall uty, subT (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| subT_dist: forall uty vty, subT (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| subT_inst : forall ty u, subT (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| subT_lift: forall ty, subT ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))
| subT_leaf_fun:forall uty, subT Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| subT_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subT (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))
| subT_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subT (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| subT_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subT (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)
| subT_fork_fork_leaf: forall uty vty wty,
    subT (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty) (Funty Leaf uty)
| subT_fork_fork_stem:
    forall uty vty1 vty2 wty,
      subT (Fork (Fork uty (Funty vty1 vty2)) wty) (Funty (Stem vty1) vty2)
| subT_fork_fork_fork:
    forall uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3,
      subT (Fork (Fork uty vty) (Funty wty1 (Funty wty2 wty3))) (Funty (Fork wty1 wty2) wty3)
| subT_recursion:
    forall k uty vty,
      subT omega2_ty
              (Funty
                 omega2_ty
                 (Funty
                    (Funty (quant k (Funty uty vty)) (quant k (Funty uty vty)))
                    (quant k (Funty uty vty))))
| subT_tree: forall ty uty,
    covariant ty ->
    subT (Fork
               (Fork
                  (subst ty Leaf)
                  (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
               (quant
                  2
                  (Funty
                     (Var 1)
                     (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))
            ))
            (Funty uty (subst ty uty))
| subT_to_asf: forall ty, subT ty (Asf ty)
| subT_from_asf: forall uty vty, subT (Asf (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty vty)
| subT_bffs: forall uty vty,
    subT (Fork (Stem (bffs_aug uty)) (Asf vty)) (Asf (Fork (Stem uty) vty))
| subT_bfff : forall uty vty wty,
    subT (Fork (Fork uty (Asf vty)) (bfff_aug wty))
         (Asf (Fork (Fork uty vty) wty)).

Lemma subT_subtype : forall X Y, subT X Y -> subtype X Y.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Proof. intros. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_same. Qed.

  j <= K ->

  lift_rec (insert_Var w i K) j n.

  intros w i j K n HjK.

  destruct (compare K i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
  - (* K < i: insert = Var (pred i) *)
    assert (Hji : j <= i) by lia.
    destruct (test j i) as [hji|hji].
    + (* relocate = n+i *)
      assert (Hcmp : K+n < n+i) by lia.
      destruct (compare (K+n) (n+i)) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * simpl. unfold relocate. rewrite Hji. reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - (* K = i: insert = lift K w *)
    subst i.
    destruct (test j K) as [hjK|hjK].
