      assert (Hcmp : K+n = n+K) by lia.
      destruct (compare (K+n) (n+K)) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * unfold lift. rewrite Hcmp. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.

    assert (Hij : i < K) by lia.

      assert (Hcmp : i+n < K+n) by lia.

      * exfalso; lia.

  subst_rec (lift_rec X j n) w (K+n) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec X w K) j n.

  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHX; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHX1; assumption | apply IHX2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHX1; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHX1; assumption | apply IHX2; assumption].
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHX. lia.
Qed.

  j <= K ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec X j m) (K+m) n =
  lift_rec (lift_rec X K n) j m.
Proof.
  induction X; intros j K m n HjK; simpl.
  - (* Var *)
    unfold relocate.
    destruct (test j n0) as [hj|hj].
    + (* first shift: n0+m *)
      assert (Hn : j <= n0 + m) by lia.
      destruct (test (K+m) (n0+m)) as [h1|h1].
      * (* n0+m >= K+m, so n0 >= K *)
        assert (HKn : K <= n0) by lia.
        destruct (test K n0) as [h2|h2].
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + (* n0 < j *)
      assert (Hn : n0 < K) by lia.
      destruct (test (K+m) n0) as [h1|h1].
      * (* n0 >= K+m impossible *)
        exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test K n0) as [h2|h2].
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- destruct (test j n0) as [h3|h3].
           ++ exfalso; lia.
           ++ reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHX; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHX1; assumption | apply IHX2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHX1; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHX1; assumption | apply IHX2; assumption].
  - (* Quant *) simpl. f_equal. apply IHX; lia.
Qed.

(* ---------- E_n ---------- *)

Lemma lift_subst_gen : forall X u K n,
  lift_rec (subst_rec X u 0) K n =
  subst_rec (lift_rec X (S K) n) (lift_rec u K n) 0.
Proof.
  induction X; intros u K n; simpl.
  - (* Var *)
    unfold relocate. unfold insert_Var. unfold lift.
    destruct (test 0 n0) as [h0|h0].
    + (* 0 <= n0 always; first term *)
      assert (H0 : 0 <= n0) by lia.
      destruct (test (S K) n0) as [h1|h1].
      * (* n0 >= S K *)
        assert (Hcmp : K <= relocate n0 0 n) by (unfold relocate; lia).
        (* goal: Var (relocate (relocate n0 0 n) K n?) ... *)
        admit.
      * admit.
    + exfalso; lia.
Admitted.

cat > /tmp/new/ids.v <<'EOF'
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes Triage.derive.
Open Scope string_scope. Open Scope nat_scope. Open Scope tree_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* ---------- pointwise Var helpers ---------- *)

Lemma relocate_lift_gen : forall ii bb kk jj nn,
  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
  relocate (relocate ii bb kk) jj nn = relocate ii bb (kk+nn).
Proof.
  intros ii bb kk jj nn Hbj HbK.
  unfold relocate.
  destruct (test bb ii) as [h1|h1].
  - (* bb <= ii, inner index ii+kk *)
    assert (Hik : bb <= ii + kk) by lia.
    destruct (test jj (ii+kk)) as [h2|h2].
    + (* outer shifts by nn *)
      f_equal; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - (* bb > ii, inner index ii *)
    assert (Hii : ii < jj) by lia.
    destruct (test jj ii) as [h2|h2].
    + exfalso; lia.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lift_subst : forall ii kk nn,
  relocate (relocate ii 0 nn) kk nn = relocate ii 0 nn.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test 0 ii) as [h0|h0].
  - (* 0<=ii : inner ii+nn *)
    destruct (test kk (ii+nn)) as [h1|h1].
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma lift_insert_zero : forall uu ii kk nn,
  lift_rec (insert_Var uu ii 0) kk nn =
  insert_Var (lift_rec uu kk nn) (relocate ii (S kk) nn) 0.
Proof.
  intros uu ii kk nn.
  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  destruct (compare 0 ii) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
  - (* 0 < ii : Var (pred ii) *)
    assert (Hii : 0 < ii) by lia.
    destruct (test (S kk) ii) as [hSK|hSK].
    + (* index ii+nn *)
      assert (Hpos : 0 < ii+nn) by lia.
      destruct (compare 0 (ii+nn)) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * (* relocate (ii-1) kk nn = ii-1+nn because ii-1 >= kk *)
        assert (Hik : kk <= ii - 1) by lia.
        destruct (test kk (ii-1)) as [h4|h4]; [f_equal; lia | exfalso; lia].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + (* index ii *)
      assert (Hlt : ii <= kk) by lia.
      destruct (compare 0 ii) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * (* ii-1 < kk *)
        assert (Hik : ii - 1 < kk) by lia.
        destruct (test kk (ii-1)) as [h4|h4]; [exfalso; lia | f_equal; lia].
      * f_equal; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
  - (* 0 = ii; insert = uu *)
    subst ii.
    destruct (test (S kk) 0) as [hSK|hSK].
    + (* relocate 0 (S kk) nn = 0+nn = nn *)
      destruct (compare 0 nn) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * (* lift 0 (lift uu kk nn) = lift uu kk nn *)
        unfold lift. rewrite h2. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_0.
      * f_equal; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma insert_lift_gen : forall ww ii jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  insert_Var ww (relocate ii jj nn) (kk+nn) =
  lift_rec (insert_Var ww ii kk) jj nn.
Proof.
  intros ww ii jj kk nn Hjk.
  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  destruct (compare kk ii) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
  - (* kk < ii: insert = Var (pred ii) *)
    assert (Hji : jj <= ii) by lia.
    destruct (test jj ii) as [hji|hji].
    + (* relocate = nn+ii *)
      assert (Hcmp : kk+nn < nn+ii) by lia.
      destruct (compare (kk+nn) (nn+ii)) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * (* need relocate (ii-1) jj nn = ii-1+nn *)
        assert (Hik : jj <= ii - 1) by lia.
        destruct (test jj (ii-1)) as [h4|h4]; [f_equal; lia | exfalso; lia].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - (* kk = ii: insert = lift kk ww *)
    subst ii.
    destruct (test jj kk) as [hjk|hjk].
    + (* relocate = nn+kk *)
      assert (Hcmp : kk+nn = nn+kk) by lia.
      destruct (compare (kk+nn) (nn+kk)) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * unfold lift. rewrite Hcmp. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - (* kk > ii: insert = Var ii *)
    assert (Hii : ii < kk) by lia.
    destruct (test jj ii) as [hji|hji].
    + (* relocate = nn+ii *)
      assert (Hcmp : ii+nn < kk+nn) by lia.
      destruct (compare (kk+nn) (ii+nn)) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test jj ii) as [h4|h4]; [f_equal; lia | exfalso; lia].
    + (* relocate = ii *)
      assert (Hcmp : ii < kk+nn) by lia.
      destruct (compare (kk+nn) ii) as [[h1|h2]|h3].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test jj ii) as [h4|h4]; [exfalso; lia | f_equal; lia].
Qed.

(* ---------- identities ---------- *)

Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall ww bb kk jj nn,
  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec ww bb kk) jj nn = lift_rec ww bb (kk+nn).
Proof.
  induction ww; intros bb kk jj nn Hbj HbK; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_gen; assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHww; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHww1; assumption | apply IHww2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHww1; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHww1; assumption | apply IHww2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHww; lia.
Qed.

Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_same : forall ww bb kk nn,
  lift_rec (lift_rec ww bb kk) bb nn = lift_rec ww bb (kk+nn).
Proof. intros. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia. Qed.

Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall ww kk nn,
  lift_rec (lift_rec ww 0 kk) 0 nn = lift_rec ww 0 (kk+nn).
Proof. intros. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_same. Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_gen : forall XX ww jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX jj nn) ww (kk+nn) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec XX ww kk) jj nn.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros ww jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
  - apply insert_lift_gen; assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHXX1; assumption | apply IHXX2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX1; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHXX1; assumption | apply IHXX2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX. lia.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall XX jj kk mm nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX jj mm) (kk+mm) nn =
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX kk nn) jj mm.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros jj kk mm nn Hjk; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_gen; lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHXX1; assumption | apply IHXX2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX1; assumption.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHXX1; assumption | apply IHXX2; assumption].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX; lia.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_gen : forall XX uu kk nn,
  lift_rec (subst_rec XX uu 0) kk nn =
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX (S kk) nn) (lift_rec uu kk nn) 0.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros uu kk nn; simpl.
  - apply lift_insert_zero.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHXX1 | apply IHXX2].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX1.
  - simpl. f_equal; [apply IHXX1 | apply IHXX2].
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IHXX.
Qed.
EOF

- /tmp/sub/shapes2.v
  - SpineL (Leaf/Funty true, Quant/Asf recurse, Stem/Fork/Var false) and SpineS (Stem/Funty true, Quant/Asf recurse, Leaf/Fork/Var false) are stable along subtype.
  - Proved: no_leaf_stem, no_leaf_fork, no_leaf_var, no_stem_fork, no_stem_leaf, no_stem_var, leaf_reach_spine, stem_reach_spine.
  - Consequence: every intermediate X reachable as Leaf <: X is Leaf, Funty, Quant(Z) with SpineL Z, or Asf(Z) with SpineL Z; no Fork/Stem/Var intermediate ever occurs. This kills the fork/tree/recursion/bffs/bfff/stem_fun cases in the derivation analysis.
- /tmp/sub/below_leaf_check.v
  - The planned shape lemma below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf is FALSE. Counterexample: subtype (Quant (Var 0)) Leaf via sub_inst, since subst (Var 0) Leaf = Leaf. Do not use below_leaf; no_stem_leaf is the true replacement.
- /tmp/sub/exp7.v remains the verified de Bruijn/commutation library (subst_lift_rec, subst_lift_rec_S, subst_lift1, quant_stem_comm, fork_quant_comm, stem_quant_lift, fork_quant_lift).
- /tmp/sub/d1_reduction.v and /tmp/sub/d2_reduction.v compile and give a complete 26-rule case analysis reducing D1/D2 to two closure properties Good_lift/Good_subst. Caveat: these are conditional reductions, not proofs. Good_lift is plausible (lifting is a renaming and preserves covariance). Good_subst is the danger: its Funty instance is subst preservation for arbitrary sources/cutoffs, and the sub_tree case is not syntactically stable. Do not add these as axioms.

Key negative finding
- The naive lift-after-subst law
  lift_rec (subst_rec ty u j) k n = subst_rec (lift_rec ty (S k) n) (lift_rec u k n) j
  is FALSE. Counterexample: ty = Quant (Var 1), u = Var 0, j = 0, k = 1, n = 1 gives Quant (Var 1) vs Quant (Var 0). So the sub_inst case of lift_subtype needs either a simultaneous substitution/renaming or a direct target-shape case analysis (sub_quant / sub_inst / sub_quant_stem/fork/asf / sub_dist), not a single-term commutation.

Where D1/D2 stand
- No counterexample to D1 or D2 was found; all checked instances are true, including Leaf <: Funty (Quant (lift b)) (Quant (Stem (lift b))), whose D1 conclusion is exactly the machine-checked quant_stem_comm.
- Cleanest remaining route (notes section 12): well-founded pair induction on (d : Leaf <: X, e : X <: Funty u ty). The trans and sub_zero cases are handled by descending on the second or first derivation; sub_funty reduces to the sub_zero case with a strictly smaller e; all Fork/Stem/Var source cases are vacuous by shapes2.v. The only genuinely hard cases are Quant/Asf intermediates (sub_dist, sub_inst, sub_from_asf), where the QInv1/QInv2 invariants from notes sections 2-3 are required. The only admissibility lemma the Comp route actually needs is lift_subtype (used in the sub_lift branch); its sub_inst case needs the careful commutation/case analysis above.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes Triage.derive.

  repeat match goal with
  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
  end;

Lemma relocate_lift_gen : forall ii bb kk jj nn,
  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
  relocate (relocate ii bb kk) jj nn = relocate ii bb (kk+nn).
Proof. intros. unfold relocate. crush_tests. Qed.

Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall ww bb kk jj nn,
  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec ww bb kk) jj nn = lift_rec ww bb (kk+nn).
Proof.
  induction ww; intros bb kk jj nn Hbj HbK; simpl.
  - (* Var *) f_equal. apply relocate_lift_gen; assumption.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply (IHww (S bb) kk (S jj) nn); lia.

  - (* Fork *) f_equal; [ apply (IHww1 bb kk jj nn); assumption | apply (IHww2 bb kk jj nn); assumption ].

  lift_rec (lift_rec ww 0 kk) 0 nn = lift_rec ww 0 (kk+nn).
Proof. intros. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia. Qed.

  jj <= kk ->
  insert_Var ww (relocate ii jj nn) (kk+nn) =
  lift_rec (insert_Var ww ii kk) jj nn.

  unfold insert_Var, relocate.

Qed.

Lemma lift_insert_gen : forall uu ii jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (insert_Var uu ii jj) kk nn =
  insert_Var (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) (relocate ii (S kk) nn) jj.
Proof.
  intros uu ii jj kk nn Hjk.
  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  repeat match goal with
  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
  end.
  all: try reflexivity.
  all: try (rewrite !lift_zero; reflexivity).
  all: try (rewrite (lift_rec_zero uu 0); rewrite (lift_rec_zero (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) 0); reflexivity).
  all: try (unfold lift; cbn [lift_rec relocate]; crush_tests).
  all: try (cbn [lift_rec]; unfold relocate; crush_tests).
  all: try (unfold lift; exact (lift_lift_subst_gen uu 0 jj kk nn Hjk)).
Qed.

(* 6. B_gen: substitution into a lifted term *)
Lemma subst_lift_gen : forall XX ww jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX jj nn) ww (kk+nn) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec XX ww kk) jj nn.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros ww jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
  - apply insert_lift_gen; assumption.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww (S jj) (S kk) nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 ww jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 ww jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww jj kk nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 ww jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 ww jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww jj kk nn); assumption.
Qed.

(* 7. C_gen: swapping two lifts *)
Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall XX jj kk mm nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX jj mm) (kk+mm) nn =
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX kk nn) jj mm.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros jj kk mm nn Hjk; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_gen; lia.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX (S jj) (S kk) mm nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 jj kk mm nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 jj kk mm nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX jj kk mm nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 jj kk mm nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 jj kk mm nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX jj kk mm nn); assumption.
Qed.

(* 8. J: generalized lift of a substitution *)
Lemma lift_subst_gen : forall XX uu jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (subst_rec XX uu jj) kk nn =
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX (S kk) nn) (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) jj.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros uu jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
  - apply lift_insert_gen; assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace ((S kk) - (S jj)) with (kk - jj) by lia.
    apply (IHXX uu (S jj) (S kk) nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu jj kk nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu jj kk nn); assumption.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Open Scope nat_scope.

Lemma lift_omega2_ty : forall c d, lift_rec omega2_ty c d = omega2_ty.
Proof.
  intros. unfold omega2_ty, omega21_ty, omega22_ty. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_quant : forall n X c d,
  lift_rec (quant n X) c d = quant n (lift_rec X (c+n) d).
Proof.
  induction n; intros X c d; simpl.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
  - replace (c + S n) with (S (c+n)) by lia.
    apply IHn.
Qed.

Lemma lift_eval_ty : forall c d, lift_rec eval_ty c d = eval_ty.
Proof. intros. unfold eval_ty. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_eager_ty : forall c d, lift_rec eager_ty c d = eager_ty.
Proof. intros. unfold eager_ty. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma lift_bfff_aug : forall uty c d,
  lift_rec (bfff_aug uty) c d = bfff_aug (lift_rec uty c d).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bfff_aug. cbn [lift_rec]. rewrite lift_eval_ty. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_bffs_aug : forall uty c d,
  lift_rec (bffs_aug uty) c d = bffs_aug (lift_rec uty c d).
Proof.
  intros. unfold bffs_aug. cbn [lift_rec]. rewrite lift_eager_ty. cbn [lift_rec].
  rewrite lift_bfff_aug. reflexivity.
Qed.
=====LIFTLEMMAS
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types.
Open Scope nat_scope.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i a K j n, j <= K ->
  relocate (relocate i a j) (K+a) n =
  relocate (relocate i (K+a-j) n) a j.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test a i) as [ha|ha]; cbn.
  - destruct (test (K+a-j) i) as [hb|hb]; cbn.
    + destruct (test a (n+i)) as [h1|h1]; cbn.
      2: exfalso; lia.
      destruct (test (K+a) (j+i)) as [h2|h2]; cbn.
      2: exfalso; lia.
      lia.
    + destruct (test (K+a) (j+i)) as [h2|h2]; cbn.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test a i) as [ha2|ha2]; cbn.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exfalso; lia.
  - assert (K+a-j > i) by lia.
    destruct (test (K+a-j) i) as [hb|hb]; cbn.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + destruct (test (K+a) i) as [h2|h2]; cbn.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test a i) as [ha2|ha2]; cbn.
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall N a K j n, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec N a j) (K + a) n =
  lift_rec (lift_rec N (K + a - j) n) a j.
Proof.
  induction N; intros a K j m H; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_lift. assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace (S (K + a)) with (K + S a) by lia.
    replace (S (K + a - j)) with (K + S a - j) by lia.
    apply IHN. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN1. assumption. apply IHN2. assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHN. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN1. assumption. apply IHN2. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_0 : forall N K j n, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 j) K n =
  lift_rec (lift_rec N (K - j) n) 0 j.
Proof.
  intros. pose proof (lift_lift_gen N 0 K j n H) as Hll.
  replace (K + 0) with K in Hll by lia.
  replace (K + 0 - j) with (K - j) in Hll by lia.
  exact Hll.
Qed.


Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate. destruct (test k i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, i < k -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate. destruct (test k i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - exfalso; lia.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_lt : forall N i j, j < i -> insert_Var N i j = Var (pred i).
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, compare. destruct (test j i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - destruct (le_lt j i h) as [hlt|heq]; cbn.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma insert_eq : forall N i, insert_Var N i i = lift i N.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, compare. destruct (test i i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - destruct (le_lt i i h) as [hlt|heq]; cbn.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma insert_gt : forall N i j, i < j -> insert_Var N i j = Var i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, compare. destruct (test j i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - destruct (le_lt j i h) as [hlt|heq]; cbn; exfalso; lia.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_insert_gen : forall N i j K n, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (insert_Var N i j) K n =
  insert_Var (lift_rec N (K-j) n) (relocate i (S K) n) j.
Proof.
  intros N i j K n H.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec j i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
  - (* j < i *)
    rewrite (insert_lt N i j hlt).
    destruct i as [|i'].
    + exfalso; lia.
    + cbn.
      destruct (le_lt_dec (S K) (S i')) as [hSK|hSK].
      * assert (hKI : K <= i') by lia.
        rewrite (relocate_ge (S i') (S K) n hSK).
        assert (hji : j < n + S i') by lia.
        rewrite (insert_lt (lift_rec N (K - j) n) (n + S i') j hji).
        rewrite (relocate_ge i' K n hKI).
        f_equal. lia.
      * assert (hKS : S i' < S K) by lia.
        rewrite (relocate_lt (S i') (S K) n hKS).
        rewrite (insert_lt (lift_rec N (K - j) n) (S i') j hlt).
        assert (hiK : i' < K) by lia.
        rewrite (relocate_lt i' K n hiK).
        reflexivity.
  - (* j = i *)
    subst j. rewrite (insert_eq N i).
    assert (hiSK : i < S K) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (S K) n hiSK).
    rewrite (insert_eq (lift_rec N (K - i) n) i).
    unfold lift. apply lift_lift_0. assumption.
  - (* i < j *)
    rewrite (insert_gt N i j hgt).
    assert (hiSK : i < S K) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (S K) n hiSK).
    rewrite (insert_gt (lift_rec N (K - j) n) i j hgt).
    cbn.
    assert (hiK : i < K) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i K n hiK).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_rec_U : forall M N j K m, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (subst_rec M N j) K m =
  subst_rec (lift_rec M (S K) m) (lift_rec N (K - j) m) j.
Proof.
  induction M; intros N j K m H; simpl.
  - apply lift_insert_gen. assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace (K - j) with (S K - S j) by lia.
    apply IHM. lia.
  - f_equal. apply IHM1. assumption. apply IHM2. assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHM. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHM1. assumption. apply IHM2. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHM. assumption.
Qed.

  lift_rec (lift_rec N (K + a - j) n) a j.
Proof.
  induction N; intros a K j m H; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_lift. assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace (S (K + a)) with (K + S a) by lia.
    replace (S (K + a - j)) with (K + S a - j) by lia.
    apply IHN. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN1. assumption. apply IHN2. assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHN. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN1. assumption. apply IHN2. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_0 : forall N K j n, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 j) K n =
  lift_rec (lift_rec N (K - j) n) 0 j.
Proof.
  intros. pose proof (lift_lift_gen N 0 K j n H) as Hll.
  replace (K + 0) with K in Hll by lia.
  replace (K + 0 - j) with (K - j) in Hll by lia.
  exact Hll.
Qed.


Lemma relocate_ge : forall i k n, k <= i -> relocate i k n = n + i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate. destruct (test k i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma relocate_lt : forall i k n, i < k -> relocate i k n = i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate. destruct (test k i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - exfalso; lia.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_lt : forall N i j, j < i -> insert_Var N i j = Var (pred i).
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, compare. destruct (test j i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - destruct (le_lt j i h) as [hlt|heq]; cbn.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma insert_eq : forall N i, insert_Var N i i = lift i N.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, compare. destruct (test i i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - destruct (le_lt i i h) as [hlt|heq]; cbn.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + reflexivity.
  - exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma insert_gt : forall N i j, i < j -> insert_Var N i j = Var i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, compare. destruct (test j i) as [h|h]; cbn.
  - destruct (le_lt j i h) as [hlt|heq]; cbn; exfalso; lia.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_insert_gen : forall N i j K n, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (insert_Var N i j) K n =
  insert_Var (lift_rec N (K-j) n) (relocate i (S K) n) j.
Proof.
  intros N i j K n H.
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec j i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
  - (* j < i *)
    rewrite (insert_lt N i j hlt).
    destruct i as [|i'].
    + exfalso; lia.
    + cbn.
      destruct (le_lt_dec (S K) (S i')) as [hSK|hSK].
      * assert (hKI : K <= i') by lia.
        rewrite (relocate_ge (S i') (S K) n hSK).
        assert (hji : j < n + S i') by lia.
        rewrite (insert_lt (lift_rec N (K - j) n) (n + S i') j hji).
        rewrite (relocate_ge i' K n hKI).
        f_equal. lia.
      * assert (hKS : S i' < S K) by lia.
        rewrite (relocate_lt (S i') (S K) n hKS).
        rewrite (insert_lt (lift_rec N (K - j) n) (S i') j hlt).
        assert (hiK : i' < K) by lia.
        rewrite (relocate_lt i' K n hiK).
        reflexivity.
  - (* j = i *)
    subst j. rewrite (insert_eq N i).
    assert (hiSK : i < S K) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (S K) n hiSK).
    rewrite (insert_eq (lift_rec N (K - i) n) i).
    unfold lift. apply lift_lift_0. assumption.
  - (* i < j *)
    rewrite (insert_gt N i j hgt).
    assert (hiSK : i < S K) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i (S K) n hiSK).
    rewrite (insert_gt (lift_rec N (K - j) n) i j hgt).
    cbn.
    assert (hiK : i < K) by lia.
    rewrite (relocate_lt i K n hiK).
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_rec_U : forall M N j K m, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (subst_rec M N j) K m =
  subst_rec (lift_rec M (S K) m) (lift_rec N (K - j) m) j.
Proof.
  induction M; intros N j K m H; simpl.
  - apply lift_insert_gen. assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace (K - j) with (S K - S j) by lia.
    apply IHM. lia.
  - f_equal. apply IHM1. assumption. apply IHM2. assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHM. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHM1. assumption. apply IHM2. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHM. assumption.
Qed.

Proof.
  induction n; intros X c d; simpl.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_r. reflexivity.
  - replace (c + S n) with (S (c+n)) by lia.

Qed.

Lemma lift11_tree : forall ty c d,
  lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 1) (S (S c)) d =
  lift_rec (lift_rec ty (S c) d) 1 1.
Proof.
  intros. pose proof (lift_lift_gen ty 1 (S c) 1 d ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (S c + 1) with (S (S c)) in H by lia.
  replace (S c + 1 - 1) with (S c) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lift12_tree : forall ty c d,
  lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 2) (S (S (S c))) d =

  intros. pose proof (lift_lift_gen ty 1 (S (S c)) 2 d ltac:(lia)) as H.
  replace (S (S c) + 1) with (S (S (S c))) in H by lia.
  replace (S (S c) + 1 - 2) with (S c) in H by lia.
  exact H.
Qed.

Require Import Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes String.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Declare Scope tree_scope.

Global Open Scope tree_scope.

Inductive Tree:  Set :=
  | Ref : string -> Tree
  | Node : Tree
  | App : Tree -> Tree -> Tree
.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition Sop := S1 (K @ Node) @ Node.

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Definition KI := K@I.

Inductive program : Tree -> Prop :=
| pr_leaf : program △
| pr_stem : forall M, program M -> program (△ @ M)
| pr_fork : forall M N, program M -> program N -> program (△ @ M@ N)
.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Inductive multi_step : (Tree -> Tree -> Prop) -> Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
  | zero_red : forall red M, multi_step red M M
  | succ_red : forall (red: Tree-> Tree -> Prop) M N P,
                   red M N -> multi_step red N P -> multi_step red M P
.

Definition t_red := multi_step t_red1.

Definition transitive red := forall (M N P: Tree), red M N -> red N P -> red M P.

Definition preserves_appl (red : Tree -> Tree -> Prop) :=
forall M N M', red M M' -> red (M@N) (M'@ N).

Definition preserves_appr (red : Tree -> Tree -> Prop) :=
forall M N N', red N N' -> red (M@N) (M@N').

Definition preserves_app (red : Tree -> Tree -> Prop) :=
forall M M', red M M' -> forall N N', red N N' -> red (M@N) (M'@N').

Fixpoint substitute M x N :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => if eqb x y then N else Ref y
  | △ => △
  | M1 @ M2 => (substitute M1 x N) @ (substitute M2 x N)
end.

Fixpoint bracket x M :=
match M with
| Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
| △ => K@ △
| App M1 M2 => S1 (bracket x M1) @ (bracket x M2)
end
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
  | △ => K@ △
  | App M1 M2 => if occurs x (M1 @ M2)
                 then S1 (star x M1) @ (star x M2)
                 else K@ (M1 @ M2)
  end.

Notation "\" := star : tree_scope.

Inductive combination : Tree -> Prop :=
| is_Node : combination △
| is_App : forall M N, combination M -> combination N -> combination (M@ N)
.

Inductive active: Tree -> Prop :=
| active_ref: forall x, active (Ref x)
| active_app: forall M N, active M -> active (M@N)
.

Inductive normal : Tree -> Prop :=
| nf_ref: forall x, normal (Ref x)
| nf_active: forall M N, active M -> normal M -> normal N -> normal (M@N)
| nf_leaf : normal △
| nf_stem : forall M, normal M -> normal (△ @ M)
| nf_fork : forall M N, normal M -> normal N -> normal (△ @ M@ N)
.

Definition self_apply := Eval cbv in \"x" (Ref "x" @ (Ref "x")).

Definition wait M N := S1 (S1 (K@ M) @ (K@ N)) @ I.

Definition omega := \"w" (\"f" (Ref "f" @ (Ref "w" @ Ref "w" @ Ref "f"))).

Definition Yop := omega @ omega.

Definition wait2 M N x :=  S1 (S1 (S1 (K @ M) @ (K @ N)) @ (K @ x)) @ I.

Definition omega2 := \"w" (\"f" (Ref "f" @ (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f")))).

Definition omega21 := K @ (△ @ (△ @ I)).

Definition omega22 :=  \ "w" (\ "f" (wait2 (Ref "w") (Ref "w") (Ref "f"))).
=====TYPES
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Open Scope tree_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Inductive dtype : Set :=
  Var :  nat -> dtype
| Quant : dtype -> dtype
| Funty : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Leaf : dtype
| Stem : dtype -> dtype
| Fork : dtype -> dtype -> dtype
| Asf : dtype -> dtype
.

Fixpoint  program_type p :=
  match p with
  | Node => Leaf
  | p1 @ p2 =>
    match program_type p1 with
      Leaf => Stem (program_type p2)
    | Stem ty1 => Fork ty1 (program_type p2)
    | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
    end
  | _ => Funty Leaf Leaf
  end.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
intros m' H'; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition le_lt : forall n m : nat, n <= m -> {n < m} + {n = m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;
    intros m' H1 H2; elim (H m'); auto with arith).

Definition compare : forall n m : nat, {n < m} + {n = m} + {n > m} := ltac:(intros n m; elim (test n m); auto with arith;
    left; apply le_lt; trivial with arith).

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=
  match test k i with
     | left _ => n+i
     | _ => i
  end.

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => Fork (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

     | inleft (left _) => Var (Nat.pred i)
     | inleft _ => lift k N
     | _ => Var i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

Fixpoint get x (gamma: list (string * dtype)) :=
  match gamma with
  | (s,ty)::gamma1 => if (s =? x)%string then Some ty else get x gamma1
  | _ => None
  end.

Definition lift_rec_context n k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, lift_rec (snd p) n k)).

Definition lift_context := lift_rec_context 0.

Definition subst_rec_context uty k := map (fun (p:string * dtype)  => (fst p, subst_rec (snd p) uty k)).

Fixpoint normal_type gamma t :=
  match t with
  | Ref x => get x gamma
  | Node => Some Leaf
  | Node @ t1 => match normal_type gamma t1 with | Some ty => Some (Stem ty) | _ => None end
  | Node @ t1 @ t2 =>
    match (normal_type gamma t1, normal_type gamma t2) with
    | (Some ty1, Some ty2) => Some (Fork ty1 ty2)
    | (_,_) => None
    end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint quant n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quant n1 (Quant ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quantf n ty :=
  match n with
  | 0 => ty
  | S n1 => quantf n1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quanta bs ty :=
  match bs with
    nil => ty
  | true :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Quant ty)
  | false :: bs1 => quanta bs1 (Asf ty)
  end.

Fixpoint quant_count bs :=
  match bs with
    nil => 0
  | true :: bs1 => S (quant_count bs1)
  | false :: bs1 => quant_count bs1
  end.

Fixpoint quant_to_quanta n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => nil
  | S n1 => true :: (quant_to_quanta n1)
  end.

Fixpoint variant pos k ty :=


  match ty with
  | Var n => if k=?n then pos else true
  | Quant ty1 => variant pos (S k) ty1
  | Funty ty1 ty2 => variant (negb pos) k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Leaf => true
  | Stem ty1 => variant pos k ty1
  | Fork ty1 ty2 => variant pos k ty1 && variant pos k ty2
  | Asf ty1 => variant pos k ty1
   end.

Definition covariant ty := variant true 0 ty = true.
=====DERIVE
Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat Datatypes.

Require Import terms types subtypes.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Inductive derive: list (string * dtype) -> Tree -> dtype -> Prop :=
| derive_ref : forall gamma x uty ty, get x gamma = Some uty -> subtype uty ty -> derive gamma (Ref x) ty
| derive_node : forall gamma uty, subtype Leaf uty -> derive gamma Node uty
| derive_app: forall gamma M N ty u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) -> derive gamma N u -> derive gamma (M@N) ty
.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Definition omega21_ty := program_type omega21.

Definition omega22_ty := program_type omega22.

Definition omega2_ty := (Fork (Stem omega21_ty) omega22_ty).

Definition eval_ty := quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (Asf (Var 0))).

Definition eager_ty := quant 2 (Funty (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1)) (Funty (Var 0) (Var 1))).

Definition bfff_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eval_ty)) (Asf uty).

Definition bffs_aug uty := Fork (Stem (Fork Leaf eager_ty)) (bfff_aug uty).

Inductive subtype : dtype -> dtype -> Prop :=

| sub_zero : forall ty, subtype ty ty
| sub_trans : forall ty1 ty2 ty3, subtype ty1 ty2 -> subtype ty2 ty3 -> subtype ty1 ty3

| sub_stem : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Stem uty1) (Stem uty2)
| sub_fork : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                         subtype (Fork uty1 vty1) (Fork uty2 vty2)
| sub_asf : forall uty1 uty2, subtype uty1 uty2 -> subtype (Asf uty1) (Asf uty2)
| sub_funty : forall uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2, subtype uty2 uty1 -> subtype vty1 vty2 ->
                                          subtype (Funty uty1 vty1) (Funty uty2 vty2)
| sub_quant : forall vty1 vty2,  subtype vty1 vty2 -> subtype (Quant vty1) (Quant vty2)

| sub_quant_stem: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Stem uty)) (Stem (Quant uty))
| sub_quant_fork: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Fork uty vty)) (Fork (Quant uty) (Quant vty))
| sub_quant_asf: forall uty, subtype (Quant (Asf uty)) (Asf (Quant uty))
| sub_dist: forall uty vty, subtype (Quant (Funty uty vty)) (Funty (Quant uty) (Quant vty))

| sub_inst : forall ty u,  subtype (Quant ty) (subst ty u)
| sub_lift: forall ty, subtype ty (Quant (lift 1 ty))

| sub_leaf_fun:forall uty,  subtype Leaf (Funty uty (Stem uty))
| sub_stem_fun: forall uty vty, subtype (Stem uty) (Funty vty (Fork uty vty))

| sub_fork_leaf: forall uty vty, subtype (Fork Leaf uty) (Funty vty uty)
| sub_fork_stem: forall uty vty wty,
    subtype (Fork (Stem (Funty uty (Funty vty wty))) (Funty uty vty)) (Funty uty wty)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.
Require Import shape_lemmas.
Require Import d1_reduction.
Require Import d2_reduction.

(* Good is stable under lift, unconditionally. *)

Lemma Good_lift : forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a b IH | | B IH | A1 B1 IH1 IH2 | Z IH ];
    intros k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (lift_subtype (Stem a) b H k n).
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Good2 is stable under a simultaneous lift of the head and the type. *)

Lemma Good2_lift :
  forall A S k n, Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a b IH | | B IH | A1 B1 IH1 IH2 | Z IH ];
    intros A k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - (* Quant: the head is lifted by one inside the body as well. *)
    assert (E : lift_rec (lift 1 A) (S k) n = lift 1 (lift_rec A k n)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (lift_lift_gen A 0 (S k) 1 n ltac:(lia)) as Hll.
      replace (S k + 0) with (S k) in Hll by lia.
      replace (S k + 0 - 1) with k in Hll by lia.
      exact Hll. }
    rewrite <- E. apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (lift_subtype (Fork A a) b H k n).
  - exact H.
  - exact (lift_subtype A B H k n).
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Hence the D1/D2 reductions only need the substitution closures. *)

Lemma D1_from_subst_closure :
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hsubst. apply D1_from_closures.
  - exact Good_lift.
  - exact Hsubst.
Qed.

Lemma D2_from_subst_closure :
  (forall A S w k, Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hsubst. apply D2_from_closures.
  - exact Good2_lift.
  - exact Hsubst.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.

Lemma insert_relocate_k : forall u i k, insert_Var u (relocate i k 1) k = Var i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  destruct (test k i) as [h|h].
  - destruct (compare k (1+i)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + exfalso. lia.
  - destruct (compare k i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_relocate_Sk : forall i k, insert_Var (Var 0) (relocate i (S k) 1) k = Var i.
Proof.
  intros. unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  destruct (test (S k) i) as [h|h].
  - destruct (compare k (1+i)) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + exfalso. lia.
  - destruct (compare k i) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt]; cbn.
    + exfalso. lia.
    + subst. cbn. f_equal. lia.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_rec : forall X k u, subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X.
Proof.
  induction X; intros k u; simpl.
  - apply insert_relocate_k.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_rec_S : forall X k, subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X.
Proof.
  induction X; intros k; simpl.
  - apply insert_relocate_Sk.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma subst_lift1 : forall X u, subst (lift 1 X) u = X.
Proof. intros. unfold subst, lift. apply subst_lift_rec. Qed.

Lemma subst_lift_rec11 : forall X, subst (lift_rec X 1 1) (Var 0) = X.
Proof. intros. unfold subst. apply subst_lift_rec_S. Qed.

Lemma quant_stem_comm : forall u, subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant (Stem u)).
Proof.
  intros u. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift.
  - change (subtype (Quant (Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))) (Quant (Stem u))).
    apply sub_quant, sub_stem. eapply sub_trans.
    + apply (sub_inst (lift_rec u 1 1) (Var 0)).
    + rewrite subst_lift_rec11. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_comm : forall A a, subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a)).
Proof.
  intros A a. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_lift.
  - change (subtype (Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1))))
                    (Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a))).
    apply sub_quant, sub_fork.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * apply (sub_inst (lift_rec a 1 1) (Var 0)).
      * rewrite subst_lift_rec11. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Corollaries used in the D1/D2 sub_dist cases. *)
Lemma stem_quant_lift : forall a b, subtype (Stem a) b ->
                                   subtype (Stem (Quant a)) (Quant b).
Proof.
  intros a b H. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply quant_stem_comm.
  - apply sub_quant, H.
Qed.

Lemma fork_quant_lift : forall A a b, subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b ->
                                      subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant b).
Proof.
  intros A a b H. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply fork_quant_comm.
  - apply sub_quant, H.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun (N : dtype) (k : nat) =>
  match L with
  | Var i => insert_Var N i k
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem M => Stem (subst_rec M N k)
  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Quant M => Quant (subst_rec M N (S k))
  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)
  end.

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

(scratch work; /workspace untouched)

Targets
-------
D1: subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty
D2: subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty

D1/D2 are equivalent to the Task.v helper lemmas:
  L1: subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype A u -> subtype (Stem A) ty
  L2: subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype B u -> subtype (Fork A B) ty
(L1 follows from D1 by sub_stem + sub_trans; conversely take A:=u/B:=u and
sub_zero.)  No counterexample found; the rules look designed to make D1/D2
true, and the critical quantifier cases close exactly via the lift/subst
identities below.  The proof is NOT an eauto exercise: sub_trans forces an
induction over a pair of derivations.

0. VERIFIED COQ CORE LEMMAS  (/tmp/sub/exp7.v compiles, no admits)
------------------------------------------------------------------
The following are proved and are the load-bearing arithmetic/de Bruijn facts.
(the definitions relocate/insert_Var are those of /workspace/types.v)

Lemma insert_relocate_k : forall u i k,
  insert_Var u (relocate i k 1) k = Var i.

Lemma insert_relocate_Sk : forall i k,
  insert_Var (Var 0) (relocate i (S k) 1) k = Var i.

Lemma subst_lift_rec : forall X k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X.

Lemma subst_lift_rec_S : forall X k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X.

Corollaries (exactly the identities suggested in the task):
Lemma subst_lift1 : forall X u, subst (lift 1 X) u = X.
Lemma subst_lift_rec11 : forall X, subst (lift_rec X 1 1) (Var 0) = X.

Commutation lemmas:
Lemma quant_stem_comm : forall u,
  subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant (Stem u)).
Proof: sub_trans of
  (a) sub_lift : Stem (Quant u) <: Quant (Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))
      (definitional identity lift 1 (Stem (Quant u)) =
       Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))
  (b) sub_quant (sub_stem (sub_inst (lift_rec u 1 1) (Var 0)))
      : Quant (Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) <: Quant (Stem u)
      where the instance type is rewritten by subst_lift_rec11.

Lemma fork_quant_comm : forall A a,
  subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a)).
Proof: sub_trans of
  (a) sub_lift : Fork A (Quant a) <:
        Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)))
  (b) sub_quant (sub_fork (sub_zero (lift 1 A))
                          (sub_inst (lift_rec a 1 1) (Var 0)))
      : Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1))) <:
        Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a).

Note the exact indices: under the Quant binder lift uses cutoff 1, so the
relevant identity is subst_lift_rec_S at k=0 (equivalently
subst_lift_rec11).  These two commutation lemmas are what makes the
sub_dist case of D1/D2 go through.

1. WHY NAIVE INDUCTION FAILS; THE RIGHT CERTIFICATE
---------------------------------------------------
For D1 the derivation d : subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) has only two possible
last rules:
  (i)  sub_leaf_fun : immediate (Stem u <: Stem u);
  (ii) sub_trans d0 d2 with d0 : subtype Leaf X, d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty).
The middle X is arbitrary, so nothing is known about X from its shape.  The
same happens for D2 (middle reachable from Stem A).

The fix is a certificate indexed by the *derivation*, not merely by the
type.  Use a well-founded induction on derivation size (define
size : subtype S T -> nat by structural recursion; use lt_wf / Nat.lt_wf_rect)
and prove simultaneously:

  D1(d : subtype Leaf (Funty u ty))              -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  D2(A, d : subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty))       -> subtype (Fork A u) ty
  Comp1(d0 : subtype Leaf X) (d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty))
                                                 -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  Comp2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) X) (d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty))
                                                 -> subtype (Fork A u) ty
  and the quantifier-body invariants QInv1/QInv2 below.

Termination: every recursive call is on a strictly smaller derivation in the
global size measure.  In Comp's sub_trans case reassociate
  Comp d0 (sub_trans e1 e2)  :=  Comp (sub_trans d0 e1) e2
where the second derivation e2 is smaller.  The enlarged first derivation is
still smaller than the original top-level derivation (its two parts are
disjoint subtrees of it), so the outer well-founded hypothesis applies when
Comp's sub_zero/sub_funty cases call D1/D2 on it.  This is the only
implementation subtlety; it is a standard well-founded recursion.

2. CASE TABLE FOR Comp1  (d0 : Leaf <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
---------------------------------------------------------------
Invert the last rule of d2.  The only rules whose conclusion is a Funty are
sub_zero, sub_funty, sub_trans, sub_leaf_fun, sub_stem_fun, sub_dist,
sub_inst, sub_from_asf, sub_fork_leaf, sub_fork_stem, sub_fork_fork_*,
sub_recursion, sub_tree.  For each we need subtype (Stem u) ty:

* sub_zero (X = Funty u ty): call D1(d0); d0 is smaller than the original
  derivation.  [This is where the circular-looking base case is discharged.]
* sub_funty (X = Funty a b, u <: a, b <: ty):
    D1(d0) gives Stem a <: b; sub_stem(u<:a) + sub_trans + b<:ty.
* sub_trans (X <: Y <: Funty u ty): recurse Comp1(sub_trans d0 e1, e2).
* sub_leaf_fun (X = Leaf, target Funty a (Stem a)):
    Stem a <: Stem a by sub_zero (d0 is unused).
* sub_stem_fun (X = Stem B, target Funty v (Fork B v)):
    d0 : Leaf <: Stem B.  Impossible: nothing Stem-headed is above Leaf.
    Need lemma `no_leaf_stem : subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False`
    (prove by induction on the derivation of Leaf <: Stem B; use that every
    rule with conclusion subtype Leaf T has T = Leaf, Funty..., Quant Leaf,
    Asf Leaf, or is a trans whose right side is reached by one of these;
    a Stem target can only be produced by sub_stem/sub_quant_stem, which
    need a Stem/Quant(Stem) source, contradicting the IH).
    Same for sub_fork_* (no Leaf <: Fork...), sub_recursion/sub_tree
    (sources omega2_ty / the tree big Fork are Fork-headed).
* sub_dist (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (Quant a) (Quant b)):
    need subtype (Stem (Quant a)) (Quant b).
    The invariant QInv1(d0) below gives subtype (Stem a) b.
    Then quant_stem_comm : Stem (Quant a) <: Quant (Stem a),
    and sub_quant of the invariant gives Quant (Stem a) <: Quant b.
    sub_trans closes.  THIS IS THE CASE THAT NEEDS quant_stem_comm.
* sub_inst (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (subst a w) (subst b w)):
    need subtype (Stem (subst a w)) (subst b w).
    QInv1(d0) gives subtype (Stem a) b.  Substitution preserves subtyping
    (lemma subst_subtype below), so
      subtype (subst (Stem a) w) (subst b w)
    and subst distributes: subst (Stem a) w = Stem (subst a w).
    Closes with no lift identity needed.
* sub_from_asf (X = Asf (Funty a b), target Funty a b):
    need subtype (Stem a) b.  The Asf-invariant of d0 (section 4) gives it.
* sub_fork_leaf (X = Fork Leaf b, target Funty v b):
    d0 : Leaf <: Fork Leaf b is impossible (no Leaf <: Fork...).  Vacuous.

QInv1 (needed above):
  QInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Quant Z)) :=
      forall a b, subtype Z (Funty a b) -> subtype (Stem a) b.
  Prove by the same two-derivation induction (d0 is the left derivation; the
  second argument is a continuation out of Z).  Base cases:
    - d0 ends in sub_trans through Funty p q then sub_lift:
        Leaf <: Funty p (Stem p) <: Quant (Funty (lift p) (lift (Stem p))).
      The body is Funty (lift p) (Stem (lift p)); the continuation inversion
      (funty_src below) gives a <: lift p and Stem (lift p) <: b, hence
      Stem a <: Stem (lift p) <: b.
    - sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift continuations of Z: exactly the computations
      of section 2, with lifting/substitution preservation.
QInv1 uses no head parameter (the D1 companion is simply Stem a).

3. CASE TABLE FOR Comp2  (d0 : Stem A <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
------------------------------------------------------------------
* sub_zero: call D2(A, d0), d0 smaller.
* sub_funty (X = Funty a b, u <: a, b <: ty):
    D2(A,d0) : Fork A a <: b; sub_fork(u<:a) : Fork A u <: Fork A a;
    sub_trans.
* sub_trans: recurse Comp2(A, sub_trans d0 e1, e2).
* sub_leaf_fun (X = Leaf): d0 : Stem A <: Leaf impossible
    (below Leaf only Leaf; lemma `below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf`,
    proved by induction on the derivation: only sub_zero/sub_trans can end
    with right side Leaf).
* sub_stem_fun (X = Stem B, target Funty v (Fork B v)):
    d0 : Stem A <: Stem B.  Lemma `stem_inv : subtype (Stem A) (Stem B) ->
    subtype A B` (induction on the derivation; rules with conclusion
    Stem-headed are sub_zero, sub_stem, sub_quant_stem, sub_trans; the
    quant_stem case has a Quant(Stem) source, impossible for source Stem A
    unless A is quantified, handled by inversion).  Then sub_fork.
* sub_dist (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (Quant a) (Quant b)):
    need subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant b).
    QInv2(A,d0) below gives subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.
    fork_quant_comm gives Fork A (Quant a) <: Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a),
    and sub_quant of the invariant gives Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a) <: Quant b.
    sub_trans closes.  THIS IS THE CASE THAT NEEDS fork_quant_comm and the
    lift-1 head in the invariant.
* sub_inst (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (subst a w) (subst b w)):
    need subtype (Fork A (subst a w)) (subst b w).
    QInv2(A,d0) gives subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.  Substitution
    preservation gives subtype (subst (Fork (lift 1 A) a) w) (subst b w);
    subst distributes and subst (lift 1 A) w = A by subst_lift1, so this is
    exactly subtype (Fork A (subst a w)) (subst b w).
    THIS IS WHERE subst_lift1 is used.
* sub_from_asf: use the Asf-invariant (section 4).
* sub_fork_leaf/stem/fork_*: X Fork-headed; d0 : Stem A <: Fork ... is
    impossible (nothing Fork-headed is above Stem A except via trans whose
    final step needs a Fork/quantified-Fork source; prove
    `no_stem_fork : subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False` analogously to
    no_leaf_stem).  sub_recursion and sub_tree are the same (Fork sources).
    Vacuous.

QInv2 (needed above):
  QInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Quant Z)) :=
      forall a b, subtype Z (Funty a b) ->
                  subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.
  The head is lift 1 A, NOT A.  Base/closure:
    - Stem A <: Funty p (Fork A p) [sub_stem_fun], then sub_lift:
      body Z = Funty (lift p) (Fork (lift A) (lift p)); QInv2 conclusion is
      Fork (lift A) (lift p) <: Fork (lift A) (lift p) (sub_zero).  The
      continuation inversion gives a <: lift p and Fork (lift A) (lift p)
      <: b, then sub_fork(a<:lift p) + sub_trans.
    - sub_lift continuation: body becomes lift 1 Z; lifting preservation of
      subtype turns the earlier datum into the one with one more lift.
    - sub_dist continuation: use fork_quant_comm.
    - sub_inst continuation: use subst_lift1 exactly as in Comp2 above.
  The head lift 1 A is precisely the index that de Bruijn lifting puts on A
  when the derivation goes under a Quant binder; the two identities
  subst_lift1 / subst_lift_rec_S absorb the shift at the next elimination.

4. Asf (both D1 and D2)
-----------------------
The Asf rules are simple and do not create new function-type heads:
  sub_to_asf  : ty <: Asf ty
  sub_asf     : Asf a <: Asf b from a <: b
  sub_from_asf: Asf (Funty a b) <: Funty a b
For the certificate, pair each invariant with an Asf companion that is the
same datum transported through Asf:
  AsfInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Asf Z))  :=  QInv1-transported-to-Z
  AsfInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Asf Z)) := QInv2-transported-to-Z
with the rule sub_to_asf preserving the datum (the same companion subtype is
kept), sub_asf using the premise's invariant, and sub_from_asf applying the
invariant at the body Funty a b.  The only new obligation is:
  subtype (Asf (Funty a b)) (Funty a b) is an axiom (sub_from_asf), so the
  invariant at Z=Funty a b is consumed directly.
No new commutation identity is needed for Asf.

5. Funty-source inversion (used by the quantifier closures)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Lemma funty_src :
  forall a b u v, subtype (Funty a b) (Funty u v) ->
                  subtype u a /\ subtype b v.
Proof: two-derivation induction exactly like Comp, by the last rule of the
*second* derivation:
  sub_zero: refl both.
  sub_funty: premises give u <: c and d <: v; the first derivation gives
             c <: a and b <: d (recursive call on the smaller derivation
             into Funty c d); compose with sub_trans.
  sub_trans: reassociate as in section 1.
  Other rules cannot have a Funty source except through trans; when the
  second derivation's last rule has source Quant/Asf/Fork/etc., the first
  derivation's source Funty is related to it only through sub_lift/sub_to_asf
  (or a trans chain), and the needed facts are:
    - Quant (lift 1 a) <: a and b <: Quant (lift 1 b)  (sub_inst/sub_lift,
      using subst_lift1),
    - the Asf datum from section 4,
    - the Fork cases are vacuous because a Funty source cannot reach a Fork
      or Stem head (same no_* lemmas).
This lemma is also exactly the "domain contravariance + codomain covariance"
needed for the closure steps.

6. Preservation lemmas (standard de Bruijn metatheory)
------------------------------------------------------
subst_subtype :
  forall P Q w, subtype P Q -> subtype (subst P w) (subst Q w).
lift_subtype :
  forall P Q k n, subtype P Q -> subtype (lift_rec P k n) (lift_rec Q k n).
Prove by induction on the subtype derivation.  All rules are schematic, so
the only work is commuting subst/lift with the constructors:
  - sub_lift/sub_inst need
      subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X            (subst_lift_rec)
      subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X  (subst_lift_rec_S)

-----------------------
The Asf rules are simple and do not create new function-type heads:
  sub_to_asf  : ty <: Asf ty
  sub_asf     : Asf a <: Asf b from a <: b
  sub_from_asf: Asf (Funty a b) <: Funty a b

same datum transported through Asf:
  AsfInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Asf Z))  :=  QInv1-transported-to-Z
  AsfInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Asf Z)) := QInv2-transported-to-Z

  subtype (Asf (Funty a b)) (Funty a b) is an axiom (sub_from_asf), so the
  invariant at Z=Funty a b is consumed directly.

Lemma funty_src :
  forall a b u v, subtype (Funty a b) (Funty u v) ->
                  subtype u a /\ subtype b v.

*second* derivation:

             into Funty c d); compose with sub_trans.
  sub_trans: reassociate as in section 1.
  Other rules cannot have a Funty source except through trans; when the
  second derivation's last rule has source Quant/Asf/Fork/etc., the first
  derivation's source Funty is related to it only through sub_lift/sub_to_asf
  (or a trans chain), and the needed facts are:
    - Quant (lift 1 a) <: a and b <: Quant (lift 1 b)  (sub_inst/sub_lift,
      using subst_lift1),
    - the Asf datum from section 4,
    - the Fork cases are vacuous because a Funty source cannot reach a Fork
      or Stem head (same no_* lemmas).
This lemma is also exactly the "domain contravariance + codomain covariance"
needed for the closure steps.

Lemma relocate_lift_lift : forall i a K j n, j <= K ->
  relocate (relocate i a j) (K+a) n =
  relocate (relocate i (K+a-j) n) a j.
Proof.
  intros. unfold relocate.
  destruct (test a i) as [ha|ha]; cbn.
  - destruct (test (K+a-j) i) as [hb|hb]; cbn.
    + destruct (test a (n+i)) as [h1|h1]; cbn.
      2: exfalso; lia.
      destruct (test (K+a) (j+i)) as [h2|h2]; cbn.
      2: exfalso; lia.
      lia.
    + destruct (test (K+a) (j+i)) as [h2|h2]; cbn.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test a i) as [ha2|ha2]; cbn.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- exfalso; lia.
  - assert (K+a-j > i) by lia.
    destruct (test (K+a-j) i) as [hb|hb]; cbn.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + destruct (test (K+a) i) as [h2|h2]; cbn.
      * exfalso; lia.
      * destruct (test a i) as [ha2|ha2]; cbn.
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- reflexivity.

  lift_rec (lift_rec N a j) (K + a) n =
  lift_rec (lift_rec N (K + a - j) n) a j.
Proof.

  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_lift. assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace (S (K + a)) with (K + S a) by lia.
    replace (S (K + a - j)) with (K + S a - j) by lia.
    apply IHN. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN1. assumption. apply IHN2. assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHN. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN1. assumption. apply IHN2. assumption.
  - f_equal. apply IHN. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lift_lift_0 : forall N K j n, j <= K ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec N 0 j) K n =
  lift_rec (lift_rec N (K - j) n) 0 j.
Proof.
  intros. pose proof (lift_lift_gen N 0 K j n H) as Hll.
  replace (K + 0) with K in Hll by lia.
  replace (K + 0 - j) with (K - j) in Hll by lia.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Load "/tmp/s/shape_lemmas.v".
Load "/tmp/sub/exp7.v".

Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Section CertL.

(* Temporary section variable: the real proof is being produced separately in
   /tmp/s/subst_ids.v.  Everything else in this file is unconditional. *)
Variable subtype_subst_rec :
  forall X Y, subtype X Y -> forall u k,
    subtype (subst_rec X u k) (subst_rec Y u k).

Fixpoint CertL (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty u ty => subtype (Stem u) ty
  | Asf Z => CertL Z
  | Quant Z => CertL Z
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma CertL_subst_rec : forall X u k,
  CertL X -> CertL (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  induction X; intros u k HC; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Stem (subst_rec X1 u k)) (subst_rec X2 u k)).
    specialize (subtype_subst_rec (Stem X1) X2 HC u k).
    cbn [subst_rec] in H.
    exact H.
  - contradiction.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IHX. exact HC.
  - (* Quant *)
    apply IHX with (k := S k). exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma CertL_lift_rec : forall X,
  CertL X -> forall k n, CertL (lift_rec X k n).
Proof.
  induction X; intros HC k n; simpl in *.
  - exact I.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Stem (lift_rec X1 k n)) (lift_rec X2 k n)).
    specialize (lift_subtype (Stem X1) X2 HC k n).
    cbn [lift_rec] in H.
    exact H.
  - contradiction.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IHX. exact HC.
  - (* Quant *)
    apply IHX with (k := S k) (n := n). exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma CertL_transfer : forall X Y,
  subtype X Y -> CertL X -> CertL Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction H; intro HC; simpl in *.
  - exact HC.
  - apply IHsubtype2. apply IHsubtype1. exact HC.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - apply IHsubtype. exact HC.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact HC.
      * exact H0.
  - apply IHsubtype. exact HC.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *)
    exact HC.
  - (* sub_dist *)
    apply stem_quant_lift. exact HC.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    apply (CertL_subst_rec ty u 0). exact HC.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    change (CertL (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
    apply CertL_lift_rec with (k := 0) (n := 1). exact HC.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *)
    apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_recursion *)
    change (CertL omega2_ty) in HC.
    unfold omega2_ty. cbn [CertL] in HC. contradiction.
  - (* sub_tree *)
    change (CertL (Fork
      (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
        (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
      (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
        (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))) in HC.
    cbn [CertL] in HC. contradiction.
  - (* sub_to_asf *)
    exact HC.
  - (* sub_from_asf *)
    exact HC.
  - (* sub_bffs *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_bfff *)
    contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma D1 : forall u ty,
  subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros u ty H.
  apply (CertL_transfer Leaf (Funty u ty)); auto.
Qed.

End CertL.

Print Assumptions D1.

(* ============================================================ *)

(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint NF (X:dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf Z => NF Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z
  | Var _ => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  end
with NFQ (X:dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty _ _ => True
  | Asf Z => NFQ Z
  | Quant Z => NFQ Z
  | Var _ => False
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  end.

Lemma NF_subst_lift_all : forall X,
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NF (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall u k, NFQ (subst_rec X u k)) /\
  (NF X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)) /\
  (NFQ X -> forall k n, NFQ (lift_rec X k n)).
Proof.
  induction X; cbn; repeat split; intros H;
    try exact I; try destruct H; auto.
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 IHX) H).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 IHX) H).
  - exact (proj1 (proj2 IHX) H).
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 IHX) H).
Qed.

Lemma NFQ_subst_rec_NF : forall X u k, NFQ X -> NF (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  intros. exact (proj1 (NF_subst_lift_all X) H u k).
Qed.

Proof.

Proof.
  intros. exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (NF_subst_lift_all X))) H k n).
Qed.

STRATEGY NOTES: pure subtype facts D1/D2 for typed tree calculus
(scratch work; /workspace untouched)

Targets
-------
D1: subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty
D2: subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty

D1/D2 are equivalent to the Task.v helper lemmas:
  L1: subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype A u -> subtype (Stem A) ty
  L2: subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype B u -> subtype (Fork A B) ty
(L1 follows from D1 by sub_stem + sub_trans; conversely take A:=u/B:=u and
sub_zero.)  No counterexample found; the rules look designed to make D1/D2
true, and the critical quantifier cases close exactly via the lift/subst
identities below.  The proof is NOT an eauto exercise: sub_trans forces an
induction over a pair of derivations.

0. VERIFIED COQ CORE LEMMAS  (/tmp/sub/exp7.v compiles, no admits)
------------------------------------------------------------------
The following are proved and are the load-bearing arithmetic/de Bruijn facts.
(the definitions relocate/insert_Var are those of /workspace/types.v)

Lemma insert_relocate_k : forall u i k,
  insert_Var u (relocate i k 1) k = Var i.

Lemma insert_relocate_Sk : forall i k,
  insert_Var (Var 0) (relocate i (S k) 1) k = Var i.

Lemma subst_lift_rec : forall X k u,
  subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X.

Lemma subst_lift_rec_S : forall X k,
  subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X.

Corollaries (exactly the identities suggested in the task):
Lemma subst_lift1 : forall X u, subst (lift 1 X) u = X.
Lemma subst_lift_rec11 : forall X, subst (lift_rec X 1 1) (Var 0) = X.

Commutation lemmas:
Lemma quant_stem_comm : forall u,
  subtype (Stem (Quant u)) (Quant (Stem u)).
Proof: sub_trans of
  (a) sub_lift : Stem (Quant u) <: Quant (Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))
      (definitional identity lift 1 (Stem (Quant u)) =
       Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1)))
  (b) sub_quant (sub_stem (sub_inst (lift_rec u 1 1) (Var 0)))
      : Quant (Stem (Quant (lift_rec u 1 1))) <: Quant (Stem u)
      where the instance type is rewritten by subst_lift_rec11.

Lemma fork_quant_comm : forall A a,
  subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a)).
Proof: sub_trans of
  (a) sub_lift : Fork A (Quant a) <:
        Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1)))
  (b) sub_quant (sub_fork (sub_zero (lift 1 A))
                          (sub_inst (lift_rec a 1 1) (Var 0)))
      : Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) (Quant (lift_rec a 1 1))) <:
        Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a).

Note the exact indices: under the Quant binder lift uses cutoff 1, so the
relevant identity is subst_lift_rec_S at k=0 (equivalently
subst_lift_rec11).  These two commutation lemmas are what makes the
sub_dist case of D1/D2 go through.

1. WHY NAIVE INDUCTION FAILS; THE RIGHT CERTIFICATE
---------------------------------------------------
For D1 the derivation d : subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) has only two possible
last rules:
  (i)  sub_leaf_fun : immediate (Stem u <: Stem u);
  (ii) sub_trans d0 d2 with d0 : subtype Leaf X, d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty).
The middle X is arbitrary, so nothing is known about X from its shape.  The
same happens for D2 (middle reachable from Stem A).

The fix is a certificate indexed by the *derivation*, not merely by the
type.  Use a well-founded induction on derivation size (define
size : subtype S T -> nat by structural recursion; use lt_wf / Nat.lt_wf_rect)
and prove simultaneously:

  D1(d : subtype Leaf (Funty u ty))              -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  D2(A, d : subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty))       -> subtype (Fork A u) ty
  Comp1(d0 : subtype Leaf X) (d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty))
                                                 -> subtype (Stem u) ty
  Comp2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) X) (d2 : subtype X (Funty u ty))
                                                 -> subtype (Fork A u) ty
  and the quantifier-body invariants QInv1/QInv2 below.

Termination: every recursive call is on a strictly smaller derivation in the
global size measure.  In Comp's sub_trans case reassociate
  Comp d0 (sub_trans e1 e2)  :=  Comp (sub_trans d0 e1) e2
where the second derivation e2 is smaller.  The enlarged first derivation is
still smaller than the original top-level derivation (its two parts are
disjoint subtrees of it), so the outer well-founded hypothesis applies when
Comp's sub_zero/sub_funty cases call D1/D2 on it.  This is the only
implementation subtlety; it is a standard well-founded recursion.

2. CASE TABLE FOR Comp1  (d0 : Leaf <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
---------------------------------------------------------------

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes Triage.derive.
Open Scope string_scope. Open Scope nat_scope. Open Scope tree_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Ltac crush_tests :=
  repeat match goal with
  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
  end;
  try reflexivity; try (f_equal; lia); lia.

(* 1. relocate under two lifts *)
Lemma relocate_lift_gen : forall ii bb kk jj nn,
  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
  relocate (relocate ii bb kk) jj nn = relocate ii bb (kk+nn).
Proof. intros. unfold relocate. crush_tests. Qed.

(* 2. lift; lift with same cutoff *)
Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall ww bb kk jj nn,
  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec ww bb kk) jj nn = lift_rec ww bb (kk+nn).
Proof.
  induction ww; intros bb kk jj nn Hbj HbK; simpl.
  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_gen; assumption.
  - f_equal. apply (IHww (S bb) kk (S jj) nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHww1 bb kk jj nn); assumption | apply (IHww2 bb kk jj nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHww bb kk jj nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHww1 bb kk jj nn); assumption | apply (IHww2 bb kk jj nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHww bb kk jj nn); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall ww kk nn,
  lift_rec (lift_rec ww 0 kk) 0 nn = lift_rec ww 0 (kk+nn).
Proof. intros. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia. Qed.

(* 3. lift by zero *)
Lemma lift_rec_zero : forall ww kk, lift_rec ww kk 0 = ww.
Proof.
  induction ww; intros kk; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. destruct (test kk n); reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHww.
  - f_equal; [apply IHww1 | apply IHww2].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHww.
  - f_equal; [apply IHww1 | apply IHww2].
  - f_equal. apply IHww.
Qed.

Lemma lift_zero : forall ww, lift 0 ww = ww.
Proof. intros. unfold lift. apply lift_rec_zero. Qed.

(* 4. insert under a lift *)
Lemma insert_lift_gen : forall ww ii jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  insert_Var ww (relocate ii jj nn) (kk+nn) =
  lift_rec (insert_Var ww ii kk) jj nn.
Proof.
  intros ww ii jj kk nn Hjk.
  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  repeat match goal with
  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
  end.
  all: try reflexivity.
  all: try (unfold lift; symmetry; apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia).
  all: try (rewrite !lift_zero; reflexivity).
  all: cbn [lift_rec]; unfold relocate; crush_tests.
Qed.

(* 5. generalized insert under lift (needed for lift-subst) *)
Lemma lift_lift_subst_gen : forall XX bb jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX bb jj) (bb+kk) nn =
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX (bb+kk-jj) nn) bb jj.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros bb jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. crush_tests.
  - f_equal.
    replace (S (bb + kk)) with (S bb + kk) by lia.
    replace (S (bb + kk - jj)) with (S bb + kk - jj) by lia.
    apply (IHXX (S bb) jj kk nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 bb jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 bb jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX bb jj kk nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 bb jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 bb jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX bb jj kk nn); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lift_insert_gen : forall uu ii jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (insert_Var uu ii jj) kk nn =
  insert_Var (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) (relocate ii (S kk) nn) jj.
Proof.
  intros uu ii jj kk nn Hjk.
  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
  repeat match goal with
  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
  end.
  all: try reflexivity.
  all: try (rewrite !lift_zero; reflexivity).
  all: try (rewrite (lift_rec_zero uu 0); rewrite (lift_rec_zero (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) 0); reflexivity).
  all: try (unfold lift; cbn [lift_rec relocate]; crush_tests).
  all: try (cbn [lift_rec]; unfold relocate; crush_tests).
  all: try (unfold lift; exact (lift_lift_subst_gen uu 0 jj kk nn Hjk)).
Qed.

(* 6. B_gen: substitution into a lifted term *)
Lemma subst_lift_gen : forall XX ww jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX jj nn) ww (kk+nn) =
  lift_rec (subst_rec XX ww kk) jj nn.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros ww jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
  - apply insert_lift_gen; assumption.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww (S jj) (S kk) nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 ww jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 ww jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww jj kk nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 ww jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 ww jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww jj kk nn); assumption.
Qed.

(* 7. C_gen: swapping two lifts *)
Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall XX jj kk mm nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX jj mm) (kk+mm) nn =
  lift_rec (lift_rec XX kk nn) jj mm.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros jj kk mm nn Hjk; simpl.
  - unfold relocate. crush_tests.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX (S jj) (S kk) mm nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 jj kk mm nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 jj kk mm nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX jj kk mm nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 jj kk mm nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 jj kk mm nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX jj kk mm nn); assumption.
Qed.

(* 8. J: generalized lift of a substitution *)
Lemma lift_subst_gen : forall XX uu jj kk nn,
  jj <= kk ->
  lift_rec (subst_rec XX uu jj) kk nn =
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX (S kk) nn) (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) jj.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros uu jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
  - apply lift_insert_gen; assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace ((S kk) - (S jj)) with (kk - jj) by lia.
    apply (IHXX uu (S jj) (S kk) nn); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu jj kk nn); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu jj kk nn); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu jj kk nn); assumption.
Qed.

(* 9. substitution into a lift, below the lifted region *)
Lemma subst_lift_low : forall XX NN bb jj cc,
  bb <= jj -> jj < bb + cc ->
  subst_rec (lift_rec XX bb cc) NN jj = lift_rec XX bb (cc-1).
Proof.
  induction XX; intros NN bb jj cc Hbj HbC; simpl.
  - (* Var *) simpl. unfold relocate, insert_Var. crush_tests.
  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply (IHXX NN (S bb) (S jj) cc); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 NN bb jj cc); assumption | apply (IHXX2 NN bb jj cc); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX NN bb jj cc); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 NN bb jj cc); assumption | apply (IHXX2 NN bb jj cc); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX NN bb jj cc); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma insert_Var_same : forall NN ii, insert_Var NN ii ii = lift ii NN.
Proof.
  intros NN ii. unfold insert_Var.
  destruct (compare ii ii) as [[h|h]|h]; try (exfalso; lia); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma insert_subst_gen : forall uu ww ii jj kk,
  jj <= kk ->
  subst_rec (insert_Var uu ii jj) ww kk =
  subst_rec (insert_Var ww ii (S kk)) (subst_rec uu ww (kk-jj)) jj.
Proof.
  intros uu ww ii jj kk Hjk.
  unfold insert_Var.
  repeat match goal with
  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
  end.
  all: try reflexivity.
  all: try (subst ii; simpl; rewrite insert_Var_same; unfold lift;
            rewrite (subst_lift_low ww (subst_rec uu ww (kk-jj)) 0 jj (S kk)); [|lia|lia];
            replace (S kk - 1) with kk by lia; reflexivity).
  all: try (subst ii; simpl; rewrite insert_Var_same; unfold lift;
            replace kk with ((kk-jj)+jj) by lia;
            replace (((kk-jj)+jj)-jj) with (kk-jj) by lia;
            apply subst_lift_gen; lia).
  all: try (simpl; unfold insert_Var, relocate; crush_tests).
Qed.

Lemma subst_subst_gen : forall XX uu ww jj kk,
  jj <= kk ->
  subst_rec (subst_rec XX uu jj) ww kk =
  subst_rec (subst_rec XX ww (S kk)) (subst_rec uu ww (kk-jj)) jj.
Proof.
  induction XX; intros uu ww jj kk Hjk; simpl.
  - apply insert_subst_gen; assumption.
  - f_equal.
    replace ((S kk) - (S jj)) with (kk - jj) by lia.
    apply (IHXX uu ww (S jj) (S kk)); lia.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu ww jj kk); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu ww jj kk); assumption ].
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu ww jj kk); assumption.
  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu ww jj kk); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu ww jj kk); assumption ].
  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu ww jj kk); assumption.
Qed.

(* variant preservation infrastructure *)

Lemma variant_lift_rec_true : forall uu pos lev cut ee,
  lev < cut -> variant pos (lev+ee) (lift_rec uu ee cut) = true.
Proof.
  induction uu as [ n | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | uu IH ];
    intros pos lev cut ee Hlt; simpl.

  - (* Quant *) replace (S (lev+ee)) with (lev + S ee) by lia.
