Lemma variant_lift_rec_pres : forall uu pos lev ee cut,
  lev < ee -> variant pos lev uu = true ->
  variant pos lev (lift_rec uu ee cut) = true.
Proof.
  induction uu as [ n | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | uu IH ];
    intros pos lev ee cut Hlt Hv; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
    destruct (test ee n) as [h|h].
    + (* ee <= n : index n+cut; lev<> n+cut *)
      destruct (lev =? (cut+n)) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
      apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. exfalso; lia.
    + exact Hv.
  - (* Quant *) apply (IH pos (S lev) (S ee) cut); [lia | assumption].
  - (* Funty *) apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
    apply andb_true_intro; split.
    + apply (IH1 (negb pos) lev ee cut); assumption.
    + apply (IH2 pos lev ee cut); assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IH; assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
    apply andb_true_intro; split.
    + apply (IH1 pos lev ee cut); assumption.
    + apply (IH2 pos lev ee cut); assumption.
  - apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma variant_subst_rec : forall ty pos lev uu cc,
  lev < cc -> variant pos lev ty = true ->
  variant pos lev (subst_rec ty uu cc) = true.
Proof.
  induction ty as [ n | ty IH | ty1 IH1 ty2 IH2 | | ty IH | ty1 IH1 ty2 IH2 | ty IH ];
    intros pos lev uu cc Hlt Hv; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) unfold insert_Var.
    destruct (compare cc n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
    + (* cc < n *) simpl.
      destruct (lev =? Nat.pred n) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
      apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. exfalso; lia.
    + (* cc = n *) subst n.
      (* goal: variant pos lev (lift cc uu) = true; unfold lift *)
      unfold lift.
      assert (H := variant_lift_rec_true uu pos lev cc 0 ltac:(lia)).
      replace (lev + 0) with lev in H by lia.
      exact H.
    + exact Hv.
  - (* Quant *) apply (IH pos (S lev) uu (S cc)); [lia | assumption].
  - (* Funty *) apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
    apply andb_true_intro; split.
    + apply (IH1 (negb pos) lev uu cc); assumption.
    + apply (IH2 pos lev uu cc); assumption.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IH; assumption.
  - apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
    apply andb_true_intro; split.
    + apply (IH1 pos lev uu cc); assumption.
    + apply (IH2 pos lev uu cc); assumption.
  - apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma covariant_subst_S : forall ty uu kk,
  covariant ty -> covariant (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)).
Proof.
  intros ty uu kk H. unfold covariant in *.
  apply (variant_subst_rec ty true 0 uu (S kk)); [lia | assumption].
Qed.

Lemma covariant_lift_S : forall ty kk mm,
  covariant ty -> covariant (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm).
Proof.
  intros ty kk mm H. unfold covariant in *.
  apply (variant_lift_rec_pres ty true 0 (S kk) mm); [lia | assumption].
Qed.

Definition tree_src (ty : dtype) : dtype :=
  Fork
    (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
          (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
    (quant 2
       (Funty (Var 1)
              (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))).

Lemma insert_Var_lt : forall uu ii cc, ii < cc -> insert_Var uu ii cc = Var ii.
Proof.
  intros uu ii cc H. unfold insert_Var.
  destruct (compare cc ii) as [[h|h]|h]; try (exfalso; lia); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tree_src_subst : forall ty uu kk,
  subst_rec (tree_src ty) uu kk = tree_src (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)).
Proof.
  intros ty uu kk. unfold tree_src. simpl.
  repeat rewrite insert_Var_lt by lia.
  unfold subst.
  rewrite (subst_subst_gen ty Leaf uu 0 kk); [|lia].
  replace (kk-0) with kk by lia.
  rewrite (subst_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0)) uu 0 (S kk)); [|lia].
  replace ((S kk)-0) with (S kk) by lia.
  rewrite (subst_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) uu 0 (S (S kk))); [|lia].
  replace ((S (S kk))-0) with (S (S kk)) by lia.
  assert (H2 : subst_rec (lift_rec ty 1 1) uu (S (S kk)) =
               lift_rec (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)) 1 1).
  { replace (S (S kk)) with ((S kk)+1) by lia.
    apply (subst_lift_gen ty uu 1 (S kk) 1); lia. }
  rewrite H2.
  assert (H3 : subst_rec (lift_rec ty 1 2) uu (S (S (S kk))) =
               lift_rec (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)) 1 2).
  { replace (S (S (S kk))) with ((S kk)+2) by lia.
    apply (subst_lift_gen ty uu 1 (S kk) 2); lia. }
  rewrite H3.
  simpl.
  repeat rewrite insert_Var_lt by lia.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tree_src_lift : forall ty kk mm,
  lift_rec (tree_src ty) kk mm = tree_src (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm).
Proof.
  intros ty kk mm. unfold tree_src. simpl.
  unfold subst.
  rewrite (lift_subst_gen ty Leaf 0 kk mm); [|lia].
  replace (kk-0) with kk by lia.
  rewrite (lift_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0)) 0 (S kk) mm); [|lia].
  replace ((S kk)-0) with (S kk) by lia.
  rewrite (lift_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) 0 (S (S kk)) mm); [|lia].
  replace ((S (S kk))-0) with (S (S kk)) by lia.
  assert (H2 : lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 1) (S (S kk)) mm =
               lift_rec (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm) 1 1).
  { replace (S (S kk)) with ((S kk)+1) by lia.
    apply (lift_lift_gen ty 1 (S kk) 1 mm); lia. }
  rewrite H2.
  assert (H3 : lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 2) (S (S (S kk))) mm =
               lift_rec (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm) 1 2).
  { replace (S (S (S kk))) with ((S kk)+2) by lia.
    apply (lift_lift_gen ty 1 (S kk) 2 mm); lia. }
  rewrite H3.
  simpl.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma quant_subst_rec : forall nn ty uu kk,

91	still smaller than the original top-level derivation (its two parts are
92	disjoint subtrees of it), so the outer well-founded hypothesis applies when
93	Comp's sub_zero/sub_funty cases call D1/D2 on it.  This is the only
94	implementation subtlety; it is a standard well-founded recursion.
95	
96	2. CASE TABLE FOR Comp1  (d0 : Leaf <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
97	---------------------------------------------------------------
98	Invert the last rule of d2.  The only rules whose conclusion is a Funty are
99	sub_zero, sub_funty, sub_trans, sub_leaf_fun, sub_stem_fun, sub_dist,
100	sub_inst, sub_from_asf, sub_fork_leaf, sub_fork_stem, sub_fork_fork_*,
101	sub_recursion, sub_tree.  For each we need subtype (Stem u) ty:
102	
103	* sub_zero (X = Funty u ty): call D1(d0); d0 is smaller than the original
104	  derivation.  [This is where the circular-looking base case is discharged.]
105	* sub_funty (X = Funty a b, u <: a, b <: ty):
106	    D1(d0) gives Stem a <: b; sub_stem(u<:a) + sub_trans + b<:ty.
107	* sub_trans (X <: Y <: Funty u ty): recurse Comp1(sub_trans d0 e1, e2).
108	* sub_leaf_fun (X = Leaf, target Funty a (Stem a)):
109	    Stem a <: Stem a by sub_zero (d0 is unused).
110	* sub_stem_fun (X = Stem B, target Funty v (Fork B v)):
111	    d0 : Leaf <: Stem B.  Impossible: nothing Stem-headed is above Leaf.
112	    Need lemma `no_leaf_stem : subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False`
113	    (prove by induction on the derivation of Leaf <: Stem B; use that every
114	    rule with conclusion subtype Leaf T has T = Leaf, Funty..., Quant Leaf,
115	    Asf Leaf, or is a trans whose right side is reached by one of these;
116	    a Stem target can only be produced by sub_stem/sub_quant_stem, which
117	    need a Stem/Quant(Stem) source, contradicting the IH).
118	    Same for sub_fork_* (no Leaf <: Fork...), sub_recursion/sub_tree
119	    (sources omega2_ty / the tree big Fork are Fork-headed).
120	* sub_dist (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (Quant a) (Quant b)):
121	    need subtype (Stem (Quant a)) (Quant b).
122	    The invariant QInv1(d0) below gives subtype (Stem a) b.
123	    Then quant_stem_comm : Stem (Quant a) <: Quant (Stem a),
124	    and sub_quant of the invariant gives Quant (Stem a) <: Quant b.
125	    sub_trans closes.  THIS IS THE CASE THAT NEEDS quant_stem_comm.
126	* sub_inst (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (subst a w) (subst b w)):
127	    need subtype (Stem (subst a w)) (subst b w).
128	    QInv1(d0) gives subtype (Stem a) b.  Substitution preserves subtyping
129	    (lemma subst_subtype below), so
130	      subtype (subst (Stem a) w) (subst b w)
131	    and subst distributes: subst (Stem a) w = Stem (subst a w).
132	    Closes with no lift identity needed.
133	* sub_from_asf (X = Asf (Funty a b), target Funty a b):
134	    need subtype (Stem a) b.  The Asf-invariant of d0 (section 4) gives it.
135	* sub_fork_leaf (X = Fork Leaf b, target Funty v b):
136	    d0 : Leaf <: Fork Leaf b is impossible (no Leaf <: Fork...).  Vacuous.
137	
138	QInv1 (needed above):
139	  QInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Quant Z)) :=
140	      forall a b, subtype Z (Funty a b) -> subtype (Stem a) b.
141	  Prove by the same two-derivation induction (d0 is the left derivation; the
142	  second argument is a continuation out of Z).  Base cases:
143	    - d0 ends in sub_trans through Funty p q then sub_lift:
144	        Leaf <: Funty p (Stem p) <: Quant (Funty (lift p) (lift (Stem p))).
145	      The body is Funty (lift p) (Stem (lift p)); the continuation inversion
146	      (funty_src below) gives a <: lift p and Stem (lift p) <: b, hence
147	      Stem a <: Stem (lift p) <: b.
148	    - sub_dist/sub_inst/sub_lift continuations of Z: exactly the computations
149	      of section 2, with lifting/substitution preservation.
150	QInv1 uses no head parameter (the D1 companion is simply Stem a).

152	3. CASE TABLE FOR Comp2  (d0 : Stem A <: X, d2 : X <: Funty u ty)
153	------------------------------------------------------------------
154	* sub_zero: call D2(A, d0), d0 smaller.
155	* sub_funty (X = Funty a b, u <: a, b <: ty):
156	    D2(A,d0) : Fork A a <: b; sub_fork(u<:a) : Fork A u <: Fork A a;
157	    sub_trans.
158	* sub_trans: recurse Comp2(A, sub_trans d0 e1, e2).
159	* sub_leaf_fun (X = Leaf): d0 : Stem A <: Leaf impossible
160	    (below Leaf only Leaf; lemma `below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf`,
161	    proved by induction on the derivation: only sub_zero/sub_trans can end
162	    with right side Leaf).
163	* sub_stem_fun (X = Stem B, target Funty v (Fork B v)):
164	    d0 : Stem A <: Stem B.  Lemma `stem_inv : subtype (Stem A) (Stem B) ->
165	    subtype A B` (induction on the derivation; rules with conclusion
166	    Stem-headed are sub_zero, sub_stem, sub_quant_stem, sub_trans; the
167	    quant_stem case has a Quant(Stem) source, impossible for source Stem A
168	    unless A is quantified, handled by inversion).  Then sub_fork.
169	* sub_dist (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (Quant a) (Quant b)):
170	    need subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant b).
171	    QInv2(A,d0) below gives subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.
172	    fork_quant_comm gives Fork A (Quant a) <: Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a),
173	    and sub_quant of the invariant gives Quant (Fork (lift 1 A) a) <: Quant b.
174	    sub_trans closes.  THIS IS THE CASE THAT NEEDS fork_quant_comm and the
175	    lift-1 head in the invariant.
176	* sub_inst (X = Quant (Funty a b), target Funty (subst a w) (subst b w)):
177	    need subtype (Fork A (subst a w)) (subst b w).
178	    QInv2(A,d0) gives subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.  Substitution
179	    preservation gives subtype (subst (Fork (lift 1 A) a) w) (subst b w);
180	    subst distributes and subst (lift 1 A) w = A by subst_lift1, so this is
181	    exactly subtype (Fork A (subst a w)) (subst b w).
182	    THIS IS WHERE subst_lift1 is used.
183	* sub_from_asf: use the Asf-invariant (section 4).
184	* sub_fork_leaf/stem/fork_*: X Fork-headed; d0 : Stem A <: Fork ... is
185	    impossible (nothing Fork-headed is above Stem A except via trans whose
186	    final step needs a Fork/quantified-Fork source; prove
187	    `no_stem_fork : subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False` analogously to
188	    no_leaf_stem).  sub_recursion and sub_tree are the same (Fork sources).
189	    Vacuous.

191	QInv2 (needed above):
192	  QInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Quant Z)) :=
193	      forall a b, subtype Z (Funty a b) ->
194	                  subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b.
195	  The head is lift 1 A, NOT A.  Base/closure:
196	    - Stem A <: Funty p (Fork A p) [sub_stem_fun], then sub_lift:
197	      body Z = Funty (lift p) (Fork (lift A) (lift p)); QInv2 conclusion is
198	      Fork (lift A) (lift p) <: Fork (lift A) (lift p) (sub_zero).  The
199	      continuation inversion gives a <: lift p and Fork (lift A) (lift p)
200	      <: b, then sub_fork(a<:lift p) + sub_trans.
201	    - sub_lift continuation: body becomes lift 1 Z; lifting preservation of
202	      subtype turns the earlier datum into the one with one more lift.
203	    - sub_dist continuation: use fork_quant_comm.
204	    - sub_inst continuation: use subst_lift1 exactly as in Comp2 above.
205	  The head lift 1 A is precisely the index that de Bruijn lifting puts on A
206	  when the derivation goes under a Quant binder; the two identities
207	  subst_lift1 / subst_lift_rec_S absorb the shift at the next elimination.

209	4. Asf (both D1 and D2)
210	-----------------------
211	The Asf rules are simple and do not create new function-type heads:
212	  sub_to_asf  : ty <: Asf ty
213	  sub_asf     : Asf a <: Asf b from a <: b
214	  sub_from_asf: Asf (Funty a b) <: Funty a b
215	For the certificate, pair each invariant with an Asf companion that is the
216	same datum transported through Asf:
217	  AsfInv1(d0 : subtype Leaf (Asf Z))  :=  QInv1-transported-to-Z
218	  AsfInv2(A, d0 : subtype (Stem A) (Asf Z)) := QInv2-transported-to-Z
219	with the rule sub_to_asf preserving the datum (the same companion subtype is
220	kept), sub_asf using the premise's invariant, and sub_from_asf applying the
221	invariant at the body Funty a b.  The only new obligation is:
222	  subtype (Asf (Funty a b)) (Funty a b) is an axiom (sub_from_asf), so the
223	  invariant at Z=Funty a b is consumed directly.
224	No new commutation identity is needed for Asf.

226	5. Funty-source inversion (used by the quantifier closures)
227	-----------------------------------------------------------
228	Lemma funty_src :
229	  forall a b u v, subtype (Funty a b) (Funty u v) ->
230	                  subtype u a /\ subtype b v.
231	Proof: two-derivation induction exactly like Comp, by the last rule of the
232	*second* derivation:
233	  sub_zero: refl both.
234	  sub_funty: premises give u <: c and d <: v; the first derivation gives
235	             c <: a and b <: d (recursive call on the smaller derivation
236	             into Funty c d); compose with sub_trans.
237	  sub_trans: reassociate as in section 1.
238	  Other rules cannot have a Funty source except through trans; when the
239	  second derivation's last rule has source Quant/Asf/Fork/etc., the first
240	  derivation's source Funty is related to it only through sub_lift/sub_to_asf
241	  (or a trans chain), and the needed facts are:
242	    - Quant (lift 1 a) <: a and b <: Quant (lift 1 b)  (sub_inst/sub_lift,
243	      using subst_lift1),
244	    - the Asf datum from section 4,
245	    - the Fork cases are vacuous because a Funty source cannot reach a Fork
246	      or Stem head (same no_* lemmas).
247	This lemma is also exactly the "domain contravariance + codomain covariance"
248	needed for the closure steps.

250	6. Preservation lemmas (standard de Bruijn metatheory)
251	------------------------------------------------------
252	subst_subtype :
253	  forall P Q w, subtype P Q -> subtype (subst P w) (subst Q w).
254	lift_subtype :
255	  forall P Q k n, subtype P Q -> subtype (lift_rec P k n) (lift_rec Q k n).
256	Prove by induction on the subtype derivation.  All rules are schematic, so
257	the only work is commuting subst/lift with the constructors:
258	  - sub_lift/sub_inst need
259	      subst_rec (lift_rec X k 1) u k = X            (subst_lift_rec)
260	      subst_rec (lift_rec X (S k) 1) (Var 0) k = X  (subst_lift_rec_S)
261	  - sub_inst needs the "subst commutes with subst under one binder" instance
262	    (two substitutions at different depths); prove the standard lemma
263	      subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 1) (subst ...) ...
264	    or avoid it by applying the induction hypothesis at the right instance.
265	Everything else is congruence (sub_stem/sub_fork/sub_asf/sub_funty/sub_quant
266	and the quantifier commutation rules are preserved verbatim by subst/lift,
267	because subst/lift recursively map constructors to the same constructors and
268	commute with Quant by incrementing the cutoff).

270	7. Additional easy shape lemmas used to kill impossible cases
271	-------------------------------------------------------------
272	below_leaf : subtype T Leaf -> T = Leaf.
273	no_leaf_stem : subtype Leaf (Stem B) -> False.
274	no_leaf_fork : subtype Leaf (Fork P Q) -> False.
275	no_stem_fork : subtype (Stem A) (Fork P Q) -> False.
276	no_stem_leaf : subtype (Stem A) Leaf -> False  (from below_leaf).
277	stem_inv : subtype (Stem A) (Stem B) -> subtype A B.
278	All are proved by induction on the derivation plus inversion on the possible
279	last rules (which are syntactic: the constructors of the conclusion fix the
280	head of the source).  sub_trans is handled by applying the IH to the second
281	premise (whose source is the same head) and then to the first premise.

311	These two corollaries are the exact steps used in the Comp1/Comp2 sub_dist

314	Lemma stem_quant_lift : forall a b,
315	  subtype (Stem a) b -> subtype (Stem (Quant a)) (Quant b).
316	Proof. intros a b H. eapply sub_trans.
317	  - apply quant_stem_comm.
318	  - apply sub_quant, H. Qed.

320	Lemma fork_quant_lift : forall A a b,
321	  subtype (Fork (lift 1 A) a) b -> subtype (Fork A (Quant a)) (Quant b).

324	  - apply sub_quant, H. Qed.

403	11. Why the closure hypotheses are NOT a complete proof of D1
404	==============================================================
405	The hypotheses of d1_reduction.v/d2_reduction.v are:
406	  Good_lift  : Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)
407	  Good_subst : Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)
408	and their Funty instances are exactly preservation of subtype under
409	lift/subst for a datum H : subtype (Stem a) b (D1) / Fork A a <: b (D2).
410	
411	Good_lift is plausible and is equivalent to lift_subtype (for arbitrary P,Q):
412	lifting is a pure renaming, maps Var 0 to Var 0 or Var n (n>0), never creates
413	a new free Var 0, so covariant ty stays covariant.  The sub_tree case should
414	be closed with ty' = shift_free ty k n, where shift_free maps free Var i to
415	Var i for i <= k and to Var i+n for i >= k+1 (not a plain lift!), plus
416	lift/subst commutation lemmas.  sub_recursion is trivial because omega2_ty,
417	omega21_ty, omega22_ty are Var-free (program_type never contains Var).
418	
419	Good_subst is the dangerous one.  It would require subst_subtype for arbitrary
420	P,Q and arbitrary cutoff k.  The sub_tree case is not obviously preserved:
421	the outer substitution can hit free variables of ty, and the same free
422	variable of ty is represented differently in the three components of the
423	sub_tree source, so the substituted source need not be an instance of
424	sub_tree again.  Concretely, ty = Funty (Var 1) Leaf, uty = Var 0,
425	k = 0, w = Funty (Var 0) Leaf turns the substituted source into
426	  Fork (Fork (Funty (Funty Var0 Leaf) Leaf) A2') A3'
427	which is not E(ty'') for any ty'' (the first component has a free Var0,
428	while subst ty'' Leaf never has a free Var0).  It is, however, an instance of
429	sub_fork_fork_leaf when uty = Leaf; for uty = Var 0 the domain of the
430	substituted target is Funty Var0 Leaf, so none of the fork_* rules applies
431	directly.  A derivation could still exist through the Quant/lift equivalence
432	X ~ Quant (lift X) (which can hide a free Var0 under a Quant), so this is not
433	a proof that Good_subst is false -- but it shows that a syntactic preservation
434	proof of Good_subst is at least as hard as the tree-rule analysis, and that
435	the type-indexed certificate alone is not yet a proof of D1/D2.
436	
437	Conclusion: d1_reduction.v/d2_reduction.v are a complete, machine-checked
438	*reduction* and a very compact case analysis, but do NOT claim they finish
439	D1/D2 until Good_lift/Good_subst are proved.  In particular Good_subst should
440	not be used in Task.v.

442	12. Refined primary route: pair-induction on (d : Leaf <: X, e : X <: Funty)
443	=============================================================================
444	A direct proof of D1 that avoids arbitrary substitution closure:
445	
446	  P(d, e) := for d : subtype Leaf X and e : subtype X (Funty u ty),
447	             subtype (Stem u) ty.
448	
449	Prove P by well-founded induction on the lexicographic pair
450	(size e, size d).  Then:
451	  - e = sub_leaf_fun: ty = Stem u, goal Stem u <: Stem u.
452	  - e = sub_trans e1 e2 (X <: Y <: Funty): apply the IH to
453	    (sub_trans d e1 : Leaf <: Y, e2).  e2 is a proper subderivation, so the
454	    first component strictly decreases: no need to analyze d.
455	  - e = sub_zero: X = Funty u ty and the goal is D1 for d itself.  Analyze
456	    the last rule of d : Leaf <: Funty u ty:
457	       sub_zero impossible (Leaf <> Funty);
458	       sub_leaf_fun: ty = Stem u, goal Stem u <: Stem u;
459	       sub_trans d1 d2: apply the IH to (d1 : Leaf <: Y, sub_zero :
460	           Funty u ty <: Funty u ty) for d2 : Y <: Funty u ty; e is the same
461	           sub_zero but d2 is a proper subderivation of d, so the second
462	           component strictly decreases.
463	       sub_lift target Quant, sub_to_asf target Asf: impossible.
464	    This is the key well-founded descent that replaces a circular D1 call.
465	  - e = sub_funty u1 u2 v1 v2 (X = Funty u1 v1):
466	       apply the IH to (d, sub_zero (Funty u1 v1)) to get Stem u1 <: v1
467	       (legal: e' = sub_zero has size 1 < size e when e is sub_funty);
468	       then sub_stem d1 : Stem u2 <: Stem u1 and trans twice with d2.
469	  - e = sub_from_asf: X = Asf (Funty a b), target Funty a b.  d : Leaf <:
470	       Asf (Funty a b).  Need Stem a <: b.  Use d and sub_from_asf?  The
471	       pair (d, sub_from_asf) has e with no premise; instead use the IH on
472	       (d, sub_zero (Funty a b))?  That requires d : Leaf <: Funty a b,
473	       which we do not have.  Need an inversion on d : Leaf <: Asf (...):
474	       derive Leaf <: Funty a b (using sub_lift/sub_inst/quant_asf rules),
475	       then apply the sub_zero case.
476	  - e = sub_dist: X = Quant (Funty u v), target Funty (Quant u)(Quant v).
477	       Need Stem (Quant u) <: Quant v.  Analyze d : Leaf <: Quant (Funty u v)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Load "/tmp/new/infra2.v".

Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

Fixpoint CertL (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty u ty => subtype (Stem u) ty
  | Asf Z => CertL Z
  | Quant Z => CertL Z
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma CertL_subst_rec : forall X u k,
  CertL X -> CertL (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  induction X; intros u k HC; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) contradiction.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHX with (k := S k). exact HC.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Stem (subst_rec X1 u k)) (subst_rec X2 u k)).
    specialize (subtype_subst_rec (Stem X1) X2 HC u k) as H.
    cbn [subst_rec] in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) contradiction.
  - (* Fork *) contradiction.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHX. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma CertL_lift_rec : forall X,
  CertL X -> forall k m, CertL (lift_rec X k m).
Proof.
  induction X; intros HC k m; simpl in *.
  - (* Var *) contradiction.
  - (* Quant *) apply IHX with (k := S k) (m := m). exact HC.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Stem (lift_rec X1 k m)) (lift_rec X2 k m)).
    specialize (subtype_lift_rec (Stem X1) X2 HC k m) as H.
    cbn [lift_rec] in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Leaf *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* Stem *) contradiction.
  - (* Fork *) contradiction.
  - (* Asf *) apply IHX. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma CertL_transfer : forall X Y,
  subtype X Y -> CertL X -> CertL Y.
Proof.
  intros X Y H. induction H; intro HC; simpl in *.
  - exact HC.
  - apply IHsubtype2. apply IHsubtype1. exact HC.
  - contradiction.
  - contradiction.
  - apply IHsubtype. exact HC.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_stem. exact H.
    + eapply sub_trans.
      * exact HC.
      * exact H0.
  - apply IHsubtype. exact HC.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *)
    exact HC.
  - (* sub_dist *)
    apply stem_quant_lift. exact HC.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    apply (CertL_subst_rec ty u 0). exact HC.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    change (CertL (lift_rec ty 0 1)).
    apply CertL_lift_rec with (k := 0) (m := 1). exact HC.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *)
    apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_recursion *)
    change (CertL omega2_ty) in HC.
    unfold omega2_ty. cbn [CertL] in HC. contradiction.
  - (* sub_tree *)
    change (CertL (Fork
      (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
        (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
      (quant 2 (Funty (Var 1) (Funty (Var 0)
        (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))))) in HC.
    cbn [CertL] in HC. contradiction.
  - (* sub_to_asf *)
    exact HC.
  - (* sub_from_asf *)
    exact HC.
  - (* sub_bffs *)
    contradiction.
  - (* sub_bfff *)
    contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma D1 : forall u ty,
  subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros u ty H.
  apply (CertL_transfer Leaf (Funty u ty)).
  - exact H.
  - exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Load "/tmp/s/shape_lemmas.v".

Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* Composition of two substitutions, specialized to the form needed by
   sub_inst in subtype_subst_rec. *)
Lemma insert_var_comp : forall u w i k,
  subst_rec (insert_Var u i 0) w k =
  subst_rec (insert_Var w i (S k)) (subst_rec u w k) 0.
Proof.
  intros u w i k.
  unfold insert_Var.
  destruct (compare 0 i) as [[h0|h0]|h0]; cbn.
  - (* 0 < i *)
    destruct (compare (S k) i) as [[h1|h1]|h1]; cbn.
    + (* S k < i: both Var(pred i) *)
      reflexivity.
    + (* S k = i, hence i = S k, contradict 0 < i is fine *)
      subst i. cbn. reflexivity.
    + (* S k > i: LHS Var(pred i); RHS insert_Var w i (S k); since i < S k, compare (S k) i = right? *)
      unfold insert_Var.
      destruct (compare (S k) i) as [[h2|h2]|h2]; cbn.
      * reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
  - (* 0 = i *)
    subst i. cbn.
    unfold insert_Var.
    destruct (compare (S k) 0) as [[h1|h1]|h1]; cbn.
    + exfalso; lia.
    + (* 0 = S k impossible *)
      exfalso; lia.
    + (* S k > 0: insert_Var w 0 (S k) = Var 0 *)
      cbn. unfold insert_Var. cbn. reflexivity.
  - (* 0 > i impossible *)
    exfalso; lia.
Qed.

Lemma subst_comp : forall X u w k,
  subst_rec (subst_rec X u 0) w k =
  subst_rec (subst_rec X w (S k)) (subst_rec u w k) 0.
Proof.
  induction X; intros u w k; simpl.
  - apply insert_var_comp.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Lemma lift_subst_comp : forall X w k,
  lift_rec (subst_rec X w k) 0 1 =
  subst_rec (lift_rec X 0 1) w (S k).
Proof.
  induction X; intros w k; simpl.
  - (* Var *)
    unfold insert_Var. unfold relocate.
    destruct (test 0 n) as [h|h]; cbn.
    + (* 0 <= n *)
      destruct (compare 0 n) as [[h0|h0]|h0]; cbn.
      * (* 0 < n *)
        unfold insert_Var.
        destruct (test (S k) (n+1)) as [h1|h1]; cbn.
        -- destruct (compare (S k) (n+1)) as [[h2|h2]|h2]; cbn.
           ++ (* S k < n+1: Var n *)
              unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 n) as [h3|h3]; cbn; reflexivity.
           ++ exfalso; lia.
           ++ exfalso; lia.
        -- exfalso; lia.
      * (* 0 = n *)
        subst n. cbn. unfold insert_Var. cbn.
        unfold insert_Var.
        destruct (compare (S k) 0) as [[h1|h1]|h1]; cbn.
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- exfalso; lia.
        -- cbn. unfold relocate. destruct (test 0 0) as [h2|h2]; cbn; reflexivity.
      * exfalso; lia.
    + exfalso; lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal; [apply IHX1 | apply IHX2].
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
  - f_equal. apply IHX.
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.

(* A syntactic certificate on reachable types. *)
Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

(*
   D1 reduces to the two admissibility (lift/subst closure) properties below.
   These are standard metatheorems about subtype; they are the only missing
   ingredient of this proof.  The theorem D1_from_closures is axiom-free.
*)

Lemma Good_stable :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact H ].
    apply sub_stem. exact d1.
  - (* sub_quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply stem_quant_lift. exact H.
  - (* sub_inst *) unfold subst. apply Hsubst. exact H.
  - (* sub_lift *) unfold lift. apply Hlift. exact H.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D1_from_closures :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst u ty d.
  exact (Good_stable Hlift Hsubst Leaf (Funty u ty) Logic.I d).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.

(* Certificate for D2: the head A is shifted by lift 1 under Quant binders. *)
Fixpoint Good2 (A S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => False
  | Funty a b => subtype (Fork A a) b
  | Quant Z => Good2 (lift 1 A) Z
  | Asf Z => Good2 A Z
  | Stem B => subtype A B
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good2_stable :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, subtype S T -> forall A, Good2 A S -> Good2 A T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T d. induction d; intros A HG; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, HG.
  - (* sub_stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HG | exact d ].
  - (* sub_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact HG.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact HG ].
    apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | exact d1 ].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply (IHd (lift 1 A)). exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift.
    + apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply fork_quant_lift. exact HG.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    pose proof (Hsubst (lift 1 A) ty u 0 HG) as X.
    change (Good2 (subst (lift 1 A) u) (subst ty u)) in X.
    rewrite subst_lift1 in X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    pose proof (Hlift A ty 0 1 HG) as X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    apply sub_fork.
    + exact HG.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact HG.
Qed.

Lemma D2_from_closures :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst A u ty d.
  exact (Good2_stable Hlift Hsubst (Stem A) (Funty u ty) d A (sub_zero A)).
Qed.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes.
Require Import exp7.
Require Import shape_lemmas.
Require Import d1_reduction.
Require Import d2_reduction.

(* Good is stable under lift, unconditionally. *)

Lemma Good_lift : forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (lift_subtype (Stem a) b H k n).
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Good2 is stable under a simultaneous lift of the head and the type. *)

Lemma Good2_lift :
  forall A S k n, Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  intros A S. revert A.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros A k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - (* Quant: the head is lifted by one inside the body as well. *)
    assert (E : lift_rec (lift 1 A) (S k) n = lift 1 (lift_rec A k n)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (lift_lift_gen A 0 (S k) 1 n ltac:(lia)) as Hll.
      replace (S k + 0) with (S k) in Hll by lia.
      replace (S k - 1) with k in Hll by lia.
      exact Hll. }
    rewrite <- E. apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (lift_subtype (Fork A a) b H k n).
  - exact H.
  - exact (lift_subtype A B H k n).
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* Hence the D1/D2 reductions only need the substitution closures. *)

Lemma D1_from_subst_closure :
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hsubst. apply D1_from_closures.
  - exact Good_lift.
  - exact Hsubst.
Qed.

Lemma D2_from_subst_closure :
  (forall A S w k, Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros Hsubst. apply D2_from_closures.
  - exact Good2_lift.
  - exact Hsubst.
Qed.

Definition test : forall n m : nat, {n <= m} + {n > m} := ltac:(simple induction n; simple induction m; simpl in |- *; auto with arith;

Definition relocate (i k n : nat) :=

Definition relocatek1 k i := relocate i k 1.

Fixpoint lift_rec (L : dtype) : nat -> nat -> dtype :=
  fun k n =>
  match L with
  | Var i => Var (relocate i k n)
  | Leaf => Leaf
  | Stem ty => Stem (lift_rec ty k n)

  | Funty ty1 ty2 => Funty (lift_rec ty1 k n) (lift_rec ty2 k n)
  | Quant ty => Quant (lift_rec ty (S k) n)
  | Asf ty => Asf (lift_rec ty k n)
  end.

Definition lift (n : nat) (ty : dtype) := lift_rec ty 0 n.

Definition insert_Var (N : dtype) (i k : nat) :=
  match compare k i with

Fixpoint subst_rec (L : dtype) : dtype -> nat -> dtype :=

  | Fork M M' => Fork (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)
  | Funty M M' => Funty (subst_rec M N k) (subst_rec M' N k)

  | Asf M => Asf (subst_rec M N k)

Definition subst (M N : dtype) := subst_rec M N 0.

(* Complete, unconditional proof of D1 and D2.

   Reuses the machine-checked infrastructure in /tmp/new/infra2.v
   (in particular subtype_subst_rec, subtype_lift_rec, and the de Bruijn
   commutation lemmas).  The type-indexed certificates Good / Good2 reduce
   D1/D2 to lift- and substitution-closure; both closures are now proved
   unconditionally, so D1/D2 follow with no extra hypotheses. *)

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes.
Load "/tmp/new/infra2.v".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D1 certificate                                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good_stable :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact H ].
    apply sub_stem. exact d1.
  - (* sub_quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply stem_quant_lift. exact H.
  - (* sub_inst *) unfold subst. apply Hsubst. exact H.
  - (* sub_lift *) unfold lift. apply Hlift. exact H.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Good_lift : forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (subtype_lift_rec (Stem a) b H k n).
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Good_subst : forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros w k H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (subtype_subst_rec (Stem a) b H w k).
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D1_unconditional :
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros u ty d.
  exact (Good_stable Good_lift Good_subst Leaf (Funty u ty) Logic.I d).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D2 certificate (head shifted by lift 1 under Quant binders)         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good2 (A S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => False
  | Funty a b => subtype (Fork A a) b
  | Quant Z => Good2 (lift 1 A) Z
  | Asf Z => Good2 A Z
  | Stem B => subtype A B
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good2_stable :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, subtype S T -> forall A, Good2 A S -> Good2 A T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T d. induction d; intros A HG; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, HG.
  - (* sub_stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HG | exact d ].
  - (* sub_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact HG.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact HG ].
    apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | exact d1 ].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply (IHd (lift 1 A)). exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift.
    + apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply fork_quant_lift. exact HG.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    pose proof (Hsubst (lift 1 A) ty u 0 HG) as X.
    change (Good2 (subst (lift 1 A) u) (subst ty u)) in X.
    rewrite subst_lift1 in X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    pose proof (Hlift A ty 0 1 HG) as X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    apply sub_fork.
    + exact HG.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact HG.
Qed.

Lemma Good2_lift :
  forall A S k n, Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  intros A S. revert A.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros A k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - (* Quant *)
    assert (E : lift_rec (lift 1 A) (S k) n = lift 1 (lift_rec A k n)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (lift_lift_subst_gen A 0 1 (S k) n ltac:(lia)) as Hll.
      replace (0 + S k) with (S k) in Hll by lia.
      replace (0 + S k - 1) with k in Hll by lia.
      exact Hll. }
    rewrite <- E. apply (IH (lift 1 A) (S k) n). exact H.
  - exact (subtype_lift_rec (Fork A a) b H k n).
  - exact H.
  - exact (subtype_lift_rec A B H k n).
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Good2_subst :
  forall A S w k,
    Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k).
Proof.
  intros A S. revert A.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros A w k H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - (* Quant: subst_rec (lift 1 A) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec A w k) *)
    assert (E : subst_rec (lift 1 A) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec A w k)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (subst_lift_gen A w 0 k 1 ltac:(lia)) as Hs.
      replace (k + 1) with (S k) in Hs by lia.
      exact Hs. }
    rewrite <- E. apply (IH (lift 1 A) w (S k)). exact H.
  - exact (subtype_subst_rec (Fork A a) b H w k).
  - exact H.
  - exact (subtype_subst_rec A B H w k).
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D2_unconditional :
  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros A u ty d.
  exact (Good2_stable Good2_lift Good2_subst (Stem A) (Funty u ty) d A (sub_zero A)).
Qed.

(* Complete, unconditional proof of D1 and D2.

   Reuses the machine-checked infrastructure in /tmp/new/infra2.v
   (in particular subtype_subst_rec, subtype_lift_rec, and the de Bruijn

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes.
Load "/tmp/new/infra2.v".
Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D1 certificate                                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good_stable :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
===
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D1_unconditional :
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros u ty d.
  exact (Good_stable Good_lift Good_subst Leaf (Funty u ty) Logic.I d).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D2 certificate (head shifted by lift 1 under Quant binders)         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good2 (A S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => False
  | Funty a b => subtype (Fork A a) b
  | Quant Z => Good2 (lift 1 A) Z
  | Asf Z => Good2 A Z
  | Stem B => subtype A B
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good2_stable :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, subtype S T -> forall A, Good2 A S -> Good2 A T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T d. induction d; intros A HG; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, HG.
  - (* sub_stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HG | exact d ].
  - (* sub_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact HG.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact HG ].
    apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | exact d1 ].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply (IHd (lift 1 A)). exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift.
    + apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply fork_quant_lift. exact HG.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    pose proof (Hsubst (lift 1 A) ty u 0 HG) as X.
    change (Good2 (subst (lift 1 A) u) (subst ty u)) in X.
    rewrite subst_lift1 in X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    pose proof (Hlift A ty 0 1 HG) as X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    apply sub_fork.
    + exact HG.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact HG.
Qed.

Lemma Good2_lift :
  forall A S k n, Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  intros A S. revert A.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros A k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - (* Quant *)
    assert (E : lift_rec (lift 1 A) (S k) n = lift 1 (lift_rec A k n)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (lift_lift_subst_gen A 0 1 (S k) n ltac:(lia)) as Hll.
      replace (0 + S k) with (S k) in Hll by lia.
      replace (S k - 1) with k in Hll by lia.
      exact Hll. }
    rewrite <- E. apply (IH (lift 1 A) (S k) n). exact H.
  - exact (subtype_lift_rec (Fork A a) b H k n).
  - exact H.
  - exact (subtype_lift_rec A B H k n).
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Good2_subst :
  forall A S w k,
    Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k).
Proof.
  intros A S. revert A.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros A w k H; simpl in *.
  - exfalso. exact H.
  - (* Quant: subst_rec (lift 1 A) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec A w k) *)
    assert (E : subst_rec (lift 1 A) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec A w k)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (subst_lift_gen A w 0 k 1 ltac:(lia)) as Hs.
      replace (k + 1) with (S k) in Hs by lia.
      exact Hs. }
    rewrite <- E. apply (IH (lift 1 A) w (S k)). exact H.
  - exact (subtype_subst_rec (Fork A a) b H w k).
  - exact H.
  - exact (subtype_subst_rec A B H w k).
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D2_unconditional :
  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros A u ty d.
  exact (Good2_stable Good2_lift Good2_subst (Stem A) (Funty u ty) d A (sub_zero A)).
Qed.

(* The two application lemmas used by Task.v, now unconditional. *)

Lemma subtype_leaf_app :
  forall A u ty,
    subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype A u ->
    subtype (Stem A) ty.
Proof.
  intros A u ty Hleaf HAu.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_stem. exact HAu.
  - apply D1_unconditional. exact Hleaf.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_app :
  forall A B u ty,
    subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) ->
    subtype B u ->
    subtype (Fork A B) ty.
Proof.
  intros A B u ty Hstem HBu.
  eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_fork.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + exact HBu.
  - apply D2_unconditional. exact Hstem.
Qed.

.

Notation "△" := Node : tree_scope.

Notation "x @ y" := (App x y) (at level 65, left associativity) : tree_scope.

Definition K := △ @ △.

Definition S1 x := △ @ (△@x).

Definition Sop := S1 (K @ Node) @ Node.

Definition I := S1 K @ K.

Definition KI := K@I.

Inductive program : Tree -> Prop :=
| pr_leaf : program △
| pr_stem : forall M, program M -> program (△ @ M)
| pr_fork : forall M N, program M -> program N -> program (△ @ M@ N)
.

Inductive t_red1 : Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
| k_red : forall y z, t_red1 (△ @ △ @ y @ z) y
| s_red: forall (x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ x) @ y @ z) (x @ z @ (y @ z))
| leaf_red: forall (w x y : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ Node) w
| stem_red: forall (w x y z : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z)) (x @ z)
| fork_red: forall (w x y z1 z2 : Tree), t_red1 (△ @ (△ @ w @ x) @ y @ (Node @ z1 @ z2)) (y @ z1 @ z2)
| appl_red : forall M M' N, t_red1 M M' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M'@N)
| appr_red : forall M N N', t_red1 N N' -> t_red1 (M@N) (M@N')
.

Inductive multi_step : (Tree -> Tree -> Prop) -> Tree -> Tree -> Prop :=
  | zero_red : forall red M, multi_step red M M
  | succ_red : forall (red: Tree-> Tree -> Prop) M N P,
                   red M N -> multi_step red N P -> multi_step red M P
.

Definition t_red := multi_step t_red1.

Definition transitive red := forall (M N P: Tree), red M N -> red N P -> red M P.

Definition preserves_appl (red : Tree -> Tree -> Prop) :=
forall M N M', red M M' -> red (M@N) (M'@ N).

Definition preserves_appr (red : Tree -> Tree -> Prop) :=
forall M N N', red N N' -> red (M@N) (M@N').

Definition preserves_app (red : Tree -> Tree -> Prop) :=
forall M M', red M M' -> forall N N', red N N' -> red (M@N) (M'@N').

Fixpoint substitute M x N :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => if eqb x y then N else Ref y
  | △ => △
  | M1 @ M2 => (substitute M1 x N) @ (substitute M2 x N)
end.

Fixpoint bracket x M :=
match M with
| Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
| △ => K@ △
| App M1 M2 => S1 (bracket x M1) @ (bracket x M2)
end
.

Fixpoint occurs x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y => eqb x y
  | △ => false
  | M1@ M2 => (occurs x M1) || (occurs x M2)
  end.

Fixpoint star x M :=
  match M with
  | Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))

.

| active_ref: forall x, active (Ref x)

.

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.

Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Open Scope string_scope.

Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* A small hint database for the subtyping and typing rules. *)
Create HintDb triage.

Hint Constructors subtype : triage.
Hint Constructors derive : triage.
Hint Constructors program : triage.

(* Applications of a leaf and of a stem. *)
Lemma subtype_leaf_app: forall A u ty,
  subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype A u ->
  subtype (Stem A) ty.
Proof.
  intros. eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_app: forall A B u ty,
  subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype B u ->
  subtype (Fork A B) ty.
Proof.
  intros. eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Hint Resolve subtype_leaf_app subtype_stem_app : triage.

(* A typing of a stem at a function type is principal at the
   corresponding stem type. *)
Lemma stem_fun_principal: forall M gamma u ty,
  program M ->
  (forall gamma ty, derive gamma M ty -> subtype (program_type M) ty) ->
  derive gamma (Node @ M) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype (Stem (program_type M)) (Funty u ty).
Proof.
  intros M gamma u ty Hp IH Hd.
  inversion Hd; subst.
  inversion H3; subst.
  pose proof (IH _ _ H5) as HA.
  eauto 15 with triage.
Qed.

Hint Resolve stem_fun_principal : triage.

Theorem programs_have_types: forall p gamma, program p -> derive gamma p (program_type p).
Proof.
  intros p gamma Hp. induction Hp.
  - simpl. eauto 10 with triage.
  - simpl. eauto 12 with triage.
  - simpl. eauto 20 with triage.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_principal_types:
  forall p, program p ->
            forall gamma ty, derive gamma p ty -> subtype (program_type p) ty.
Proof.
  intros p Hp. induction Hp; intros gamma ty Hd.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst. eauto with triage.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst. inversion H3; subst.
    pose proof (IHHp _ _ H5) as HA.
    eauto 15 with triage.
  - simpl. inversion Hd; subst.
    pose proof (IHHp1 _ _ H5) as HM.
    pose proof (IHHp2 _ _ H4) as HN.
    eauto 20 with triage.
Qed.

1	(* Complete, unconditional proof of D1 and D2.
2	
3	   Reuses the machine-checked infrastructure in /tmp/new/infra2.v
4	   (in particular subtype_subst_rec, subtype_lift_rec, and the de Bruijn
5	   commutation lemmas).  The type-indexed certificates Good / Good2 reduce
6	   D1/D2 to lift- and substitution-closure; both closures are now proved
7	   unconditionally, so D1/D2 follow with no extra hypotheses. *)
8	
9	Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
10	Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes.
11	Load "/tmp/new/infra2.v".
12	Open Scope string_scope.
13	Open Scope nat_scope.
14	
15	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
16	
17	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
18	(* D1 certificate                                                      *)
19	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
20	
21	Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
22	  match S with
23	  | Leaf => True
24	  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
25	  | Quant Z => Good Z
26	  | Asf Z => Good Z
27	  | Stem _ => False
28	  | Fork _ _ => False
29	  | Var _ => False
30	  end.
31	
32	Lemma Good_stable :
33	  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
34	  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
35	  forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
36	Proof.
37	  intros Hlift Hsubst S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
38	  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
39	  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
40	  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
41	  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
42	  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
43	  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
44	    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact H ].
45	    apply sub_stem. exact d1.
46	  - (* sub_quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
47	  - (* sub_quant_stem *) exact H.
48	  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exact H.
49	  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact H.
50	  - (* sub_dist *) apply stem_quant_lift. exact H.
51	  - (* sub_inst *) unfold subst. apply Hsubst. exact H.
52	  - (* sub_lift *) unfold lift. apply Hlift. exact H.
53	  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
54	  - (* sub_stem_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
55	  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
56	  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
57	  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
58	  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
59	  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
60	  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact H.
61	  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact H.
62	  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact H.
63	  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact H.
64	  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
65	  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
66	Qed.
67	
68	Lemma Good_lift : forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n).
69	Proof.
70	  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
71	    intros k n H; simpl in *.
72	  - exact H.
73	  - apply IH. exact H.
74	  - exact (subtype_lift_rec (Stem a) b H k n).
75	  - exact Logic.I.
76	  - exact H.
77	  - exact H.
78	  - apply IH. exact H.
79	Qed.
80	
81	Lemma Good_subst : forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k).
82	Proof.
83	  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
84	    intros w k H; simpl in *.
85	  - exfalso. exact H.
86	  - apply IH. exact H.
87	  - exact (subtype_subst_rec (Stem a) b H w k).
88	  - exact Logic.I.
89	  - exact H.
90	  - exact H.
91	  - apply IH. exact H.
92	Qed.
93	
94	Lemma D1_unconditional :
95	  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
96	Proof.
97	  intros u ty d.
98	  exact (Good_stable Good_lift Good_subst Leaf (Funty u ty) Logic.I d).
99	Qed.
100	
101	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
102	(* D2 certificate (head shifted by lift 1 under Quant binders)         *)
103	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
104	
105	Fixpoint Good2 (A S : dtype) : Prop :=
106	  match S with
107	  | Leaf => False
108	  | Funty a b => subtype (Fork A a) b
109	  | Quant Z => Good2 (lift 1 A) Z
110	  | Asf Z => Good2 A Z
111	  | Stem B => subtype A B
112	  | Fork _ _ => False
113	  | Var _ => False
114	  end.
115	
116	Lemma Good2_stable :
117	  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
118	      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
119	  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
120	      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
121	  forall S T, subtype S T -> forall A, Good2 A S -> Good2 A T.
122	Proof.
123	  intros Hlift Hsubst S T d. induction d; intros A HG; simpl in *.
124	  - (* sub_zero *) exact HG.
125	  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, HG.
126	  - (* sub_stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HG | exact d ].
127	  - (* sub_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
128	  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact HG.
129	  - (* sub_funty *)
130	    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
131	    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact HG ].
132	    apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | exact d1 ].
133	  - (* sub_quant *) apply (IHd (lift 1 A)). exact HG.
134	  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
135	    eapply sub_trans.
136	    + apply sub_lift.
137	    + apply sub_quant. exact HG.
138	  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
139	  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact HG.
140	  - (* sub_dist *) apply fork_quant_lift. exact HG.
141	  - (* sub_inst *)
142	    pose proof (Hsubst (lift 1 A) ty u 0 HG) as X.
143	    change (Good2 (subst (lift 1 A) u) (subst ty u)) in X.
144	    rewrite subst_lift1 in X.
145	    exact X.
146	  - (* sub_lift *)
147	    pose proof (Hlift A ty 0 1 HG) as X.
148	    exact X.
149	  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact HG.
150	  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
151	    apply sub_fork.
152	    + exact HG.
153	    + apply sub_zero.
154	  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
155	  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
156	  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
157	  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
158	  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
159	  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact HG.
160	  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact HG.
161	  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact HG.
162	  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact HG.
163	  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact HG.
164	  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact HG.
165	Qed.
166	
167	Lemma Good2_lift :
168	  forall A S k n, Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n).
169	Proof.
170	  intros A S. revert A.
171	  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
172	    intros A k n H; simpl in *.
173	  - exact H.
174	  - (* Quant *)
175	    assert (E : lift_rec (lift 1 A) (S k) n = lift 1 (lift_rec A k n)).
176	    { unfold lift.
177	      pose proof (lift_lift_subst_gen A 0 1 (S k) n ltac:(lia)) as Hll.
178	      replace (0 + S k) with (S k) in Hll by lia.
179	      replace (S k - 1) with k in Hll by lia.
180	      exact Hll. }
181	    rewrite <- E. apply (IH (lift 1 A) (S k) n). exact H.
182	  - exact (subtype_lift_rec (Fork A a) b H k n).
183	  - exact H.
184	  - exact (subtype_lift_rec A B H k n).
185	  - exact H.
186	  - apply IH. exact H.
187	Qed.
188	
189	Lemma Good2_subst :
190	  forall A S w k,
191	    Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k).
192	Proof.
193	  intros A S. revert A.
194	  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
195	    intros A w k H; simpl in *.
196	  - exfalso. exact H.
197	  - (* Quant: subst_rec (lift 1 A) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec A w k) *)
198	    assert (E : subst_rec (lift 1 A) w (S k) = lift 1 (subst_rec A w k)).
199	    { unfold lift.
200	      pose proof (subst_lift_gen A w 0 k 1 ltac:(lia)) as Hs.
201	      replace (k + 1) with (S k) in Hs by lia.
202	      exact Hs. }
203	    rewrite <- E. apply (IH (lift 1 A) w (S k)). exact H.
204	  - exact (subtype_subst_rec (Fork A a) b H w k).
205	  - exact H.
206	  - exact (subtype_subst_rec A B H w k).
207	  - exact H.
208	  - apply IH. exact H.
209	Qed.
210	
211	Lemma D2_unconditional :
212	  forall A u ty, subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
213	Proof.
214	  intros A u ty d.
215	  exact (Good2_stable Good2_lift Good2_subst (Stem A) (Funty u ty) d A (sub_zero A)).
216	Qed.
217	
218	(* The two application lemmas used by Task.v, now unconditional. *)
219	
220	Lemma subtype_leaf_app :
221	  forall A u ty,
222	    subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) ->
223	    subtype A u ->
224	    subtype (Stem A) ty.
225	Proof.
226	  intros A u ty Hleaf HAu.
227	  eapply sub_trans.
228	  - apply sub_stem. exact HAu.
229	  - apply D1_unconditional. exact Hleaf.
230	Qed.
231	
232	Lemma subtype_stem_app :
233	  forall A B u ty,
234	    subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) ->
235	    subtype B u ->
236	    subtype (Fork A B) ty.
237	Proof.
238	  intros A B u ty Hstem HBu.
239	  eapply sub_trans.
240	  - apply sub_fork.
241	    + apply sub_zero.
242	    + exact HBu.
243	  - apply D2_unconditional. exact Hstem.
244	Qed.

2	Require Import Triage.terms Triage.types Triage.subtypes Triage.derive.
3	Open Scope string_scope. Open Scope nat_scope. Open Scope tree_scope.
4	Set Default Proof Using "Type".
5	
6	Ltac crush_tests :=
7	  repeat match goal with
8	  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
9	  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
10	  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
11	  end;
12	  try reflexivity; try (f_equal; lia); lia.
13	
14	(* 1. relocate under two lifts *)
15	Lemma relocate_lift_gen : forall ii bb kk jj nn,
16	  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
17	  relocate (relocate ii bb kk) jj nn = relocate ii bb (kk+nn).
18	Proof. intros. unfold relocate. crush_tests. Qed.
19	
20	(* 2. lift; lift with same cutoff *)
21	Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_gen : forall ww bb kk jj nn,
22	  bb <= jj -> jj <= bb + kk ->
23	  lift_rec (lift_rec ww bb kk) jj nn = lift_rec ww bb (kk+nn).
24	Proof.
25	  induction ww; intros bb kk jj nn Hbj HbK; simpl.
26	  - f_equal. apply relocate_lift_gen; assumption.
27	  - f_equal. apply (IHww (S bb) kk (S jj) nn); lia.
28	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHww1 bb kk jj nn); assumption | apply (IHww2 bb kk jj nn); assumption ].
29	  - reflexivity.
30	  - f_equal. apply (IHww bb kk jj nn); assumption.
31	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHww1 bb kk jj nn); assumption | apply (IHww2 bb kk jj nn); assumption ].
32	  - f_equal. apply (IHww bb kk jj nn); assumption.
33	Qed.
34	
35	Lemma lift_rec_lift_rec_0 : forall ww kk nn,
36	  lift_rec (lift_rec ww 0 kk) 0 nn = lift_rec ww 0 (kk+nn).
37	Proof. intros. apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia. Qed.
38	
39	(* 3. lift by zero *)
40	Lemma lift_rec_zero : forall ww kk, lift_rec ww kk 0 = ww.
41	Proof.
42	  induction ww; intros kk; simpl.
43	  - unfold relocate. destruct (test kk n); reflexivity.
44	  - f_equal. apply IHww.
45	  - f_equal; [apply IHww1 | apply IHww2].
46	  - reflexivity.
47	  - f_equal. apply IHww.
48	  - f_equal; [apply IHww1 | apply IHww2].
49	  - f_equal. apply IHww.
50	Qed.
51	
52	Lemma lift_zero : forall ww, lift 0 ww = ww.
53	Proof. intros. unfold lift. apply lift_rec_zero. Qed.
54	
55	(* 4. insert under a lift *)
56	Lemma insert_lift_gen : forall ww ii jj kk nn,
57	  jj <= kk ->
58	  insert_Var ww (relocate ii jj nn) (kk+nn) =
59	  lift_rec (insert_Var ww ii kk) jj nn.
60	Proof.
61	  intros ww ii jj kk nn Hjk.
62	  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
63	  repeat match goal with
64	  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
65	  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
66	  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
67	  end.
68	  all: try reflexivity.
69	  all: try (unfold lift; symmetry; apply lift_rec_lift_rec_gen; lia).
70	  all: try (rewrite !lift_zero; reflexivity).
71	  all: cbn [lift_rec]; unfold relocate; crush_tests.
72	Qed.
73	
74	(* 5. generalized insert under lift (needed for lift-subst) *)
75	Lemma lift_lift_subst_gen : forall XX bb jj kk nn,
76	  jj <= kk ->
77	  lift_rec (lift_rec XX bb jj) (bb+kk) nn =
78	  lift_rec (lift_rec XX (bb+kk-jj) nn) bb jj.
79	Proof.
80	  induction XX; intros bb jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
81	  - unfold relocate. crush_tests.
82	  - f_equal.
83	    replace (S (bb + kk)) with (S bb + kk) by lia.
84	    replace (S (bb + kk - jj)) with (S bb + kk - jj) by lia.
85	    apply (IHXX (S bb) jj kk nn); assumption.
86	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 bb jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 bb jj kk nn); assumption ].
87	  - reflexivity.
88	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX bb jj kk nn); assumption.
89	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 bb jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 bb jj kk nn); assumption ].
90	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX bb jj kk nn); assumption.
91	Qed.
92	
93	Lemma lift_insert_gen : forall uu ii jj kk nn,
94	  jj <= kk ->
95	  lift_rec (insert_Var uu ii jj) kk nn =
96	  insert_Var (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) (relocate ii (S kk) nn) jj.
97	Proof.
98	  intros uu ii jj kk nn Hjk.
99	  unfold insert_Var, relocate.
100	  repeat match goal with
101	  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
102	  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
103	  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
104	  end.
105	  all: try reflexivity.
106	  all: try (rewrite !lift_zero; reflexivity).
107	  all: try (rewrite (lift_rec_zero uu 0); rewrite (lift_rec_zero (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) 0); reflexivity).
108	  all: try (unfold lift; cbn [lift_rec relocate]; crush_tests).
109	  all: try (cbn [lift_rec]; unfold relocate; crush_tests).
110	  all: try (unfold lift; exact (lift_lift_subst_gen uu 0 jj kk nn Hjk)).
111	Qed.
112	
113	(* 6. B_gen: substitution into a lifted term *)
114	Lemma subst_lift_gen : forall XX ww jj kk nn,
115	  jj <= kk ->
116	  subst_rec (lift_rec XX jj nn) ww (kk+nn) =
117	  lift_rec (subst_rec XX ww kk) jj nn.
118	Proof.
119	  induction XX; intros ww jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
120	  - apply insert_lift_gen; assumption.
121	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww (S jj) (S kk) nn); lia.
122	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 ww jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 ww jj kk nn); assumption ].
123	  - reflexivity.
124	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww jj kk nn); assumption.
125	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 ww jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 ww jj kk nn); assumption ].
126	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX ww jj kk nn); assumption.
127	Qed.
128	
129	(* 7. C_gen: swapping two lifts *)
130	Lemma lift_lift_gen : forall XX jj kk mm nn,
131	  jj <= kk ->
132	  lift_rec (lift_rec XX jj mm) (kk+mm) nn =
133	  lift_rec (lift_rec XX kk nn) jj mm.
134	Proof.
135	  induction XX; intros jj kk mm nn Hjk; simpl.
136	  - unfold relocate. crush_tests.
137	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX (S jj) (S kk) mm nn); lia.
138	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 jj kk mm nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 jj kk mm nn); assumption ].
139	  - reflexivity.
140	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX jj kk mm nn); assumption.
141	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 jj kk mm nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 jj kk mm nn); assumption ].
142	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX jj kk mm nn); assumption.
143	Qed.
144	
145	(* 8. J: generalized lift of a substitution *)
146	Lemma lift_subst_gen : forall XX uu jj kk nn,
147	  jj <= kk ->
148	  lift_rec (subst_rec XX uu jj) kk nn =
149	  subst_rec (lift_rec XX (S kk) nn) (lift_rec uu (kk-jj) nn) jj.
150	Proof.
151	  induction XX; intros uu jj kk nn Hjk; simpl.
152	  - apply lift_insert_gen; assumption.
153	  - f_equal.
154	    replace ((S kk) - (S jj)) with (kk - jj) by lia.
155	    apply (IHXX uu (S jj) (S kk) nn); lia.
156	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu jj kk nn); assumption ].
157	  - reflexivity.
158	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu jj kk nn); assumption.
159	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu jj kk nn); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu jj kk nn); assumption ].
160	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu jj kk nn); assumption.
161	Qed.

163	(* 9. substitution into a lift, below the lifted region *)
164	Lemma subst_lift_low : forall XX NN bb jj cc,
165	  bb <= jj -> jj < bb + cc ->
166	  subst_rec (lift_rec XX bb cc) NN jj = lift_rec XX bb (cc-1).
167	Proof.
168	  induction XX; intros NN bb jj cc Hbj HbC; simpl.
169	  - (* Var *) simpl. unfold relocate, insert_Var. crush_tests.
170	  - (* Quant *) f_equal. apply (IHXX NN (S bb) (S jj) cc); lia.
171	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 NN bb jj cc); assumption | apply (IHXX2 NN bb jj cc); assumption ].
172	  - reflexivity.
173	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX NN bb jj cc); assumption.
174	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 NN bb jj cc); assumption | apply (IHXX2 NN bb jj cc); assumption ].
175	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX NN bb jj cc); assumption.
176	Qed.

178	Lemma insert_Var_same : forall NN ii, insert_Var NN ii ii = lift ii NN.
179	Proof.
180	  intros NN ii. unfold insert_Var.
181	  destruct (compare ii ii) as [[h|h]|h]; try (exfalso; lia); reflexivity.
182	Qed.

184	Lemma insert_subst_gen : forall uu ww ii jj kk,
185	  jj <= kk ->
186	  subst_rec (insert_Var uu ii jj) ww kk =
187	  subst_rec (insert_Var ww ii (S kk)) (subst_rec uu ww (kk-jj)) jj.
188	Proof.
189	  intros uu ww ii jj kk Hjk.
190	  unfold insert_Var.
191	  repeat match goal with
192	  | |- context[if ?c then _ else _] => destruct c
193	  | |- context[match ?c with left _ => _ | right _ => _ end] => destruct c
194	  | |- context[match compare ?a ?b with _ => _ end] => destruct (compare a b) as [[?|?]|?]
195	  end.
196	  all: try reflexivity.
197	  all: try (subst ii; simpl; rewrite insert_Var_same; unfold lift;
198	            rewrite (subst_lift_low ww (subst_rec uu ww (kk-jj)) 0 jj (S kk)); [|lia|lia];
199	            replace (S kk - 1) with kk by lia; reflexivity).
200	  all: try (subst ii; simpl; rewrite insert_Var_same; unfold lift;
201	            replace kk with ((kk-jj)+jj) by lia;
202	            replace (((kk-jj)+jj)-jj) with (kk-jj) by lia;
203	            apply subst_lift_gen; lia).
204	  all: try (simpl; unfold insert_Var, relocate; crush_tests).
205	Qed.

207	Lemma subst_subst_gen : forall XX uu ww jj kk,
208	  jj <= kk ->
209	  subst_rec (subst_rec XX uu jj) ww kk =
210	  subst_rec (subst_rec XX ww (S kk)) (subst_rec uu ww (kk-jj)) jj.
211	Proof.
212	  induction XX; intros uu ww jj kk Hjk; simpl.
213	  - apply insert_subst_gen; assumption.
214	  - f_equal.
215	    replace ((S kk) - (S jj)) with (kk - jj) by lia.
216	    apply (IHXX uu ww (S jj) (S kk)); lia.
217	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu ww jj kk); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu ww jj kk); assumption ].
218	  - reflexivity.
219	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu ww jj kk); assumption.
220	  - f_equal; [ apply (IHXX1 uu ww jj kk); assumption | apply (IHXX2 uu ww jj kk); assumption ].
221	  - f_equal. apply (IHXX uu ww jj kk); assumption.
222	Qed.

224	(* variant preservation infrastructure *)
225	
226	Lemma variant_lift_rec_true : forall uu pos lev cut ee,
227	  lev < cut -> variant pos (lev+ee) (lift_rec uu ee cut) = true.
228	Proof.
229	  induction uu as [ n | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | uu IH ];
230	    intros pos lev cut ee Hlt; simpl.
231	  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
232	    destruct (test ee n) as [h|h].
233	    + destruct (lev+ee =? cut+n) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
234	      apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. exfalso; lia.
235	    + destruct (lev+ee =? n) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
236	      apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. exfalso; lia.
237	  - (* Quant *) replace (S (lev+ee)) with (lev + S ee) by lia.
238	    apply (IH pos lev cut (S ee)); lia.
239	  - (* Funty *) apply andb_true_intro; split.
240	    + apply (IH1 (negb pos) lev cut ee); assumption.
241	    + apply (IH2 pos lev cut ee); assumption.
242	  - reflexivity.
243	  - apply IH; assumption.
244	  - apply andb_true_intro; split.
245	    + apply (IH1 pos lev cut ee); assumption.
246	    + apply (IH2 pos lev cut ee); assumption.
247	  - apply IH; assumption.
248	Qed.
249	
250	Lemma variant_lift_rec_pres : forall uu pos lev ee cut,
251	  lev < ee -> variant pos lev uu = true ->
252	  variant pos lev (lift_rec uu ee cut) = true.
253	Proof.
254	  induction uu as [ n | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | | uu IH | uu1 IH1 uu2 IH2 | uu IH ];
255	    intros pos lev ee cut Hlt Hv; simpl in *.
256	  - (* Var *) unfold relocate.
257	    destruct (test ee n) as [h|h].
258	    + (* ee <= n : index n+cut; lev<> n+cut *)
259	      destruct (lev =? (cut+n)) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
260	      apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. exfalso; lia.
261	    + exact Hv.
262	  - (* Quant *) apply (IH pos (S lev) (S ee) cut); [lia | assumption].
263	  - (* Funty *) apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
264	    apply andb_true_intro; split.
265	    + apply (IH1 (negb pos) lev ee cut); assumption.
266	    + apply (IH2 pos lev ee cut); assumption.
267	  - reflexivity.
268	  - apply IH; assumption.
269	  - apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
270	    apply andb_true_intro; split.
271	    + apply (IH1 pos lev ee cut); assumption.
272	    + apply (IH2 pos lev ee cut); assumption.
273	  - apply IH; assumption.
274	Qed.

276	Lemma variant_subst_rec : forall ty pos lev uu cc,
277	  lev < cc -> variant pos lev ty = true ->
278	  variant pos lev (subst_rec ty uu cc) = true.
279	Proof.
280	  induction ty as [ n | ty IH | ty1 IH1 ty2 IH2 | | ty IH | ty1 IH1 ty2 IH2 | ty IH ];
281	    intros pos lev uu cc Hlt Hv; simpl in *.
282	  - (* Var *) unfold insert_Var.
283	    destruct (compare cc n) as [[hlt|heq]|hgt].
284	    + (* cc < n *) simpl.
285	      destruct (lev =? Nat.pred n) eqn:E; [|reflexivity].
286	      apply Nat.eqb_eq in E. exfalso; lia.
287	    + (* cc = n *) subst n.
288	      (* goal: variant pos lev (lift cc uu) = true; unfold lift *)
289	      unfold lift.
290	      assert (H := variant_lift_rec_true uu pos lev cc 0 ltac:(lia)).
291	      replace (lev + 0) with lev in H by lia.
292	      exact H.
293	    + exact Hv.
294	  - (* Quant *) apply (IH pos (S lev) uu (S cc)); [lia | assumption].
295	  - (* Funty *) apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
296	    apply andb_true_intro; split.
297	    + apply (IH1 (negb pos) lev uu cc); assumption.
298	    + apply (IH2 pos lev uu cc); assumption.
299	  - reflexivity.
300	  - apply IH; assumption.
301	  - apply andb_true_iff in Hv. destruct Hv as [H1 H2].
302	    apply andb_true_intro; split.
303	    + apply (IH1 pos lev uu cc); assumption.
304	    + apply (IH2 pos lev uu cc); assumption.
305	  - apply IH; assumption.
306	Qed.

308	Lemma covariant_subst_S : forall ty uu kk,
309	  covariant ty -> covariant (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)).
310	Proof.
311	  intros ty uu kk H. unfold covariant in *.
312	  apply (variant_subst_rec ty true 0 uu (S kk)); [lia | assumption].
313	Qed.
314	
315	Lemma covariant_lift_S : forall ty kk mm,
316	  covariant ty -> covariant (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm).
317	Proof.
318	  intros ty kk mm H. unfold covariant in *.
319	  apply (variant_lift_rec_pres ty true 0 (S kk) mm); [lia | assumption].
320	Qed.

322	Definition tree_src (ty : dtype) : dtype :=
323	  Fork
324	    (Fork (subst ty Leaf)
325	          (quant 1 (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0))))))
326	    (quant 2
327	       (Funty (Var 1)
328	              (Funty (Var 0) (subst (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)))))).
329	
330	Lemma insert_Var_lt : forall uu ii cc, ii < cc -> insert_Var uu ii cc = Var ii.
331	Proof.
332	  intros uu ii cc H. unfold insert_Var.
333	  destruct (compare cc ii) as [[h|h]|h]; try (exfalso; lia); reflexivity.
334	Qed.
335	
336	Lemma tree_src_subst : forall ty uu kk,
337	  subst_rec (tree_src ty) uu kk = tree_src (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)).
338	Proof.
339	  intros ty uu kk. unfold tree_src. simpl.
340	  repeat rewrite insert_Var_lt by lia.
341	  unfold subst.
342	  rewrite (subst_subst_gen ty Leaf uu 0 kk); [|lia].
343	  replace (kk-0) with kk by lia.
344	  rewrite (subst_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0)) uu 0 (S kk)); [|lia].
345	  replace ((S kk)-0) with (S kk) by lia.
346	  rewrite (subst_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) uu 0 (S (S kk))); [|lia].
347	  replace ((S (S kk))-0) with (S (S kk)) by lia.
348	  assert (H2 : subst_rec (lift_rec ty 1 1) uu (S (S kk)) =
349	               lift_rec (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)) 1 1).
350	  { replace (S (S kk)) with ((S kk)+1) by lia.
351	    apply (subst_lift_gen ty uu 1 (S kk) 1); lia. }
352	  rewrite H2.
353	  assert (H3 : subst_rec (lift_rec ty 1 2) uu (S (S (S kk))) =
354	               lift_rec (subst_rec ty uu (S kk)) 1 2).
355	  { replace (S (S (S kk))) with ((S kk)+2) by lia.
356	    apply (subst_lift_gen ty uu 1 (S kk) 2); lia. }
357	  rewrite H3.
358	  simpl.
359	  repeat rewrite insert_Var_lt by lia.
360	  reflexivity.
361	Qed.
362	
363	Lemma tree_src_lift : forall ty kk mm,
364	  lift_rec (tree_src ty) kk mm = tree_src (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm).
365	Proof.
366	  intros ty kk mm. unfold tree_src. simpl.
367	  unfold subst.
368	  rewrite (lift_subst_gen ty Leaf 0 kk mm); [|lia].
369	  replace (kk-0) with kk by lia.
370	  rewrite (lift_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 1) (Stem (Var 0)) 0 (S kk) mm); [|lia].
371	  replace ((S kk)-0) with (S kk) by lia.
372	  rewrite (lift_subst_gen (lift_rec ty 1 2) (Fork (Var 1) (Var 0)) 0 (S (S kk)) mm); [|lia].
373	  replace ((S (S kk))-0) with (S (S kk)) by lia.
374	  assert (H2 : lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 1) (S (S kk)) mm =
375	               lift_rec (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm) 1 1).
376	  { replace (S (S kk)) with ((S kk)+1) by lia.
377	    apply (lift_lift_gen ty 1 (S kk) 1 mm); lia. }
378	  rewrite H2.
379	  assert (H3 : lift_rec (lift_rec ty 1 2) (S (S (S kk))) mm =
380	               lift_rec (lift_rec ty (S kk) mm) 1 2).
381	  { replace (S (S (S kk))) with ((S kk)+2) by lia.
382	    apply (lift_lift_gen ty 1 (S kk) 2 mm); lia. }
383	  rewrite H3.
384	  simpl.
385	  reflexivity.
386	Qed.
