410	Lemma subtype_subst_rec : forall XX YY, subtype XX YY ->
411	  forall uu kk, subtype (subst_rec XX uu kk) (subst_rec YY uu kk).
412	Proof.
413	  intros XX YY H.
414	  induction H as
415	  [ ty
416	  | ty1 ty2 ty3 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
417	  | uty1 uty2 h IH
418	  | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
419	  | uty1 uty2 h IH
420	  | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
421	  | vty1 vty2 h IH
422	  | uty
423	  | uty vty
424	  | uty
425	  | uty vty
426	  | ty u0
427	  | ty
428	  | uty
429	  | uty vty
430	  | uty vty
431	  | uty vty wty
432	  | uty vty wty
433	  | uty vty1 vty2 wty
434	  | uty vty wty1 wty2 wty3
435	  | kR uty vty
436	  | ty uty Hcov
437	  | ty
438	  | uty vty
439	  | uty vty
440	  | uty vty wty
441	  ]; intros uu kk; simpl.
442	  - apply sub_zero.
443	  - eapply sub_trans; [ apply (IH1 uu kk) | apply (IH2 uu kk) ].

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Load "/tmp/new/infra2.v".

Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Set Default Proof Using "Type".

(* Certificate for D2.  A is the fixed head type.  For a type X we store
   the datum needed to consume X as a function type.  The quantifier case
   shifts the head by [lift 1], exactly as de Bruijn lifting does when a
   derivation goes under a quantifier. *)
Fixpoint CertS (A X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Leaf => False
  | Stem B => subtype A B
  | Funty u v => subtype (Fork A u) v
  | Quant Z => CertS (lift 1 A) Z
  | Asf Z => CertS A Z
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

(* Lifting a certificate at amount 1, for an arbitrary cutoff.  The head is
   assumed stable under lifting by one at every cutoff. *)
Lemma CertS_lift : forall A,
  (forall k, lift_rec A k 1 = A) ->
  forall X k, CertS A X -> CertS A (lift_rec X k 1).
Proof.
  intros A HA X.
  induction X as [ n | Z IH | u v IHu IHv | | B IH | u v IHu IHv | Z IH ];
    intros k HC; cbn [CertS] in *.
  - (* Var *) exact HC.
  - (* Quant *)
    cbn [lift_rec].
    apply IH. exact HC.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Fork A (lift_rec u k 1)) (lift_rec v k 1)).
    specialize (subtype_lift_rec (Fork A u) v HC k 1) as H.
    cbn [lift_rec] in H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Leaf *) exact HC.
  - (* Stem *)
    change (subtype A (lift_rec B k 1)).
    specialize (subtype_lift_rec A B HC k 1) as H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Fork *) exact HC.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IH. exact HC.
Qed.

(* Substituting a certificate at an arbitrary depth.  The head is assumed
   stable under substitution at every depth. *)
Lemma CertS_subst : forall A,
  (forall u k, subst_rec A u k = A) ->
  forall X u k, CertS A X -> CertS A (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  intros A HA X.
  induction X as [ n | Z IH | u v IHu IHv | | B IH | u v IHu IHv | Z IH ];
    intros w k HC; cbn [CertS] in *.
  - (* Var *) exact HC.
  - (* Quant *)
    cbn [subst_rec].
    apply IH. exact HC.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Fork A (subst_rec u w k)) (subst_rec v w k)).
    specialize (subtype_subst_rec (Fork A u) v HC w k) as H.
    cbn [subst_rec] in H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Leaf *) exact HC.
  - (* Stem *)
    change (subtype A (subst_rec B w k)).
    specialize (subtype_subst_rec A B HC w k) as H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Fork *) exact HC.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IH. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma CertS_transfer : forall A,
  (forall k, lift_rec A k 1 = A) ->
  (forall u k, subst_rec A u k = A) ->
  forall X Y, subtype X Y -> CertS A X -> CertS A Y.
Proof.
  intros A HA HS X Y H.
  induction H as
  [ ty
  | ty1 ty2 ty3 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
  | uty1 uty2 h IH
  | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
  | uty1 uty2 h IH
  | uty1 uty2 vty1 vty2 h1 IH1 h2 IH2
  | vty1 vty2 h IH

Lemma D2_gen : forall A,
  (forall k, lift_rec A k 1 = A) ->
  (forall u k, subst_rec A u k = A) ->
  forall u ty,
  subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Fork A u) ty.
Proof.
  intros A HA HS u ty H.
  eapply (CertS_transfer A HA HS (Stem A) (Funty u ty) H).
  cbn [CertS]. apply sub_zero.
Qed.

(* Ground types (no free variables) are stable under lift and substitution. *)
Fixpoint Novar (X : dtype) : Prop :=
  match X with
  | Var _ => False
  | Leaf => True
  | Stem Y => Novar Y
  | Fork Y Z => Novar Y /\ Novar Z
  | Funty Y Z => Novar Y /\ Novar Z
  | Quant Y => Novar Y
  | Asf Y => Novar Y
  end.

Lemma Novar_lift_rec : forall X, Novar X ->
  forall k m, lift_rec X k m = X.
Proof.
  induction X as [ n | Z IH | u v IHu IHv | | B IH | u v IHu IHv | Z IH ];
    intros HX k m; cbn in *; try contradiction; try reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) cbn [lift_rec]. f_equal. apply IH. exact HX.
  - (* Funty *)
    destruct HX as [Hu Hv]. cbn [lift_rec]. f_equal.
    + apply IHu. exact Hu.
    + apply IHv. exact Hv.
  - (* Stem *) cbn [lift_rec]. f_equal. apply IH. exact HX.
  - (* Fork *)
    destruct HX as [Hu Hv]. cbn [lift_rec]. f_equal.
    + apply IHu. exact Hu.
    + apply IHv. exact Hv.
  - (* Asf *) cbn [lift_rec]. f_equal. apply IH. exact HX.
Qed.

Lemma Novar_subst_rec : forall X, Novar X ->
  forall u k, subst_rec X u k = X.
Proof.
  induction X as [ n | Z IH | u v IHu IHv | | B IH | u v IHu IHv | Z IH ];
    intros HX w k; cbn in *; try contradiction; try reflexivity.
  - (* Quant *) cbn [subst_rec]. f_equal. apply IH. exact HX.
  - (* Funty *)
    destruct HX as [Hu Hv]. cbn [subst_rec]. f_equal.
    + apply IHu. exact Hu.
    + apply IHv. exact Hv.
  - (* Stem *) cbn [subst_rec]. f_equal. apply IH. exact HX.
  - (* Fork *)
    destruct HX as [Hu Hv]. cbn [subst_rec]. f_equal.
    + apply IHu. exact Hu.
    + apply IHv. exact Hv.
  - (* Asf *) cbn [subst_rec]. f_equal. apply IH. exact HX.
Qed.

Lemma program_type_Novar : forall p, Novar (program_type p).
Proof.
  induction p as [ x | | p1 IH1 p2 IH2 ]; cbn [program_type].
  - (* Ref *) cbn. split; exact Logic.I.
  - (* Node *) exact Logic.I.
  - (* App *)
    destruct (program_type p1) eqn:E; cbn in *.
    + (* Leaf *) exact IH2.
    + (* Quant *) cbn. split; exact Logic.I.
    + (* Funty *) cbn. split; exact Logic.I.
    + (* Leaf *)
      cbn. split; exact Logic.I.
    + (* Stem *)
      cbn. split.
      * (* Novar of the stem body, from IH1 *)
        rewrite E in IH1. cbn in IH1. exact IH1.
      * exact IH2.
    + (* Fork *) cbn. split; exact Logic.I.
    + (* Asf *) cbn. split; exact Logic.I.
Qed.

Lemma D2_program : forall p u ty,
  subtype (Stem (program_type p)) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype (Fork (program_type p) u) ty.
Proof.
  intros p.
  apply D2_gen.
  - intros k. apply (Novar_lift_rec (program_type p) (program_type_Novar p) k 1).
  - intros u k. apply (Novar_subst_rec (program_type p) (program_type_Novar p) u k).
Qed.

| Ref y =>  if eqb x y then I else (K@ (Ref y))
| △ => K@ △

(* Lifting a certificate at amount 1, for an arbitrary cutoff.  The head is
   assumed stable under lifting by one at every cutoff. *)
Lemma CertS_lift : forall X A,
  (forall k, lift_rec A k 1 = A) ->
  forall k, CertS A X -> CertS A (lift_rec X k 1).
Proof.
  induction X as [ n | Z IH | u v IHu IHv | | B IH | u v IHu IHv | Z IH ];
    intros A HA k HC; cbn [CertS] in *.
  - (* Var *) exact HC.
  - (* Quant *)
    cbn [lift_rec].
    apply IH with (A := lift 1 A) (k := S k).
    + intros kk. unfold lift. rewrite (HA 0). apply HA.
    + exact HC.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Fork A (lift_rec u k 1)) (lift_rec v k 1)).
    specialize (subtype_lift_rec (Fork A u) v HC k 1) as H.
    cbn [lift_rec] in H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Leaf *) exact HC.
  - (* Stem *)
    change (subtype A (lift_rec B k 1)).
    specialize (subtype_lift_rec A B HC k 1) as H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Fork *) exact HC.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IH with (A := A) (k := k). exact HA. exact HC.
Qed.

(* Substituting a certificate at an arbitrary depth.  The head is assumed
   stable under substitution at every depth. *)
Lemma CertS_subst : forall X A,
  (forall u k, subst_rec A u k = A) ->
  forall u k, CertS A X -> CertS A (subst_rec X u k).
Proof.
  induction X as [ n | Z IH | u v IHu IHv | | B IH | u v IHu IHv | Z IH ];
    intros A HA w k HC; cbn [CertS] in *.
  - (* Var *) exact HC.
  - (* Quant *)
    cbn [subst_rec].
    apply IH with (A := lift 1 A) (w := w) (k := S k).
    + intros ww kk. unfold lift. rewrite (HA 0). apply HA.
    + exact HC.
  - (* Funty *)
    change (subtype (Fork A (subst_rec u w k)) (subst_rec v w k)).
    specialize (subtype_subst_rec (Fork A u) v HC w k) as H.
    cbn [subst_rec] in H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Leaf *) exact HC.
  - (* Stem *)
    change (subtype A (subst_rec B w k)).
    specialize (subtype_subst_rec A B HC w k) as H.
    rewrite HA in H.
    exact H.
  - (* Fork *) exact HC.
  - (* Asf *)
    apply IH with (A := A) (w := w) (k := k). exact HA. exact HC.
Qed.

Lemma CertS_transfer : forall A,
  (forall k, lift_rec A k 1 = A) ->
  (forall u k, subst_rec A u k = A) ->
  forall X Y, subtype X Y -> CertS A X -> CertS A Y.

  | uty1 uty2 h IH

Require Import String Arith Lia Bool List Nat.
Require Import terms types subtypes derive.

Load "/tmp/new/d2_complete.v".

Open Scope string_scope.
Open Scope nat_scope.

Set Default Proof Using "Type".

Lemma derive_node_inv: forall gamma ty,
  derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma derive_app_inv: forall gamma M N ty,
  derive gamma (M @ N) ty ->
  exists u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) /\ derive gamma N u.
Proof.
  intros gamma M N ty H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma stem_fun_principal: forall M gamma u ty,
  program M ->
  (forall gamma ty, derive gamma M ty -> subtype (program_type M) ty) ->
  derive gamma (Node @ M) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype (Stem (program_type M)) (Funty u ty).
Proof.
  intros M gamma u ty Hp IH Hd.
  destruct (derive_app_inv _ _ _ _ Hd) as [u0 [HdM HdN]].
  pose proof (derive_node_inv _ _ HdM) as HL.
  pose proof (IH _ _ HdN) as HA.
  eapply subtype_leaf_app; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma leaf_fun2: forall A B : dtype, subtype Leaf (Funty A (Funty B (Fork A B))).
Proof.
  intros A B. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_types: forall p gamma, program p -> derive gamma p (program_type p).
Proof.
  intros p gamma Hp. induction Hp.
  - simpl. apply derive_node, sub_zero.
  - simpl. eapply derive_app.
    + apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + exact IHHp.
  - simpl. eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_app.
      * apply derive_node. apply leaf_fun2.
      * exact IHHp1.
    + exact IHHp2.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_principal_types:
  forall p, program p ->
            forall gamma ty, derive gamma p ty -> subtype (program_type p) ty.
Proof.
  intros p Hp. induction Hp; intros gamma ty Hd.
  - simpl. apply derive_node_inv with (gamma := gamma). exact Hd.
  - simpl.
    destruct (derive_app_inv _ _ _ _ Hd) as [u0 [HdM HdN]].
    pose proof (derive_node_inv _ _ HdM) as HL.
    pose proof (IHHp _ _ HdN) as HA.
    eapply subtype_leaf_app; eassumption.
  - simpl.
    destruct (derive_app_inv _ _ _ _ Hd) as [u0 [Hd1 HdN]].
    pose proof (IHHp1 _ _ Hd1) as HM.
    pose proof (IHHp2 _ _ HdN) as HN.
    eapply subtype_stem_app; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma subtype_stem_app :

    subtype (Stem A) (Funty u ty) ->

Proof.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Task lemmas and main theorems                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma derive_node_inv: forall gamma ty,
  derive gamma Node ty -> subtype Leaf ty.
Proof.
  intros gamma ty H. inversion H; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma derive_app_inv: forall gamma M N ty,
  derive gamma (M @ N) ty ->
  exists u, derive gamma M (Funty u ty) /\ derive gamma N u.
Proof.
  intros gamma M N ty H. inversion H; subst.
  eexists; split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma stem_fun_principal: forall M gamma u ty,
  program M ->
  (forall gamma ty, derive gamma M ty -> subtype (program_type M) ty) ->
  derive gamma (Node @ M) (Funty u ty) ->
  subtype (Stem (program_type M)) (Funty u ty).
Proof.
  intros M gamma u ty Hp IH Hd.
  destruct (derive_app_inv _ _ _ _ Hd) as [u0 [HdM HdN]].
  pose proof (derive_node_inv _ _ HdM) as HL.
  pose proof (IH _ _ HdN) as HA.
  eapply subtype_leaf_app; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma leaf_fun2: forall A B : dtype, subtype Leaf (Funty A (Funty B (Fork A B))).
Proof.
  intros A B. eapply sub_trans.
  - apply sub_leaf_fun.
  - eapply sub_funty.
    + apply sub_zero.
    + apply sub_stem_fun.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_types: forall p gamma, program p -> derive gamma p (program_type p).
Proof.
  intros p gamma Hp. induction Hp.
  - simpl. apply derive_node, sub_zero.
  - simpl. eapply derive_app.
    + apply derive_node. apply sub_leaf_fun.
    + exact IHHp.
  - simpl. eapply derive_app.
    + eapply derive_app.
      * apply derive_node. apply leaf_fun2.
      * exact IHHp1.
    + exact IHHp2.
Qed.

Theorem programs_have_principal_types:
  forall p, program p ->
            forall gamma ty, derive gamma p ty -> subtype (program_type p) ty.
Proof.
  intros p Hp. induction Hp; intros gamma ty Hd.
  - simpl. apply derive_node_inv with (gamma := gamma). exact Hd.
  - simpl.
    destruct (derive_app_inv _ _ _ _ Hd) as [u0 [HdM HdN]].
    pose proof (derive_node_inv _ _ HdM) as HL.
    pose proof (IHHp _ _ HdN) as HA.
    eapply subtype_leaf_app; eassumption.
  - simpl.
    destruct (derive_app_inv _ _ _ _ Hd) as [u0 [Hd1 HdN]].
    pose proof (stem_fun_principal M gamma u0 ty Hp1 IHHp1 Hd1) as HM.
    pose proof (IHHp2 _ _ HdN) as HN.
    eapply subtype_stem_app; eassumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D1 and D2 certificates                                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D1 certificate                                                      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good (S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => True
  | Funty a b => subtype (Stem a) b
  | Quant Z => Good Z
  | Asf Z => Good Z
  | Stem _ => False
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good_stable :
  (forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, Good S -> subtype S T -> Good T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T H d. induction d; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact H.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2. apply IHd1. exact H.
  - (* sub_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_funty *) eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact H ].
    apply sub_stem. exact d1.
  - (* sub_quant *) apply IHd. exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exact H.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply stem_quant_lift. exact H.
  - (* sub_inst *) unfold subst. apply Hsubst. exact H.
  - (* sub_lift *) unfold lift. apply Hlift. exact H.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact H.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact H.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Good_lift : forall S k n, Good S -> Good (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (subtype_lift_rec (Stem a) b H k n).
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma Good_subst : forall S w k, Good S -> Good (subst_rec S w k).
Proof.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros w k H; simpl in *.
  - exfalso. exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
  - exact (subtype_subst_rec (Stem a) b H w k).
  - exact Logic.I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma D1_unconditional :
  forall u ty, subtype Leaf (Funty u ty) -> subtype (Stem u) ty.
Proof.
  intros u ty d.
  exact (Good_stable Good_lift Good_subst Leaf (Funty u ty) Logic.I d).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* D2 certificate (head shifted by lift 1 under Quant binders)         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Fixpoint Good2 (A S : dtype) : Prop :=
  match S with
  | Leaf => False
  | Funty a b => subtype (Fork A a) b
  | Quant Z => Good2 (lift 1 A) Z
  | Asf Z => Good2 A Z
  | Stem B => subtype A B
  | Fork _ _ => False
  | Var _ => False
  end.

Lemma Good2_stable :
  (forall (A S : dtype) (k n : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n)) ->
  (forall (A S w : dtype) (k : nat),
      Good2 A S -> Good2 (subst_rec A w k) (subst_rec S w k)) ->
  forall S T, subtype S T -> forall A, Good2 A S -> Good2 A T.
Proof.
  intros Hlift Hsubst S T d. induction d; intros A HG; simpl in *.
  - (* sub_zero *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_trans *) apply IHd2, IHd1, HG.
  - (* sub_stem *) eapply sub_trans; [ exact HG | exact d ].
  - (* sub_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_asf *) apply IHd. exact HG.
  - (* sub_funty *)
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact d2 ].
    eapply sub_trans; [ | exact HG ].
    apply sub_fork; [ apply sub_zero | exact d1 ].
  - (* sub_quant *) apply (IHd (lift 1 A)). exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_stem *)
    eapply sub_trans.
    + apply sub_lift.
    + apply sub_quant. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_quant_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_dist *) apply fork_quant_lift. exact HG.
  - (* sub_inst *)
    pose proof (Hsubst (lift 1 A) ty u 0 HG) as X.
    change (Good2 (subst (lift 1 A) u) (subst ty u)) in X.
    rewrite subst_lift1 in X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_lift *)
    pose proof (Hlift A ty 0 1 HG) as X.
    exact X.
  - (* sub_leaf_fun *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_stem_fun *)
    apply sub_fork.
    + exact HG.
    + apply sub_zero.
  - (* sub_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_leaf *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_stem *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_fork_fork_fork *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_recursion *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_tree *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_to_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_from_asf *) exact HG.
  - (* sub_bffs *) exfalso. exact HG.
  - (* sub_bfff *) exfalso. exact HG.
Qed.

Lemma Good2_lift :
  forall A S k n, Good2 A S -> Good2 (lift_rec A k n) (lift_rec S k n).
Proof.
  intros A S. revert A.
  induction S as [ m | S1 IH | a IHa b IHb | | B IH | A1 IHA1 B1 IHB1 | Z IH ];
    intros A k n H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - (* Quant *)
    assert (E : lift_rec (lift 1 A) (S k) n = lift 1 (lift_rec A k n)).
    { unfold lift.
      pose proof (lift_lift_subst_gen A 0 1 (S k) n ltac:(lia)) as Hll.
      replace (0 + S k) with (S k) in Hll by lia.
